local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Util = {}

function Util.isString(value, maxLength)
	return type(value) == "string" and #value <= (maxLength or 200)
end

function Util.isNumber(value)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

function Util.isInteger(value)
	return Util.isNumber(value) and value == math.floor(value)
end

function Util.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
	return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, value))
end

function Util.getCharacter(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if character and character.Parent then
		return character
	end
	return nil
end

function Util.getHumanoid(player)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end

function Util.getRoot(player)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end

function Util.isAlive(player)
	local humanoid = Util.getHumanoid(player)
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

function Util.playerFromModel(model)
	if typeof(model) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end
	local current = model
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current)
		if player then
			return player
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

function Util.deepCopy(source)
	if type(source) ~= "table" then
		return source
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(source) do
		copy[key] = Util.deepCopy(value)
	end
	return copy
end

function Util.reconcile(target, template)
	for key, value in pairs(template) do
		if target[key] == nil then
			target[key] = Util.deepCopy(value)
		elseif type(target[key]) == "table" and type(value) == "table" then
			Util.reconcile(target[key], value)
		end
	end
	return target
end

return Util

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local RateLimiter = {}

local buckets = {}

local function bucketsFor(player)
	local list = buckets[player]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		buckets[player] = list
	end
	return list
end

function RateLimiter.allow(player, key, perSecond, burst)
	local now = os.clock()
	local list = bucketsFor(player)
	burst = burst or perSecond
	local bucket = list[key]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { tokens = burst, last = now }
		list[key] = bucket
	end
	bucket.tokens = math.min(burst, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.last) * perSecond)
	bucket.last = now
	if bucket.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= 1
	return true
end

function RateLimiter.cooldown(player, key, seconds)
	local now = os.clock()
	local list = bucketsFor(player)
	local last = list["cd_" .. key]
	if last and now - last < seconds then
		return false
	end
	list["cd_" .. key] = now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	buckets[player] = nil
end)

return RateLimiter

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Server = script.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)
local Util = require(Server.Util)

local PlayerStore = {}

local memory = {}
local store = nil
local checked = false

local VALUE_CLASSES = { IntValue = true, NumberValue = true, StringValue = true, BoolValue = true }
local CONTAINER_CLASSES = { Folder = true, Configuration = true }

local function getStore()
	if checked then
		return store
	end
	checked = true
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
		dataStore:GetAsync("__probe")
		return dataStore
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	elseif RunService:IsStudio() then
		store = nil
	else
		store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
	end
	return store
end

local function keyFor(userId)
	return "Player_" .. tostring(userId)
end

local function lockedByOther(record)
	return record ~= nil
		and record.lock ~= nil
		and record.lock ~= game.JobId
		and os.time() - (record.lockTime or 0) < Config.LockTimeout
end

function PlayerStore.Fetch(userId)
	local dataStore = getStore()
	if not dataStore then
		return true, Util.deepCopy(memory[userId])
	end
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	for attempt = 1, Config.SaveRetries do
		local locked = false
		local blob = nil
		local ok = pcall(function()
			dataStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				if lockedByOther(old) then
					locked = true
					return nil
				end
				old = old or {}
				old.lock = game.JobId
				old.lockTime = os.time()
				blob = old.data
				return old
			end)
		end)
		if ok and not locked then
			return true, blob
		end
		task.wait(locked and 4 or attempt)
	end
	return false, nil
end

function PlayerStore.Write(userId, blob, release)
	local dataStore = getStore()
	if not dataStore then
		memory[userId] = Util.deepCopy(blob)
		return true
	end
	local key = keyFor(userId)
	for attempt = 1, Config.SaveRetries do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			dataStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				if lockedByOther(old) then
					return nil
				end
				return {
					data = blob,
					lock = (not release) and game.JobId or nil,
					lockTime = os.time(),
				}
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	return false
end

local function cleanAttributes(instance)
	local result = nil
	for name, value in pairs(instance:GetAttributes()) do
		local kind = type(value)
		if kind == "number" or kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" then
			result = result or {}
			result[name] = value
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function describe(instance, path)
	local entry = nil
	if VALUE_CLASSES[instance.ClassName] then
		entry = { p = path, c = instance.ClassName, v = instance.Value }
	elseif CONTAINER_CLASSES[instance.ClassName] then
		entry = { p = path, c = instance.ClassName }
	end
	if entry then
		local attributes = cleanAttributes(instance)
		if attributes then
			entry.a = attributes
		end
	end
	return entry
end

function PlayerStore.Serialize(player)
	local entries = {}
	local function walk(instance, path)
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			local childPath = table.clone(path)
			table.insert(childPath, child.Name)
			local entry = describe(child, childPath)
			if entry then
				table.insert(entries, entry)
				walk(child, childPath)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, rootName in ipairs(Config.PersistedRoots) do
		local root = player:FindFirstChild(rootName)
		if root then
			local rootPath = { rootName }
			local entry = describe(root, rootPath)
			if entry then
				table.insert(entries, entry)
				walk(root, rootPath)
			end
		end
	end
	return { v = 1, Entries = entries }
end

local function resolve(container, path)
	local current = container
	for index = 1, #path - 1 do
		local nextInstance = current:FindFirstChild(path[index])
		if not nextInstance then
			nextInstance = Instance.new("Folder")
			nextInstance.Name = path[index]
			nextInstance.Parent = current
		end
		current = nextInstance
	end
	local name = path[#path]
	return current, name, current:FindFirstChild(name)
end

function PlayerStore.Apply(container, blob)
	if type(blob) ~= "table" or type(blob.Entries) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(blob.Entries) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.p) == "table" and #entry.p > 0 and type(entry.c) == "string" then
			local parent, name, target = resolve(container, entry.p)
			if VALUE_CLASSES[entry.c] then
				if not target then
					target = Instance.new(entry.c)
					target.Name = name
					target.Parent = parent
				end
				if target:IsA("ValueBase") and typeof(entry.v) == typeof(target.Value) then
					target.Value = entry.v
				end
			elseif CONTAINER_CLASSES[entry.c] and not target then
				target = Instance.new(entry.c)
				target.Name = name
				target.Parent = parent
			end
			if target and type(entry.a) == "table" then
				for attributeName, attributeValue in pairs(entry.a) do
					target:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

return PlayerStore

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

local Server = script.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)
local Util = require(Server.Util)
local PlayerStore = require(Server.PlayerStore)
local ServerSignals = require(ServerStorage.ServerSignals)
local statscaling = require(ServerStorage:WaitForChild("statscaling"))

local ServerData = {}

local states = {}
local characterStates = {}
local spawning = {}

_G.session = _G.session or {}

local function defaultExtra()
	return { Inventory = {}, Fruits = {}, Fish = {}, Unlockables = {}, Titles = {}, Settings = {}, Flags = {}, Quest = {}, BonusMoments = {}, CompletedMaps = {}, AuraExp = 0 }
end

local function newValue(parent, className, name, value)
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	instance.Name = name
	if value ~= nil then
		instance.Value = value
	end
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function newFolder(parent, className, name)
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	instance.Name = name
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function buildFallbackTemplate()
	local container = Instance.new("Folder")
	local data = newFolder(container, "Folder", "Data")
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Beli", 0)
	newValue(data, "StringValue", "CrewID", "")
	newValue(data, "StringValue", "DevilFruit", "")
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Exp", 0)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Fragments", 0)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "FruitCap", 1)
	newValue(data, "StringValue", "LastSpawnPoint", Config.DefaultSpawnName)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Level", 1)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Points", 3)
	local race = newValue(data, "StringValue", "Race", "Human")
	newValue(race, "IntValue", "A", 0)
	newValue(race, "IntValue", "B", 0)
	newValue(race, "IntValue", "C", 0)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "RaceRerolls", 0)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "SeaEventsCleared", 0)
	newValue(data, "StringValue", "SpawnPoint", Config.DefaultSpawnName)
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "StatRefunds", 0)
	newValue(data, "StringValue", "Subclass", "")
	newValue(data, "IntValue", "Valor", 0)
	local stats = newFolder(data, "Folder", "Stats")
	local stars = newFolder(data, "Folder", "Stars")
	for _, name in ipairs(Config.StatNames) do
		local stat = newFolder(stats, "Folder", name)
		newValue(stat, "IntValue", "Exp", 0)
		newValue(stat, "IntValue", "Level", 0)
		newValue(stat, "IntValue", "Original", 0)
	end
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Gun", "Sword", "Melee", "Blox Fruit", "Max" }) do
		newValue(stars, "IntValue", name, 1)
	end
	newValue(container, "BoolValue", "DataLoaded", false)
	newFolder(container, "ObjectValue", "LocationTag")
	local leaderstats = newValue(container, "IntValue", "leaderstats", 0)
	newValue(leaderstats, "IntValue", "Bounty/Honor", 0)
	return container
end

local function findTemplate()
	local stored = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local template = stored and stored:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateFolderName)
	if template and #template:GetChildren() > 0 then
		return template
	end
	local host = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateHostName)
	template = host and host:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateFolderName)
	if template and #template:GetChildren() > 0 then
		return template
	end
	return nil
end

local function instantiateTemplate()
	local template = findTemplate()
	if not template then
		return buildFallbackTemplate()
	end
	local container = Instance.new("Folder")
	for _, child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		child:Clone().Parent = container
	end
	return container
end

local function getCharactersFolder()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Characters"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end
	return folder
end

local function dataFolder(player)
	return player:FindFirstChild("Data")
end

function ServerData.GetValueObject(player, name)
	local folder = dataFolder(player)
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
end

function ServerData.Get(player, name)
	local object = ServerData.GetValueObject(player, name)
	if object and object:IsA("ValueBase") then
		return object.Value
	end
	return nil
end

function ServerData.Set(player, name, value)
	local object = ServerData.GetValueObject(player, name)
	if object and object:IsA("ValueBase") and typeof(object.Value) == typeof(value) then
		object.Value = value
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function ServerData.Increment(player, name, delta)
	local current = ServerData.Get(player, name)
	if type(current) ~= "number" or not Util.isNumber(delta) then
		return nil
	end
	ServerData.Set(player, name, current + delta)
	return current + delta
end

function ServerData.GetStat(player, statName)
	local folder = dataFolder(player)
	local stats = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Stats")
	local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(statName)
	local level = stat and stat:FindFirstChild("Level")
	return level and level.Value or 0
end

function ServerData.GetExtra(player)
	local state = states[player]
	return state and state.extra or nil
end

function ServerData.GetState(player)
	return states[player]
end

function ServerData.IsReady(player)
	local state = states[player]
	return state ~= nil and state.ready == true
end

function ServerData.WaitReady(player, timeout)
	local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 20)
	while player.Parent and not ServerData.IsReady(player) and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return ServerData.IsReady(player)
end

function ServerData.Notify(player, message)
	if type(message) ~= "string" or not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
	if remote then
		remote:FireClient(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end

function ServerData.SetPlayerAttribute(player, name, value)
	player:SetAttribute(name, value)
end

function ServerData.SetCharacterAttribute(player, name, value)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute(name, value)
	end
end

function ServerData.ApplyCharacterAttributes(character, overrides)
	for name, value in pairs(Config.CharacterAttributes) do
		character:SetAttribute(name, value)
	end
	if overrides then
		for name, value in pairs(overrides) do
			character:SetAttribute(name, value)
		end
	end
end

local function teamNameOf(player)
	return player.Team and player.Team.Name or nil
end

local function spawnsFolder(teamName)
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	local spawns = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpawns")
	return spawns and teamName and spawns:FindFirstChild(teamName) or nil
end

local function spawnParts(model)
	local parts = {}
	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(parts, model)
	else
		for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(parts, child)
			end
		end
	end
	return parts
end

local function cframeFromSpawn(model)
	local parts = spawnParts(model)
	if #parts > 0 then
		local part = parts[math.random(#parts)]
		return part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + Config.SpawnHeightOffset, 0)
	end
	local ok, pivot = pcall(function()
		return model:GetPivot()
	end)
	if ok then
		return pivot + Vector3.new(0, Config.SpawnHeightOffset, 0)
	end
	return nil
end

function ServerData.GetSpawnModel(player, name)
	local folder = spawnsFolder(teamNameOf(player))
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local model = nil
	if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
		model = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	if not model then
		model = folder:FindFirstChild(Config.DefaultSpawnName) or folder:GetChildren()[1]
	end
	return model
end

function ServerData.GetSpawnCFrame(player)
	local chosen = ServerData.Get(player, "SpawnPoint")
	if type(chosen) ~= "string" or chosen == "" then
		chosen = ServerData.Get(player, "LastSpawnPoint")
	end
	local model = ServerData.GetSpawnModel(player, chosen)
	local cframe = model and cframeFromSpawn(model) or nil
	return cframe or CFrame.new(0, 60, 0), model
end

local function focalPoint(player)
	local folder = spawnsFolder(teamNameOf(player))
	local default = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(Config.DefaultSpawnName)
	local parts = default and spawnParts(default) or {}
	return parts[1] and parts[1].Position or nil
end

local function validateSpawnTarget(player, name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or #name == 0 or #name > 64 then
		return nil
	end
	local folder = spawnsFolder(teamNameOf(player))
	local model = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not model then
		return nil
	end
	local root = Util.getRoot(player)
	if root then
		local ok, pivot = pcall(function()
			return model:GetPivot()
		end)
		if ok and (root.Position - pivot.Position).Magnitude > Config.SpawnPointMaxDistance then
			return nil
		end
	end
	return model
end

function ServerData.SetLastSpawnPoint(player, name)
	local model = validateSpawnTarget(player, name)
	if not model then
		return false
	end
	return ServerData.Set(player, "LastSpawnPoint", model.Name)
end

function ServerData.SetSpawnPoint(player)
	local last = ServerData.Get(player, "LastSpawnPoint")
	local model = validateSpawnTarget(player, last)
	if not model then
		return false
	end
	ServerData.Set(player, "SpawnPoint", model.Name)
	return true
end

function ServerData.TeleportToSpawn(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or not Util.isAlive(player) then
		return nil
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if character:GetAttribute("InCombat") == true then
		ServerData.Notify(player, "You cannot do this while in combat.")
		return nil
	end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if state.nextHome and now < state.nextHome then
		return state.nextHome
	end
	local readyAt = now + Config.HomeTeleportDelay
	state.nextHome = readyAt + Config.HomeTeleportCooldown
	task.delay(Config.HomeTeleportDelay, function()
		if player.Parent and player.Character == character and Util.isAlive(player) then
			local cframe = ServerData.GetSpawnCFrame(player)
			character:PivotTo(cframe)
		end
	end)
	return readyAt
end

function ServerData.EnablePvp(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false then
		return false
	end
	player:SetAttribute("PvpDisabled", false)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("PvpDisabled", false)
	end
	return true
end

local function healthMaxFor(player)
	return math.floor(statscaling.health(player))
end

local function energyMaxFor(player)
	return math.floor(statscaling.energy(player))
end

function ServerData.RefreshCharacter(player)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	local characterState = character and characterStates[character]
	if not characterState then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = characterState.humanoid
	local ratio = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
	local maxHealth = healthMaxFor(player)
	humanoid.MaxHealth = maxHealth
	humanoid.Health = math.max(1, maxHealth * ratio)
	local maxEnergy = energyMaxFor(player)
	characterState.energy.MaxValue = maxEnergy
end

function ServerData.AddPoint(player, statName, amount)
	if type(statName) ~= "string" or not Util.isInteger(amount) or amount < 1 then
		return false
	end
	local folder = dataFolder(player)
	local stats = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Stats")
	local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(statName)
	local level = stat and stat:FindFirstChild("Level")
	local points = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Points")
	if not level or not points then
		return false
	end
	amount = math.min(amount, points.Value, Config.StatCap - level.Value)
	if amount <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	level.Value += amount
	points.Value -= amount
	ServerData.RefreshCharacter(player)
	return true
end

function ServerData.SpendEnergy(player, amount)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	local characterState = character and characterStates[character]
	if not characterState or not Util.isNumber(amount) or amount < 0 then
		return false
	end
	if characterState.energy.Value < amount then
		return false
	end
	characterState.energy.Value = math.max(0, characterState.energy.Value - math.ceil(amount))
	return true
end

function ServerData.GetCharacterState(player)
	local character = Util.getCharacter(player)
	return character and characterStates[character] or nil
end

local buttonprops = { Position = true, Scale = true }

local function buttoncustomization(extra)
	local stored = extra.Settings.MobileButtonCustomization
	if type(stored) ~= "table" then
		stored = { Position = {}, Scale = {} }
		extra.Settings.MobileButtonCustomization = stored
	end
	stored.Position = type(stored.Position) == "table" and stored.Position or {}
	stored.Scale = type(stored.Scale) == "table" and stored.Scale or {}
	return stored
end

local function changebuttoncustomization(extra, change)
	if type(change) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	if change.Prop == "Reset" then
		extra.Settings.MobileButtonCustomization = { Position = {}, Scale = {} }
		return true
	end
	if not buttonprops[change.Prop] or type(change.ButtonName) ~= "string" or #change.ButtonName > 64 then
		return false
	end
	local value = change.Value
	if change.Prop == "Scale" then
		if not Util.isNumber(value) then
			return false
		end
		value = math.clamp(value, 0.25, 4)
	else
		if type(value) ~= "table" or not Util.isNumber(value.X) or not Util.isNumber(value.Y) then
			return false
		end
		value = { X = math.clamp(value.X, -2, 2), Y = math.clamp(value.Y, -2, 2) }
	end
	buttoncustomization(extra)[change.Prop][change.ButtonName] = value
	return true
end

function ServerData.GetSetting(player, name, prop)
	local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
	if not extra or type(name) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	if name == "MobileButtonCustomization" then
		local stored = buttoncustomization(extra)
		if buttonprops[prop] then
			return table.clone(stored[prop])
		end
		return { Position = table.clone(stored.Position), Scale = table.clone(stored.Scale) }
	end
	local value = extra.Settings[name]
	if value == nil then
		return Config.DefaultSettings[name]
	end
	return value
end

function ServerData.ChangeSetting(player, name, value)
	local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
	if not extra or type(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	if name == "MobileButtonCustomization" then
		return changebuttoncustomization(extra, value)
	end
	local default = Config.DefaultSettings[name]
	if default == nil or type(value) ~= type(default) then
		return false
	end
	extra.Settings[name] = value
	return true
end

local function setupCharacter(player, character)
	if not ServerData.WaitReady(player, 30) then
		return
	end
	if not player.Parent or player.Character ~= character then
		return
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 10
	while not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and player.Character == character and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait()
	end
	if player.Character ~= character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end
	character.Parent = getCharactersFolder()
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not humanoid or not root or not character.Parent then
		return
	end
	humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled = true
	local cframe = ServerData.GetSpawnCFrame(player)
	character:PivotTo(cframe)
	local maxHealth = healthMaxFor(player)
	humanoid.MaxHealth = maxHealth
	humanoid.Health = maxHealth
	local busy = newValue(character, "BoolValue", "Busy", false)
	local stun = newValue(character, "NumberValue", "Stun", 0)
	newValue(character, "NumberValue", "Rage", 0)
	local maxEnergy = energyMaxFor(player)
	local energy = Instance.new("IntConstrainedValue")
	energy.Name = "Energy"
	energy.MinValue = 0
	energy.MaxValue = maxEnergy
	energy.Value = maxEnergy
	energy.Parent = character
	ServerData.ApplyCharacterAttributes(character)
	local pvp = player:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled")
	character:SetAttribute("PvpDisabled", pvp == nil and true or pvp)
	root:SetAttribute("DoneSpawning", true)
	local focal = focalPoint(player)
	if focal then
		player:SetAttribute("FocalSpawnPoint", focal)
	end
	characterStates[character] = {
		player = player,
		character = character,
		humanoid = humanoid,
		root = root,
		energy = energy,
		busy = busy,
		stun = stun,
		regen = 0,
		lastDodge = 0,
		lastJump = 0,
	}
	newFolder(character, "Folder", "CharacterReady")
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		characterStates[character] = nil
		task.delay(Config.RespawnDelay, function()
			if player.Parent and player.Character == character then
				ServerData.Spawn(player)
			end
		end)
	end)
	character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			characterStates[character] = nil
		end
	end)
	ServerSignals.CharacterReady():Fire(player, character)
end

function ServerData.ChangeTeam(player, teamName)
	local team = Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName)
	if not team or not Config.Teams[teamName] then
		return false
	end
	player.Team = team
	local focal = focalPoint(player)
	if focal then
		player:SetAttribute("FocalSpawnPoint", focal)
	end
	return true
end

function ServerData.Spawn(player)
	if spawning[player] or not player.Parent or not player.Team then
		return false
	end
	spawning[player] = true
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end)
	spawning[player] = nil
	if not ok then
		warn(err)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function ServerData.SetTeam(player, teamName)
	if type(teamName) ~= "string" or not Config.Teams[teamName] then
		return false
	end
	local team = Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName)
	if not team then
		return false
	end
	if player.Team and player.Character and characterStates[player.Character] then
		return false
	end
	player.Team = team
	local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	local selector = gui and gui:FindFirstChild(Config.TeamSelectGuiName)
	if selector then
		selector:Destroy()
	end
	return ServerData.Spawn(player)
end

local function cloneHostGuis(player)
	if not Config.CloneHostGuis then
		return
	end
	local host = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateHostName)
	if not host then
		return
	end
	local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	for _, source in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
		local allowed = Config.CloneAllHostGuis or source.Name == Config.TeamSelectGuiName
		if source:IsA("ScreenGui") and allowed and not gui:FindFirstChild(source.Name) then
			source:Clone().Parent = gui
		end
	end
end

local function createSession(player, state)
	state.extra.UserId = player.UserId
	local wrap = { player = player }
	local session = { player = player, userId = player.UserId, wrap = wrap, state = state, Data = state.extra }
	function wrap.notify(first, second)
		ServerData.Notify(player, type(first) == "string" and first or second)
	end
	function wrap.getSession()
		return session
	end
	function wrap.replicateItemId()
	end
	function wrap.replicateItem()
	end
	_G.session[player] = session
	_G.session[player.UserId] = session
end

local function save(player, release)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or not state.ready or state.saving then
		return false
	end
	local blob = PlayerStore.Serialize(player)
	blob.Extra = state.extra
	return PlayerStore.Write(player.UserId, blob, release == true)
end

function ServerData.Save(player, release)
	return save(player, release)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	if states[player] then
		return
	end
	local state = { ready = false, extra = defaultExtra() }
	states[player] = state
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		task.spawn(setupCharacter, player, character)
	end)
	local ok, blob = PlayerStore.Fetch(player.UserId)
	if not player.Parent then
		if ok then
			PlayerStore.Write(player.UserId, blob or { v = 1, Entries = {} }, true)
		end
		states[player] = nil
		return
	end
	if not ok then
		states[player] = nil
		player:Kick("Your data could not be loaded. Please rejoin in a moment.")
		return
	end
	local container = instantiateTemplate()
	local loaded = container:FindFirstChild("DataLoaded")
	if loaded then
		loaded.Value = false
	end
	if blob then
		PlayerStore.Apply(container, blob)
		if type(blob.Extra) == "table" then
			state.extra = Util.reconcile(blob.Extra, defaultExtra())
		end
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		child.Parent = player
	end
	container:Destroy()
	for name, value in pairs(Config.PlayerAttributes) do
		player:SetAttribute(name, value)
	end
	state.ready = true
	createSession(player, state)
	task.spawn(function()
		local replicated, err = pcall(function()
			require(ReplicatedStorage.Util.LevelCap).replicateLevelCap(player)
		end)
		if not replicated then
			warn("[ServerData] LevelCap replication failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
	local flag = player:FindFirstChild("DataLoaded")
	if flag then
		flag.Value = true
	end
	task.spawn(cloneHostGuis, player)
	ServerSignals.PlayerDataLoaded():Fire(player)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.ready then
		ServerSignals.PlayerDataSaving():Fire(player)
		save(player, true)
		state.saving = true
	end
	_G.session[player] = nil
	_G.session[player.UserId] = nil
	states[player] = nil
	spawning[player] = nil
end

function ServerData.Init()
	Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false
	getCharactersFolder()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.AutoSaveInterval)
			for player in pairs(states) do
				task.spawn(save, player, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		for character, characterState in pairs(characterStates) do
			if characterState.humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local energy = characterState.energy
				if energy.Value < energy.MaxValue then
					local grounded = characterState.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
					characterState.regen += math.max(Config.EnergyRegenPerSecond, energy.MaxValue * 0.03) * (grounded and 2 or 1) * deltaTime
					if characterState.regen >= 1 then
						local whole = math.floor(characterState.regen)
						characterState.regen -= whole
						energy.Value = math.min(energy.MaxValue, energy.Value + whole)
					end
				end
				if characterState.stun.Value > 0 then
					characterState.stun.Value = math.max(0, characterState.stun.Value - deltaTime)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player, state in pairs(states) do
			if state.ready and not state.saving then
				state.saving = true
				pending += 1
				task.spawn(function()
					local blob = PlayerStore.Serialize(player)
					blob.Extra = state.extra
					PlayerStore.Write(player.UserId, blob, true)
					pending -= 1
				end)
			end
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 25
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

return ServerData

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Server = script.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)
local RateLimiter = require(Server.RateLimiter)
local ServerData = require(Server.ServerData)

local Router = {}

Router.CLIENT_ERROR = "[client]"

local commF = {}
local commE = {}
local netModule = nil

local function normalise(options)
	options = options or {}
	if options.requireData == nil then
		options.requireData = true
	end
	return options
end

local function invoke(name, entry, player, ...)
	if entry.options.requireData and not ServerData.IsReady(player) then
		return nil
	end
	if entry.options.rate then
		local burst = entry.options.burst or entry.options.rate * 2
		if not RateLimiter.allow(player, "cmd:" .. name, entry.options.rate, burst) then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local results = table.pack(pcall(entry.handler, player, ...))
	if not results[1] then
		local message = tostring(results[2])
		if string.sub(message, 1, #Router.CLIENT_ERROR) == Router.CLIENT_ERROR then
			error(message, 0)
		end
		warn(("[Router] %s failed: %s"):format(name, message))
		return nil
	end
	return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
end

local function getNet()
	if netModule == nil then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Net"))
		end)
		netModule = ok and result or false
		if not ok then
			warn("[Router] Net module failed to load: " .. tostring(result))
		end
	end
	return netModule or nil
end

local function getRemote(container, name, className)
	local remote = container:FindFirstChild(name)
	if remote then
		return remote
	end
	remote = Instance.new(className)
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = container
	return remote
end

local function bind(remote, name, entry, limit)
	if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
		remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, ...)
			if not RateLimiter.allow(player, "RF:" .. name, limit.rate, limit.burst) then
				return nil
			end
			return invoke(name, entry, player, ...)
		end
	elseif remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
			if not RateLimiter.allow(player, "RE:" .. name, limit.rate, limit.burst) then
				return
			end
			invoke(name, entry, player, ...)
		end)
	end
	return remote
end

function Router.commF(name, handler, options)
	commF[name] = { handler = handler, options = normalise(options) }
end

function Router.commE(name, handler, options)
	commE[name] = { handler = handler, options = normalise(options) }
end

function Router.remote(name, handler, options)
	local entry = { handler = handler, options = normalise(options) }
	local container = entry.options.container or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	local remote = getRemote(container, name, entry.options.className or "RemoteEvent")
	return bind(remote, name, entry, entry.options.limit or Config.Limits.NetRF)
end

function Router.netFunction(name, handler, options)
	local Net = getNet()
	if not Net then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = { handler = handler, options = normalise(options) }
	return bind(Net:RemoteFunction(name), "N:" .. name, entry, Config.Limits.NetRF)
end

function Router.netEvent(name, handler, options)
	local Net = getNet()
	if not Net then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = { handler = handler, options = normalise(options) }
	return bind(Net:RemoteEvent(name), "N:" .. name, entry, entry.options.limit or Config.Limits.NetRE)
end

function Router.fireClient(remoteName, player, ...)
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(remoteName)
	if remote and player.Parent then
		remote:FireClient(player, ...)
	end
end

function Router.Start()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	local commFRemote = getRemote(remotes, "CommF_", "RemoteFunction")
	local commFLimit = Config.Limits.CommF_
	commFRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, command, ...)
		if type(command) ~= "string" or #command > 64 then
			return nil
		end
		if not RateLimiter.allow(player, "CommF_", commFLimit.rate, commFLimit.burst) then
			return nil
		end
		local entry = commF[command]
		if not entry then
			return nil
		end
		return invoke(command, entry, player, ...)
	end
	local commERemote = getRemote(remotes, "CommE", "RemoteEvent")
	local commELimit = Config.Limits.CommE
	commERemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command, ...)
		if type(command) ~= "string" or #command > 64 then
			return
		end
		if not RateLimiter.allow(player, "CommE", commELimit.rate, commELimit.burst) then
			return
		end
		local entry = commE[command]
		if not entry then
			return
		end
		invoke(command, entry, player, ...)
	end)
end

return Router

local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Server = script.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)
local ServerData = require(Server.ServerData)
local ServerSignals = require(ServerStorage.ServerSignals)

local TeamService = {}

function TeamService.IsValidTeam(teamName)
	return type(teamName) == "string" and Config.Teams[teamName] == true and Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName) ~= nil
end

function TeamService.Get(player)
	return player.Team and player.Team.Name or nil
end

function TeamService.GetCounts()
	local counts = {}
	for teamName in pairs(Config.Teams) do
		local team = Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName)
		counts[teamName] = team and #team:GetPlayers() or 0
	end
	return counts
end

function TeamService.AreAllies(first, second)
	return first ~= nil and second ~= nil and first.Team ~= nil and first.Team == second.Team
end

function TeamService.GetLastTeam(player)
	local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
	local last = extra and extra.Flags.LastTeam
	if TeamService.IsValidTeam(last) then
		return last
	end
	return nil
end

TeamService.RESULT_OK = 0
TeamService.RESULT_IN_COMBAT = 1
TeamService.RESULT_INVALID = 2

function TeamService.Join(player, teamName)
	if not TeamService.IsValidTeam(teamName) then
		return TeamService.RESULT_INVALID
	end
	local previous = TeamService.Get(player)
	local alive = ServerData.GetCharacterState(player) ~= nil
	local joined = false
	if alive then
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:GetAttribute("InCombat") == true then
			return TeamService.RESULT_IN_COMBAT
		end
		if previous == teamName then
			return TeamService.RESULT_OK
		end
		joined = ServerData.ChangeTeam(player, teamName)
	else
		joined = ServerData.SetTeam(player, teamName)
	end
	if not joined then
		return TeamService.RESULT_INVALID
	end
	local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
	if extra then
		extra.Flags.LastTeam = teamName
	end
	ServerSignals.Get("TeamChanged"):Fire(player, teamName, previous)
	return TeamService.RESULT_OK
end

return TeamService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Server = script.Parent.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)
local Util = require(Server.Util)

return function(Router, ServerData)
	local TeamService = require(Server.TeamService)

	local function joinTeam(player, teamName)
		if not ServerData.WaitReady(player, 20) then
			error(Router.CLIENT_ERROR .. " Player data still not ready", 0)
		end
		return TeamService.Join(player, teamName)
	end

	Router.commF("SetTeam", joinTeam, { requireData = false, rate = 1, burst = 3 })
	Router.commF("SetTeam2", joinTeam, { requireData = false, rate = 1, burst = 3 })

	Router.commF("SetLastSpawnPoint", function(player, name)
		return ServerData.SetLastSpawnPoint(player, name)
	end, { rate = 2, burst = 4 })

	Router.commF("SetSpawnPoint", function(player)
		return ServerData.SetSpawnPoint(player)
	end, { rate = 1, burst = 3 })

	Router.commF("TeleportToSpawn", function(player)
		return ServerData.TeleportToSpawn(player)
	end, { rate = 1, burst = 2 })

	Router.commF("EnablePvp", function(player)
		return ServerData.EnablePvp(player)
	end, { rate = 1, burst = 2 })

	Router.commF("AddPoint", function(player, statName, amount)
		return ServerData.AddPoint(player, statName, amount)
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("getInventory", function(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		return extra and table.clone(extra.Inventory) or {}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("GetFruits", function(player)
		local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		local items = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Items")
		local result = {}
		local seen = {}

		local function build(name)
			local entry = { Name = name, OnSale = false, Offsale = false, Rarity = 1, Price = 0, HasPermanent = true }
			local tool = items and items:FindFirstChild(name)
			local dataModule = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Data")
			if dataModule and dataModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, value = pcall(require, dataModule)
				if ok and type(value) == "table" and type(value.Lvl) == "table" and type(value.Cost) == "table" and type(value.Cooldown) == "table" and type(value.Cap) == "number" then
					entry.Data = value
				end
			end
			return entry
		end

		if extra then
			for name, count in pairs(extra.Fruits) do
				if type(count) == "number" and count > 0 and not seen[name] then
					seen[name] = true
					table.insert(result, build(name))
				end
			end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(Config.GrantedFruits) do
			if not seen[name] then
				seen[name] = true
				table.insert(result, build(name))
			end
		end
		local equipped = ServerData.Get(player, "DevilFruit")
		if type(equipped) == "string" and equipped ~= "" and not seen[equipped] then
			seen[equipped] = true
			table.insert(result, build(equipped))
		end
		return result
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.remote("GetSetting", function(player, name, prop)
		return ServerData.GetSetting(player, name, prop)
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.remote("ChangeSetting", function(player, name, value)
		ServerData.ChangeSetting(player, name, value)
	end, { rate = 5, burst = 10 })

	Router.remote("Location", function(player, region)
		local tag = player:FindFirstChild("LocationTag")
		if not tag or not tag:IsA("ObjectValue") then
			return
		end
		if region == nil then
			tag.Value = nil
			player:SetAttribute("CurrentLocation", "")
			player:SetAttribute("ExactLocation", "")
			return
		end
		if typeof(region) ~= "Instance" or not region:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
		local regions = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("EnemyRegions")
		if not regions or region.Parent ~= regions then
			return
		end
		local root = Util.getRoot(player)
		if not root then
			return
		end
		local mesh = region:FindFirstChild("Mesh")
		local radius = region.Size.X / 2
		if mesh and mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
			radius = region.Size.X * mesh.Scale.X / 2
		end
		if (root.Position - region.Position).Magnitude > radius + 100 then
			return
		end
		tag.Value = region
		player:SetAttribute("CurrentLocation", region.Name)
		player:SetAttribute("ExactLocation", region:GetAttribute("ExactLocation") or region.Name)
	end, { rate = 2, burst = 4 })

	Router.commE("Dodge", function(player, _, cost, _, stamp)
		local state = ServerData.GetCharacterState(player)
		if not state or not Util.isAlive(player) then
			return
		end
		if state.busy.Value or state.stun.Value > 0 then
			return
		end
		if not Util.isNumber(cost) or not Util.isNumber(stamp) then
			return
		end
		if math.abs(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - stamp) > 5 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastDodge < Config.DodgeCooldown then
			return
		end
		cost = Util.clamp(cost, Config.DodgeCostMin, Config.DodgeCostMax)
		if ServerData.SpendEnergy(player, cost) then
			state.lastDodge = now
		end
	end)

	Router.commE("DoubleJump", function(player)
		local state = ServerData.GetCharacterState(player)
		if not state or not Util.isAlive(player) then
			return
		end
		if state.busy.Value or state.stun.Value > 0 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastJump < Config.DoubleJumpCooldown then
			return
		end
		local race = ServerData.GetValueObject(player, "Race")
		local evolved = race ~= nil and race:FindFirstChild("Evolved") ~= nil
		local cost = evolved and Config.DoubleJumpCostEvolved or Config.DoubleJumpCost
		if ServerData.SpendEnergy(player, cost) then
			state.lastJump = now
		end
	end)

	Router.commF("getFish", function(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		return extra and table.clone(extra.Fish) or {}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("getTitles", function(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		local result = {}
		if extra then
			for name, owned in pairs(extra.Titles) do
				if owned then
					table.insert(result, { Name = name })
				end
			end
			table.sort(result, function(a, b)
				return a.Name < b.Name
			end)
		end
		return result
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("GetUnlockables", function(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		return extra and table.clone(extra.Unlockables) or {}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	local fruitDataCache = nil

	Router.remote("GetFruitData", function(player)
		if fruitDataCache then
			return fruitDataCache
		end
		local items = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Items")
		if not items then
			error("bad folder")
		end
		local TableUtil = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("TableUtil"))
		local result = {}
		for _, tool in ipairs(items:GetChildren()) do
			if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" then
				local dataModule = tool:FindFirstChild("Data")
				if dataModule and dataModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					local data = TableUtil.deepCopy(require(dataModule))
					TableUtil.deepFreeze(data)
					result[tool.Name] = data
				end
			end
		end
		table.freeze(result)
		fruitDataCache = result
		return result
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", requireData = false, rate = 2, burst = 4 })
end

local Server = script.Parent.Parent
local Util = require(Server.Util)

return function(Router, ServerData)
	local function register(name, defaults)
		Router.commF(name, function(player, action)
			if action ~= nil then
				return false
			end
			local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
			local progress = Util.deepCopy(defaults)
			local saved = extra and extra.Quest[name]
			if type(saved) == "table" then
				progress = Util.reconcile(Util.deepCopy(saved), progress)
			end
			return progress
		end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })
	end

	register("ProQuestProgress", {
		UsedTorch = false,
		UsedCup = false,
		TalkedSon = false,
		KilledMob = false,
		UsedRelic = false,
		KilledShanks = false,
		Plates = {},
	})

	register("TushitaProgress", { OpenedDoor = false, Torches = {} })
	register("CDKQuest", { Good = 0, Evil = 0, Opened = false, Finished = false })
	register("BartiloQuestProgress", { DidPlates = false, KilledBandits = false, KilledSpring = false })
	register("CitizenQuestProgress", { FoundTreasure = false, KilledBandits = false, KilledBoss = false })
	register("DressrosaQuestProgress", { KilledIceBoss = false, TalkedDetective = false, UsedKey = false })
	register("RaidsNpc", { Dough = false, Phoenix = false })
	register("Cousin", { Done = false, Granted = false, Text = {} })
	register("Awakener", { Key = "", Cost = 0 })

	Router.commF("TempleClock", function(player)
		local race = ServerData.Get(player, "Race")
		return {
			HadPoint = false,
			Race = type(race) == "string" and race or "Human",
			RaceDetails = { Gears = {} },
			RaceLevel = 0,
		}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("getAwakenedAbilities", function()
		return {}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("getTradeInventory", function()
		return { Items = {} }
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })

	Router.commF("getEquipmentForFruit", function(player, fruitName)
		local equipped = ServerData.Get(player, "DevilFruit")
		return {
			Description = "",
			Equipment = {},
			Mastery = 0,
			IsFruitAccessible = type(fruitName) == "string" and equipped == fruitName,
			IsFruitEquipped = type(fruitName) == "string" and equipped == fruitName,
		}
	end, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local starterpack = game:GetService("StarterPack")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local istransformed = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("IsTransformed"))

local studiobeli = 50000000
local fallbackprices = {
	["Empyrean (Kitsune)-Empyrean (Kitsune)"] = 12000000,
	["Dragon-Dragon"] = 15000000,
}
local startingitems = { "Triple Dark Blade" }

return function(Router, ServerData)
	local itemconfig = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemConfig"))
	local itemreplication = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemReplicationService"))
	local legacybeli = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Shop"):WaitForChild("LEGACY_BELI_ITEMS"))
	local keys = itemreplication.KEYS

	local itemsfolder = serverstorage:WaitForChild("Items")
	local accessoriesfolder = serverstorage:WaitForChild("Accessories")
	local commevent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("CommE")

	local fruits = {}
	local fruitbykey = {}
	local accessories = {}
	local accessorybykey = {}
	local weaponbykey = {}

	local function config(id)
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return itemconfig.match(id):unwrap()
		end)
		return ok and result or nil
	end

	local function normalize(name)
		return (string.lower(name):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
	end

	for _, tool in ipairs(itemsfolder:GetChildren()) do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") then
			local cfg = config(tool:GetAttribute("ItemId"))
			if tool.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" and cfg then
				local physical = cfg.Moveset and cfg.Moveset.Physical
				local physicalcfg = physical and config(physical)
				local entry = {
					tool = tool.Name,
					key = cfg.Index.StorageKey,
					physicalid = physicalcfg and physicalcfg.Index.ItemId or cfg.Index.ItemId,
					physicalkey = physicalcfg and physicalcfg.Index.StorageKey or cfg.Index.StorageKey,
					rarity = cfg.Quality and cfg.Quality.RarityValue or 0,
				}
				local legacy = legacybeli[tool.Name] or legacybeli[entry.key]
				entry.price = (legacy and legacy.Price) or fallbackprices[tool.Name] or 1000000
				table.insert(fruits, entry)
				fruitbykey[tool.Name] = entry
				fruitbykey[entry.key] = entry
				fruitbykey[entry.physicalkey] = entry
			elseif cfg then
				local entry = { tool = tool.Name, key = cfg.Index.StorageKey, id = cfg.Index.ItemId }
				weaponbykey[tool.Name] = entry
				weaponbykey[entry.key] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	local registry = {}
	for id in pairs(require(replicatedstorage.Economy.ItemId)._IDS:unwrap()) do
		local cfg = config(id)
		if cfg and cfg.Index.IdType == "Accessory" then
			registry[normalize(cfg.Index.StorageKey)] = cfg.Index
		end
	end
	for _, model in ipairs(accessoriesfolder:GetChildren()) do
		if model:IsA("Accessory") then
			local index = registry[normalize(model.Name)]
			if index then
				local entry = { model = model.Name, key = index.StorageKey, id = index.ItemId }
				table.insert(accessories, entry)
				accessorybykey[model.Name] = entry
				accessorybykey[index.StorageKey] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	local function profileof(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		if not extra then
			return nil
		end
		if type(extra.Shop) ~= "table" then
			extra.Shop = { quantity = {}, accessory = nil, fruit = nil, weapons = {}, granted = false }
		end
		extra.Shop.quantity = extra.Shop.quantity or {}
		extra.Shop.weapons = extra.Shop.weapons or {}
		return extra.Shop, extra
	end

	local function replicate(player, key, id, value)
		pcall(function()
			itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, key, id, nil, value)
		end)
	end

	local function quantity(player, id)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		return profile and profile.quantity[tostring(id)] or 0
	end

	local function setquantity(player, id, amount)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		profile.quantity[tostring(id)] = amount > 0 and amount or nil
		replicate(player, keys.QUANTITY, id, amount > 0 and amount or nil)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_OWNED, id, amount > 0 or nil)
	end

	local function setequipped(player, id, equipped)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_EQUIPPED, id, equipped or nil)
	end

	local function notifychanged(player)
		pcall(function()
			commevent:FireClient(player, "ItemChanged")
		end)
	end

	local function findtool(player, name)
		local character = player.Character
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		return (character and character:FindFirstChild(name)) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
	end

	local function sourcetool(name)
		local fromstarter = starterpack:FindFirstChild(name)
		if fromstarter and fromstarter:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			return fromstarter
		end
		return itemsfolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	end

	local function givetool(player, name)
		if findtool(player, name) then
			return true
		end
		local source = sourcetool(name)
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if not source or not backpack then
			return false
		end
		source:Clone().Parent = backpack
		return true
	end

	local function removetool(player, name)
		local tool = findtool(player, name)
		if not tool then
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and tool.Parent == character then
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
		end
		tool:SetAttribute("ending", true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		if tool.Parent then
			tool:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function wearaccessory(player)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not profile or not humanoid then
			return
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Accessory") and child:GetAttribute("inventoryaccessory") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local entry = profile.accessory and accessorybykey[profile.accessory]
		local model = entry and accessoriesfolder:FindFirstChild(entry.model)
		if model then
			local clone = model:Clone()
			clone:SetAttribute("inventoryaccessory", true)
			humanoid:AddAccessory(clone)
		end
	end

	local function equipaccessory(player, entry)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local previous = profile.accessory and accessorybykey[profile.accessory]
		if previous then
			setequipped(player, previous.id, false)
		end
		profile.accessory = entry and entry.key or nil
		if entry then
			setequipped(player, entry.id, true)
		end
		wearaccessory(player)
		return true
	end

	local function removefruittools(player, except)
		for _, entry in ipairs(fruits) do
			if entry.tool ~= except then
				removetool(player, entry.tool)
			end
		end
	end

	local function equipfruit(player, entry)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local previous = profile.fruit and fruitbykey[profile.fruit]
		if previous and previous ~= entry then
			setequipped(player, previous.physicalid, false)
		end
		removefruittools(player, entry.tool)
		profile.fruit = entry.tool
		givetool(player, entry.tool)
		setequipped(player, entry.physicalid, true)
		ServerData.Set(player, "DevilFruit", entry.tool)
	end

	local function syncplayer(player)
		local profile, extra = profileof(player)
		if not profile then
			return
		end
		if not profile.granted then
			profile.granted = true
			if runservice:IsStudio() then
				local beli = ServerData.Get(player, "Beli") or 0
				ServerData.Set(player, "Beli", math.max(beli, studiobeli))
			end
		end
		if runservice:IsStudio() then
			for _, entry in ipairs(fruits) do
				if quantity(player, entry.physicalid) <= 0 then
					setquantity(player, entry.physicalid, 1)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(accessories) do
			if quantity(player, entry.id) <= 0 then
				profile.quantity[tostring(entry.id)] = 1
			end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(startingitems) do
			local entry = weaponbykey[name]
			if entry and quantity(player, entry.id) <= 0 then
				profile.quantity[tostring(entry.id)] = 1
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(fruits) do
			local count = quantity(player, entry.physicalid)
			extra.Fruits[entry.tool] = count > 0 and count or nil
		end
		for id, amount in pairs(profile.quantity) do
			replicate(player, keys.QUANTITY, tonumber(id), amount)
			replicate(player, keys.IS_OWNED, tonumber(id), true)
		end
		local accessory = profile.accessory and accessorybykey[profile.accessory]
		if accessory then
			setequipped(player, accessory.id, true)
		end
		local fruit = profile.fruit and fruitbykey[profile.fruit]
		if fruit then
			setequipped(player, fruit.physicalid, true)
		end
		for name in pairs(profile.weapons) do
			local entry = weaponbykey[name]
			if entry then
				setequipped(player, entry.id, true)
			end
		end
	end

	local function restorecharacter(player, character)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		if not profile or player.Character ~= character then
			return
		end
		wearaccessory(player)
		if profile.fruit then
			removefruittools(player, profile.fruit)
			givetool(player, profile.fruit)
		end
		for name in pairs(profile.weapons) do
			givetool(player, name)
		end
	end

	local function onplayer(player)
		if not ServerData.WaitReady(player, 60) then
			return
		end
		syncplayer(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character:WaitForChild("CharacterReady", 30)
			restorecharacter(player, character)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			restorecharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
	end

	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onplayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onplayer, player)
	end

	local function loaditem(player, name)
		local accessory = accessorybykey[name]
		if accessory then
			if quantity(player, accessory.id) <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			return equipaccessory(player, accessory)
		end
		local weapon = weaponbykey[name]
		if weapon then
			if quantity(player, weapon.id) <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			profileof(player).weapons[weapon.tool] = true
			givetool(player, weapon.tool)
			setequipped(player, weapon.id, true)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function storeitem(player, name)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local accessory = accessorybykey[name]
		if accessory then
			if profile.accessory == accessory.key then
				equipaccessory(player, nil)
			end
			return true
		end
		local weapon = weaponbykey[name]
		if weapon then
			profile.weapons[weapon.tool] = nil
			removetool(player, weapon.tool)
			setequipped(player, weapon.id, false)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function setdragontype(player, kind)
		if kind ~= "East" and kind ~= "West" then
			return
		end
		local profile = profileof(player)
		if profile then
			profile.dragontype = kind
		end
		local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local fruit = data and data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
		if fruit then
			fruit:SetAttribute("DragonType", kind)
		end
	end

	local function getdragontype(player)
		local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local fruit = data and data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
		local kind = fruit and fruit:GetAttribute("DragonType")
		if kind ~= "East" and kind ~= "West" then
			local profile = profileof(player)
			kind = profile and profile.dragontype
		end
		if kind ~= "East" and kind ~= "West" then
			local tool = itemsfolder:FindFirstChild("Dragon-Dragon")
			kind = tool and tool:GetAttribute("DragonType") or "West"
		end
		return kind
	end

	local function loadfruit(player, name, dragontype)
		if istransformed(player.Character, true, true) then
			return false, "You can’t switch fruits while transformed."
		end
		local entry = type(name) == "string" and (fruitbykey[name] or fruitbykey[(name:gsub("Permanent ", ""))])
		if not entry or quantity(player, entry.physicalid) <= 0 then
			return false, "You don't own this fruit."
		end
		if entry.tool == "Dragon-Dragon" then
			setdragontype(player, dragontype or getdragontype(player))
		end
		equipfruit(player, entry)
		notifychanged(player)
		return true
	end

	local function storefruit(player)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local entry = profile.fruit and fruitbykey[profile.fruit]
		if not entry then
			return false
		end
		removetool(player, entry.tool)
		setequipped(player, entry.physicalid, false)
		profile.fruit = nil
		ServerData.Set(player, "DevilFruit", "")
		notifychanged(player)
		return true
	end

	local function addfruit(player, entry)
		local _, extra = profileof(player)
		local count = quantity(player, entry.physicalid) + 1
		setquantity(player, entry.physicalid, count)
		extra.Fruits[entry.tool] = count
		notifychanged(player)
	end

	local function getfruits(player)
		local list = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(fruits) do
			table.insert(list, {
				Name = entry.tool == "Dragon-Dragon" and entry.tool or entry.key,
				OnSale = true,
				Offsale = false,
				Rarity = entry.rarity,
				Price = entry.price,
				HasPermanent = quantity(player, entry.physicalid) > 0,
			})
		end
		return list
	end

	local function purchasefruit(player, name, _, dragontype)
		local entry = type(name) == "string" and fruitbykey[name]
		if not entry then
			return false
		end
		if entry.tool == "Dragon-Dragon" then
			setdragontype(player, dragontype)
		end
		local beli = ServerData.Get(player, "Beli") or 0
		if beli < entry.price then
			ServerData.Notify(player, "Not enough money.")
			return false
		end
		ServerData.Set(player, "Beli", beli - entry.price)
		addfruit(player, entry)
		ServerData.Notify(player, "Purchased " .. entry.tool .. "! Open your inventory to equip it.")
		return true
	end

	local function buyitem(player, name)
		local legacy = type(name) == "string" and legacybeli[name]
		local accessory = accessorybykey[name]
		local weapon = weaponbykey[name]
		local id = (accessory and accessory.id) or (weapon and weapon.id)
		if not legacy or not legacy.Price or not id then
			return 0
		end
		if quantity(player, id) > 0 then
			return 2
		end
		if legacy.LevelReq and (ServerData.Get(player, "Level") or 1) < legacy.LevelReq then
			return 3
		end
		local beli = ServerData.Get(player, "Beli") or 0
		if beli < legacy.Price then
			return 0
		end
		ServerData.Set(player, "Beli", beli - legacy.Price)
		setquantity(player, id, 1)
		notifychanged(player)
		return 1
	end

	local function buyrobuxshop(player, info)
		local name = type(info) == "table" and info.StorageName or info
		local entry = type(name) == "string" and (fruitbykey[name] or fruitbykey[(name:gsub("Permanent ", ""))])
		if not entry then
			ServerData.Notify(player, "This item isn't available.")
			return false
		end
		if quantity(player, entry.physicalid) <= 0 then
			addfruit(player, entry)
		end
		return true
	end

	local options = { rate = 6, burst = 12 }
	Router.commF("LoadItem", loaditem, options)
	Router.commF("StoreItem", storeitem, options)
	Router.commF("LoadFruit", loadfruit, options)
	Router.commF("SwitchFruit", loadfruit, options)
	Router.commF("StoreFruit", storefruit, options)
	Router.commF("GetFruits", getfruits, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })
	Router.commF("DragonType", getdragontype, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })
	Router.commF("PurchaseRawFruit", purchasefruit, options)
	Router.commF("BuyItem", buyitem, options)
	Router.commF("buyRobuxShop", buyrobuxshop, options)
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local tweenservice = game:GetService("TweenService")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local appearance = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Definitions"):WaitForChild("Skin"):WaitForChild("Appearance"))
local aurastats = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("aurastats"))

local prices = { Geppo = 10000, Buso = 25000, Soru = 100000 }
local limbs = { "LeftHand", "LeftLowerArm", "RightHand", "RightLowerArm" }
local layerpadding = { BusoLayer1 = 0.04, BusoLayer2 = 0.08 }
local layertransparency = { BusoLayer1 = 0, BusoLayer2 = 0.7 }
local togglecooldown = 0.5
local fadetime = 0.25
local defaultcolor = Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
local pulsetime = 1.6

return function(Router, ServerData)
	local meshes = serverstorage:WaitForChild("BushMeshes")
	local lasttoggle = {}

	local function abilities(player)
		local extra = ServerData.GetExtra(player)
		if not extra then
			return nil
		end
		if type(extra.Abilities) ~= "table" then
			extra.Abilities = {}
		end
		return extra.Abilities
	end

	local function tagcharacter(player, character)
		local owned = abilities(player)
		if not owned or not character then
			return
		end
		for name in pairs(prices) do
			if owned[name] then
				character:AddTag(name)
			end
		end
	end

	local function busoof(character)
		return character and character:FindFirstChild("HasBuso")
	end

	local function auracolors(player)
		local id = player:GetAttribute("auraskin")
		if type(id) == "number" and id > 0 then
			local ok, set = pcall(function()
				return appearance.match(id):asNullable()
			end)
			if ok and set and set.Type == "ColorSet" and set.Color3 then
				return set.Color3, set.FadeColor3
			end
		end
		return defaultcolor, nil
	end

	local function busocolorvalue(player, color, fade)
		local value = player:FindFirstChild("BusoColor")
		if not value then
			value = Instance.new("Color3Value")
			value.Name = "BusoColor"
			value.Parent = player
		end
		value.Value = color
		value:SetAttribute("FadeTo", fade)
	end

	local function paint(player, folder)
		local color, fade = auracolors(player)
		busocolorvalue(player, color, fade)
		for _, mesh in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if mesh:IsA("BasePart") then
				local pulse = mesh:FindFirstChild("aurapulse")
				if pulse then
					pulse:Destroy()
				end
				mesh.Color = color
				mesh:SetAttribute("Colored", color)
				mesh:SetAttribute("FadeTo", fade)
				if fade then
					local marker = Instance.new("Configuration")
					marker.Name = "aurapulse"
					marker.Parent = mesh
					local tween = tweenservice:Create(mesh, TweenInfo.new(pulsetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Color = fade })
					marker.Destroying:Once(function()
						tween:Cancel()
					end)
					tween:Play()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function removebuso(character)
		local folder = busoof(character)
		if folder then
			folder:Destroy()
		end
		character:SetAttribute("BusoEnabled", false)
	character:SetAttribute("BusoStage", nil)
	end

	local function addbuso(player, character)
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "HasBuso"
		for _, limbname in ipairs(limbs) do
			local limb = character:FindFirstChild(limbname)
			if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
				for layer, padding in pairs(layerpadding) do
					local template = meshes:FindFirstChild(limbname .. "_" .. layer)
					if template then
						local mesh = template:Clone()
						local target = layertransparency[layer]
						mesh.Name = limbname .. "_" .. layer
						mesh.Anchored = false
						mesh.CanCollide = false
						mesh.CanQuery = false
						mesh.CanTouch = false
						mesh.Massless = true
						mesh.CastShadow = false
						mesh.Size = limb.Size + Vector3.one * padding
						mesh.CFrame = limb.CFrame
						mesh.Transparency = 1
						local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
						weld.Part0 = limb
						weld.Part1 = mesh
						weld.C0 = CFrame.identity
						weld.Parent = mesh
						mesh.Parent = folder
						tweenservice:Create(mesh, TweenInfo.new(fadetime), { Transparency = target }):Play()
					end
				end
			end
		end
		paint(player, folder)
		folder.Parent = character
		character:SetAttribute("BusoEnabled", true)
	local stage = aurastats.stage(player)
	player:SetAttribute("BusoStage", stage)
	character:SetAttribute("BusoStage", stage)
	end

	local function togglebuso(player)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not character:HasTag("Buso") then
			return false
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lasttoggle[player] or 0) < togglecooldown then
			return busoof(character) ~= nil
		end
		lasttoggle[player] = now
		if busoof(character) then
			removebuso(character)
			return false
		end
		addbuso(player, character)
		return true
	end

	local function buyhaki(player, name)
		local price = type(name) == "string" and prices[name]
		local owned = abilities(player)
		if not price or not owned then
			return 0
		end
		if owned[name] then
			return 2
		end
		local beli = ServerData.Get(player, "Beli") or 0
		if beli < price then
			return 0
		end
		ServerData.Set(player, "Beli", beli - price)
		owned[name] = true
		if player.Character then
			player.Character:AddTag(name)
		end
		return 1
	end

	local function onplayer(player)
		if not ServerData.WaitReady(player, 60) then
			return
		end
		local owned = abilities(player)
		local stage = aurastats.stage(player)
		player:SetAttribute("BusoStage", stage)
		if owned and runservice:IsStudio() then
			owned.Buso = true
		end
		local color, fade = auracolors(player)
		busocolorvalue(player, color, fade)
		player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("auraskin"):Connect(function()
			local folder = busoof(player.Character)
			if folder then
				paint(player, folder)
			else
				local newcolor, newfade = auracolors(player)
				busocolorvalue(player, newcolor, newfade)
			end
		end)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character:WaitForChild("CharacterReady", 30)
			tagcharacter(player, character)
			local currentstage = aurastats.stage(player)
			player:SetAttribute("BusoStage", currentstage)
			character:SetAttribute("BusoStage", currentstage)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			tagcharacter(player, player.Character)
			player.Character:SetAttribute("BusoStage", stage)
		end
	end

	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onplayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onplayer, player)
	end
	players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lasttoggle[player] = nil
	end)

	Router.commF("Buso", togglebuso, { rate = 4, burst = 6 })
	Router.commF("BuyHaki", buyhaki, { rate = 2, burst = 4 })
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local textchatservice = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local function allowed(player)
	if runservice:IsStudio() then
		return true
	end
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User and player.UserId == game.CreatorId then
		return true
	end
	return game.PrivateServerOwnerId ~= 0 and player.UserId == game.PrivateServerOwnerId
end

local function maxrage(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	local rage = character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
	if not rage then
		rage = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		rage.Name = "Rage"
		rage.Parent = character
	end
	rage.Value = 100
	local armfunctions = character:FindFirstChild("MagnetArmFunctions")
	if armfunctions then
		armfunctions:SetAttribute("CurrentTier", 3)
	end
	return true
end

return function(_, ServerData)
	local folder = textchatservice:FindFirstChild("TextChatCommands")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "TextChatCommands"
		folder.Parent = textchatservice
	end
	local command = folder:FindFirstChild("ragecommand")
	if not command then
		command = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
		command.Name = "ragecommand"
		command.PrimaryAlias = "/rage"
		command.Parent = folder
	end
	command.Triggered:Connect(function(source)
		local player = source and players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if not player or not allowed(player) then
			return
		end
		if maxrage(player) then
			ServerData.Notify(player, "Rage set to max.")
		end
	end)
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local server = script.Parent.Parent
local config = require(server.Config)
local quests = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Quests"))
local questupdate = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("QuestUpdate")
local effectmodule = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Effect"))
local activequests = {}
local serverdata
local util

local function commas(amount)
	local text = tostring(math.floor(amount))
	local formatted = text:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	return (formatted:gsub("^,", ""))
end

local function requiredexp(level)
	return math.ceil(2 * level ^ 2.3 + 84)
end

local function awardexp(player, amount)
	local level = serverdata.Get(player, "Level")
	local exp = serverdata.Get(player, "Exp")
	if type(level) ~= "number" or type(exp) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	local previouslevel = level
	local awarded = math.max(0, math.floor(amount))
	exp += awarded
	local points = serverdata.Get(player, "Points") or 0
	while level < config.MaxLevel do
		local needed = requiredexp(level)
		if exp < needed then
			break
		end
		exp -= needed
		level += 1
		points += config.PointsPerLevel
	end
	serverdata.Set(player, "Exp", exp)
	if level ~= previouslevel then
		serverdata.Set(player, "Level", level)
		serverdata.Set(player, "Points", points)
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Green>LEVEL UP!<Color=/> (" .. tostring(level) .. ")")
		pcall(serverdata.RefreshCharacter, player)
		local restoreonlevel = player.Character
		local restorehumanoid = restoreonlevel and restoreonlevel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if restorehumanoid and restorehumanoid.Health > 0 and restoreonlevel:GetAttribute("InCombat") ~= true then
			restorehumanoid.Health = restorehumanoid.MaxHealth
			local energy = restoreonlevel:FindFirstChild("Energy")
			if energy then
				energy.Value = energy.MaxValue
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			require(replicatedstorage.Util.LevelCap).replicateLevelCap(player)
		end)
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			pcall(function()
				effectmodule.new("LevelUp"):replicate({ { Character = character } })
			end)
		end
	end
	return awarded
end

local function award(player, exp, beli)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or not serverdata.IsReady(player) then
		return
	end
	if type(beli) == "number" and beli >= 1 then
		serverdata.Increment(player, "Beli", math.floor(beli))
		serverdata.Notify(player, "Earned <Color=Green>$" .. commas(beli) .. "<Color=/>")
	end
	if type(exp) == "number" and exp >= 1 then
		local awarded = awardexp(player, exp)
		if awarded > 0 then
			serverdata.Notify(player, "Earned <Color=Cyan>" .. commas(awarded) .. " Exp.<Color=/>")
		end
	end
end

local function sendstate(player, state, context)
	questupdate:FireClient(player, state, context)
end

local function makepayload(state)
	return {
		InternalQuestName = state.questname,
		Info = {
			Job = true,
			Name = state.definition.Name,
			Task = state.definition.Task,
		},
		Progress = {
			[state.target] = state.killed,
		},
		Reward = state.definition.Reward,
		Target = state.target,
		Killed = state.killed,
		Required = state.required,
		RewardExp = state.definition.Reward.Exp or 0,
		RewardBeli = state.definition.Reward.Beli or 0,
	}
end

local function startquest(player, questname, questindex)
	if type(questname) ~= "string" or not util.isInteger(questindex) then
		return 1
	end
	local group = quests[questname]
	local definition = group and group[questindex]
	if not definition then
		return 1
	end
	local level = serverdata.Get(player, "Level") or 1
	if level < (definition.LevelReq or 0) then
		return definition.LevelReq
	end
	local target, required = next(definition.Task)
	if type(target) ~= "string" or type(required) ~= "number" or required < 1 then
		return 1
	end
	local state = {
		questname = questname,
		questindex = questindex,
		definition = definition,
		target = target,
		required = required,
		killed = 0,
	}
	activequests[player] = state
	sendstate(player, makepayload(state), { Context = "Start", InternalQuestName = questname, Name = definition.Name })
	return 0
end

local function abandonquest(player)
	local state = activequests[player]
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	activequests[player] = nil
	sendstate(player, nil, { Context = "Abandon", InternalQuestName = state.questname, Name = state.definition.Name })
	return true
end

local function onenemykilled(killer, model, enemyname, level)
	if not killer or not killer:IsA("Player") or not serverdata.IsReady(killer) then
		return
	end
	local isboss = model and model:GetAttribute("IsBoss") == true
	local multiplier = isboss and 4 or 1
	local rewardexp = model and model:GetAttribute("RewardExp")
	local rewardbeli = model and model:GetAttribute("RewardBeli")
	rewardexp = type(rewardexp) == "number" and rewardexp or math.max(10, math.floor((level or 1) * 8))
	rewardbeli = type(rewardbeli) == "number" and rewardbeli or math.max(5, math.floor((level or 1) * 8))
	award(killer, rewardexp * multiplier, rewardbeli * multiplier)

	local state = activequests[killer]
	if not state or state.target ~= enemyname then
		return
	end
	state.killed += 1
	if state.killed >= state.required then
		activequests[killer] = nil
		local reward = state.definition.Reward
		award(killer, reward.Exp or 0, reward.Beli or 0)
		local payload = makepayload(state)
		payload.Killed = state.required
		payload.Completed = true
		sendstate(killer, payload, {
			Context = "Complete",
			InternalQuestName = state.questname,
			Name = state.definition.Name,
		})
		return
	end
	sendstate(killer, makepayload(state), { Context = "Update", InternalQuestName = state.questname, Name = state.definition.Name })
end

return function(router, data)
	serverdata = data
	util = require(server.Util)
	router.commF("StartQuest", startquest, { rate = 2, burst = 4 })
	router.commF("AbandonQuest", abandonquest, { rate = 2, burst = 4 })
	local events = serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitboxevents", 30)
	local enemykilled = events and events:WaitForChild("enemykilled", 30)
	if enemykilled and enemykilled:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		enemykilled.Event:Connect(onenemykilled)
	end
	players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		activequests[player] = nil
	end)
end

local function register(router, serverdata)
	local function statefor(player)
		local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
		if not extra then
			return nil, nil
		end
		extra.BonusMoments = type(extra.BonusMoments) == "table" and extra.BonusMoments or {}
		local moments = extra.BonusMoments
		moments.EarlyAccessStage = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(moments.EarlyAccessStage) or 0), 0, 5)
		local available = moments.EarlyAccessAvailable == true or player:GetAttribute("EarlyAccessAvailable") == true
		return moments, available
	end

	router.netFunction("BonusMomentsGuide", function(player, action)
		local moments, available = statefor(player)
		local stage = moments and moments.EarlyAccessStage or 0
		if action == "GetState" then
			return stage
		end
		if action == "IsAvailable" then
			return available == true
		end
		if action == "GetRewardTracker" then
			return nil
		end
		if action == "InteractQuestGiver" then
			if not available then
				return "Unavailable", stage
			end
			if stage == 0 then
				return "Intro", stage
			end
			if stage == 4 then
				return "Reward", stage
			end
			if stage >= 5 then
				return "Completed", stage
			end
			return "Reminder", stage
		end
		if not moments or not available then
			return "Denied", stage
		end
		if action == "AcceptQuest" and stage == 0 then
			moments.EarlyAccessStage = 1
			return "Accepted", 1
		end
		if action == "CollectKey" and stage == 1 then
			moments.EarlyAccessStage = 2
			return "Collected", 2
		end
		if action == "InteractMansionDoor" then
			if stage == 2 then
				moments.EarlyAccessStage = 3
				return "Infiltration", 3
			end
			return "Locked", stage
		end
		if action == "FinishInfiltration" and stage == 3 then
			moments.EarlyAccessStage = 4
			return "Finished", 4
		end
		if action == "ClaimReward" and stage == 4 then
			moments.EarlyAccessStage = 5
			return "Completed", 5
		end
		if action == "InteractTesterDoor" then
			return stage >= 5 and "QuestGiver" or "Denied", stage
		end
		return nil
	end, { requireData = false, rate = 8, burst = 16 })
end

return register
