local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local function register(router)
	local itemconfig = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemConfig"))
	local itemreplication = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemReplicationService"))
	local modification = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("Modification"))
	local keys = itemreplication.KEYS

	router.netFunction("ModificationFunction", function(player, request)
		if type(request) ~= "table" or request.Type ~= "SetEquip" then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "Invalid request." }
		end
		local itemid = request.ItemId
		if type(itemid) ~= "number" or itemid % 1 ~= 0 then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "Invalid item." }
		end
		local ok, item = pcall(function()
			return itemconfig.match(itemid):unwrap()
		end)
		if not ok or not item then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "Invalid item." }
		end
		local isskin = item.Index.IdType == "Skin"
		local ismutation = item.Index.IdType == "Mutation"
		if not isskin and not ismutation then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "This item cannot be equipped here." }
		end
		local owned = itemreplication:ReadItem(player, keys.IS_OWNED, itemid, nil)
		if owned ~= true then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "You do not own this modification." }
		end
		local adorneeid
		if isskin then
			adorneeid = item.Skin and item.Skin.Adornee
		else
			adorneeid = item.Mutation and item.Mutation.Adornee
		end
		if type(adorneeid) ~= "number" or itemreplication:ReadItem(player, keys.IS_EQUIPPED, adorneeid, nil) ~= true then
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "Equip the matching fruit first." }
		end
		local modificationkey = isskin and keys.EQUIPPED_SKIN or keys.PREFERRED_MUTATION
		if request.IsEquipped == true then
			itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, modificationkey, adorneeid, nil, itemid)
		elseif request.IsEquipped == false then
			local current = itemreplication:ReadItem(player, modificationkey, adorneeid, nil)
			if current == itemid then
				itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, modificationkey, adorneeid, nil, nil)
			end
		else
			return { Type = "Error", Message = "Invalid equip state." }
		end
		return { Type = "GetData", Data = modification.Data.Modification.fromItemReplication(player) }
	end, { rate = 8, burst = 16 })
end

return register

local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

return function(router, serverdata)
	local itemconfig = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemConfig"))
	local itemreplication = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemReplicationService"))
	local effectmodule = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Effect"))
	local keys = itemreplication.KEYS
	local random = Random.new()

	local function grant(player, itemid)
		if not serverdata.IsReady(player) then
			return false
		end
		local ok, item = pcall(function()
			return itemconfig.match(itemid):unwrap()
		end)
		if not ok or not item then
			return false
		end
		local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
		if not extra then
			return false
		end
		extra.Shop = type(extra.Shop) == "table" and extra.Shop or { quantity = {}, weapons = {} }
		extra.Shop.quantity = type(extra.Shop.quantity) == "table" and extra.Shop.quantity or {}
		local amount = (tonumber(extra.Shop.quantity[tostring(itemid)]) or 0) + 1
		extra.Shop.quantity[tostring(itemid)] = amount
		itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, keys.QUANTITY, itemid, nil, amount)
		itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, keys.IS_OWNED, itemid, nil, true)
		serverdata.Notify(player, "Received " .. item.Index.StorageKey .. ".")
		local character = player.Character
		if character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			pcall(function()
				effectmodule.new("itemreward"):replicate({ { Character = character, ItemId = itemid, ItemName = item.Index.StorageKey } })
			end)
		end
		local commevent = replicatedstorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") and replicatedstorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
		if commevent then
			commevent:FireClient(player, "ItemChanged")
		end
		return true
	end

	local events = serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitboxevents", 30)
	local enemykilled = events and events:WaitForChild("enemydropeligible", 30)
	if enemykilled and enemykilled:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		enemykilled.Event:Connect(function(player, model)
			if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
				return
			end
			local itemid = model:GetAttribute("DropItemId")
			local chance = model:GetAttribute("DropChance")
			if type(itemid) ~= "number" or type(chance) ~= "number" or chance <= 0 then
				return
			end
			if random:NextNumber() <= math.clamp(chance, 0, 1) then
				grant(player, itemid)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local zonecache = {}
local zonestamp = 0

local function commevent()
	local remotes = replicatedstorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	return remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CommE")
end

local function zones()
	if os.clock() - zonestamp < 5 then
		return zonecache
	end
	zonestamp = os.clock()
	table.clear(zonecache)
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	local folder = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("SafeZones")
	if not folder then
		return zonecache
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
			local radius = mesh and mesh.Scale.X / 2 or math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2
			table.insert(zonecache, { position = part.Position, radius = radius })
		end
	end
	return zonecache
end

local function insafezone(position)
	for _, zone in ipairs(zones()) do
		if (position - zone.position).Magnitude <= zone.radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function updatezone(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local inside = root ~= nil and insafezone(root.Position)
	if player:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") ~= inside then
		player:SetAttribute("InSafeZone", inside)
		local remote = commevent()
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, "SafeZone")
		end
	end
	if character and character:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") ~= inside then
		character:SetAttribute("InSafeZone", inside)
	end
end

local function masterystore(serverdata, player)
	local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
	if not extra then
		return nil
	end
	if type(extra.Mastery) ~= "table" then
		extra.Mastery = {}
	end
	return extra.Mastery
end

local function trackmastery(serverdata, player, tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tracked[tool] then
		return
	end
	local level = tool:FindFirstChild("Level")
	if not level or not level:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end
	if not serverdata.WaitReady(player, 30) then
		return
	end
	local store = masterystore(serverdata, player)
	if not store or tracked[tool] then
		return
	end
	tracked[tool] = true
	local exp = tool:FindFirstChild("Exp")
	local saved = store[tool.Name]
	if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.Level) == "number" then
		local value = math.max(saved.Level, 1)
		level.Value = value
		if tool:GetAttribute("Level") ~= nil or value > 1 then
			tool:SetAttribute("Level", value)
		end
		if exp and exp:IsA("IntValue") and type(saved.Exp) == "number" then
			exp.Value = saved.Exp
		end
	end
	local function write()
		local current = masterystore(serverdata, player)
		if not current then
			return
		end
		local entry = current[tool.Name]
		if type(entry) ~= "table" then
			entry = {}
			current[tool.Name] = entry
		end
		entry.Level = math.max(level.Value, tool:GetAttribute("Level") or 0)
		entry.Exp = exp and exp:IsA("IntValue") and exp.Value or 0
	end
	write()
	level.Changed:Connect(write)
	tool:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Level"):Connect(function()
		local value = tool:GetAttribute("Level")
		if type(value) == "number" and level.Value ~= value then
			level.Value = value
		end
		write()
	end)
	if exp and exp:IsA("IntValue") then
		exp.Changed:Connect(write)
	end
end

local function watchcontainer(serverdata, player, container)
	container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		task.spawn(trackmastery, serverdata, player, child)
	end)
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		task.spawn(trackmastery, serverdata, player, child)
	end
end

local function onplayer(serverdata, player)
	player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Backpack") then
			watchcontainer(serverdata, player, child)
		end
	end)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		watchcontainer(serverdata, player, backpack)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		watchcontainer(serverdata, player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		watchcontainer(serverdata, player, player.Character)
	end
end

return function(_, serverdata)
	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		onplayer(serverdata, player)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onplayer, serverdata, player)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
				pcall(updatezone, player)
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local datastoreservice = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local teleportservice = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local server = script.Parent.Parent
local config = require(server.Config)

local itemconfig = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemConfig"))
local profilebackgrounds = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ProfileBackgrounds"))
local islandlookup = require(replicatedstorage.Modules:WaitForChild("IslandLocationLookup"))

local displaytitle = nil
pcall(function()
	displaytitle = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("DisplayTitle"))
end)

local statnames = {
	"Fighting Styles Unlocked",
	"Swords Unlocked",
	"Guns Unlocked",
	"Money",
	"Sea Events Cleared",
	"Races Evolved",
	"First Joined",
	"Total Fish Caught",
	"Fish Types Caught",
	"Fragments",
	"Bounty",
	"Honor",
	"Gifts Sent",
	"Permanent Fruits Owned",
	"Fruits Mastered",
	"Fighting Styles Mastered",
	"Races Fully Awakened",
}

local statmax = {
	["Fighting Styles Unlocked"] = 12,
	["Swords Unlocked"] = 40,
	["Guns Unlocked"] = 14,
	["Races Evolved"] = 7,
	["Fish Types Caught"] = 60,
	["Permanent Fruits Owned"] = 42,
	["Fruits Mastered"] = 43,
	["Fighting Styles Mastered"] = 13,
	["Races Fully Awakened"] = 7,
}

local packed = {
	Money = 1000000000,
	Fragments = 1000000000,
	Bounty = 30000000,
	Honor = 30000000,
	["First Joined"] = math.huge,
}

local settingnames = {
	"JoinServer",
	"LevelVisible",
	"RaceVisible",
	"AccessoriesVisible",
	"CombatToolsVisible",
	"ShowcaseVisible",
	"CrewVisible",
	"LocationVisible",
	"FindInRecent",
	"CanReceiveGifts",
}
local settingvalues = { Everyone = true, FriendsOnly = true, Nobody = true }

local races = { Human = true, Fishman = true, Mink = true, Skypiea = true, Ghoul = true, Cyborg = true, Draco = true }
local rarities = { Common = 1, Uncommon = 2, Rare = 3, Legendary = 4, Mythical = 5 }

local locationids = {}
for id, name in pairs(islandlookup.IdToValue or {}) do
	locationids[name] = id
end
for name, id in pairs(islandlookup.ValueToId or {}) do
	locationids[name] = id
end

local serverdata
local recentlimit = 30

local function profileof(player)
	local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
	if not extra then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local profile = extra.Profile
	if type(profile) ~= "table" then
		profile = {}
		extra.Profile = profile
	end
	profile.StatusId = tonumber(profile.StatusId) or 0
	profile.SubStatusId = tonumber(profile.SubStatusId) or 0
	profile.BackgroundIndex = tonumber(profile.BackgroundIndex) or 0
	profile.Showcase = type(profile.Showcase) == "table" and profile.Showcase or {}
	profile.Stats = type(profile.Stats) == "table" and profile.Stats or {}
	profile.Settings = type(profile.Settings) == "table" and profile.Settings or {}
	for _, name in ipairs(settingnames) do
		if not settingvalues[profile.Settings[name]] then
			profile.Settings[name] = "Everyone"
		end
	end
	profile.OwnedBackgrounds = type(profile.OwnedBackgrounds) == "table" and profile.OwnedBackgrounds or {}
	profile.NewBackgrounds = type(profile.NewBackgrounds) == "table" and profile.NewBackgrounds or {}
	profile.Recent = type(profile.Recent) == "table" and profile.Recent or {}
	if type(profile.FirstJoined) ~= "number" then
		profile.FirstJoined = os.time()
	end
	profile.GiftsSent = tonumber(profile.GiftsSent) or 0
	return profile, extra
end

local function datavalue(player, name)
	local value = serverdata.Get(player, name)
	return value
end

local function weapontype(name)
	local items = serverstorage:FindFirstChild("Items")
	local tool = items and items:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not tool then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local kind = tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType")
	if not kind and string.match(name, "^(.+)%-%1$") then
		kind = "Demon Fruit"
	end
	return kind, tool:GetAttribute("ItemId")
end

local function ownedtools(player, extra)
	local owned = {}
	local function add(name)
		if type(name) == "string" then
			owned[name] = true
		end
	end
	for _, container in ipairs({ player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), player.Character }) do
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					add(child.Name)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local shop = extra and extra.Shop
	if type(shop) == "table" and type(shop.weapons) == "table" then
		for name in pairs(shop.weapons) do
			add(name)
		end
	end
	return owned
end

local function counttypes(owned, kind)
	local count = 0
	for name in pairs(owned) do
		if weapontype(name) == kind then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function mastered(extra, kind)
	local count = 0
	if type(extra.Mastery) == "table" then
		for name, entry in pairs(extra.Mastery) do
			if type(entry) == "table" and (tonumber(entry.Level) or 0) >= 600 and weapontype(name) == kind then
				count += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function fishstats(extra)
	local total, kinds = 0, 0
	if type(extra.Fish) == "table" then
		for _, value in pairs(extra.Fish) do
			kinds += 1
			if type(value) == "number" then
				total += value
			elseif type(value) == "table" then
				total += tonumber(value.Count or value.Amount or value.Caught) or 1
			else
				total += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return total, kinds
end

local function racelevel(player)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local race = data and data:FindFirstChild("Race")
	if not race then
		return "Human", 1, 0, 0
	end
	local name = races[race.Value] and race.Value or "Human"
	local evolved = race:FindFirstChild("Evolved") ~= nil
	local level = evolved and 2 or 1
	local c = race:FindFirstChild("C")
	if evolved and c and c:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(c.Value) and c.Value >= 1 then
		level = 3
	end
	local awakened = race:FindFirstChild("Awakened") ~= nil or player:GetAttribute("RaceAwakened") == true
	if awakened then
		level = 4
	end
	return name, level, evolved and 1 or 0, awakened and 1 or 0
end

local function pack(value)
	value = math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 4294967295)
	return {
		Progression = bit32.band(value, 0xFFFF),
		MaxProgression = bit32.rshift(value, 16),
	}
end

local function statvalues(player)
	local profile, extra = profileof(player)
	if not profile then
		return nil
	end
	local owned = ownedtools(player, extra)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local bountyhonor = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Bounty/Honor")
	local bh = bountyhonor and bountyhonor.Value or 0
	local pirate = player.Team == nil or player.Team.Name ~= "Marines"
	local totalfish, fishkinds = fishstats(extra)
	local _, _, evolved, awakened = racelevel(player)
	local permanent = 0
	if type(extra.Fruits) == "table" then
		for _, count in pairs(extra.Fruits) do
			if (tonumber(count) or 0) > 0 then
				permanent += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		["Fighting Styles Unlocked"] = counttypes(owned, "Melee"),
		["Swords Unlocked"] = counttypes(owned, "Sword"),
		["Guns Unlocked"] = counttypes(owned, "Gun"),
		Money = datavalue(player, "Beli") or 0,
		["Sea Events Cleared"] = datavalue(player, "SeaEventsCleared") or 0,
		["Races Evolved"] = evolved,
		["First Joined"] = profile.FirstJoined,
		["Total Fish Caught"] = totalfish,
		["Fish Types Caught"] = fishkinds,
		Fragments = datavalue(player, "Fragments") or 0,
		Bounty = pirate and bh or 0,
		Honor = pirate and 0 or bh,
		["Gifts Sent"] = profile.GiftsSent,
		["Permanent Fruits Owned"] = permanent,
		["Fruits Mastered"] = mastered(extra, "Demon Fruit"),
		["Fighting Styles Mastered"] = mastered(extra, "Melee"),
		["Races Fully Awakened"] = awakened,
	}
end

local function statentry(values, statid)
	local name = statnames[statid + 1]
	if not name then
		return nil
	end
	local value = tonumber(values[name]) or 0
	if packed[name] then
		local entry = pack(math.min(value, packed[name]))
		entry.StatId = statid
		return entry
	end
	return {
		StatId = statid,
		Progression = math.max(0, math.floor(value)),
		MaxProgression = statmax[name] or 0,
	}
end

local function equipped(player)
	local result = { Demon = 0, Sword = 0, Gun = 0, Melee = 0 }
	local function scan(container, overwrite)
		if not container then
			return
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				local kind, itemid = weapontype(child.Name)
				itemid = child:GetAttribute("ItemId") or itemid
				local slot = kind == "Demon Fruit" and "Demon" or kind
				if slot and result[slot] ~= nil and type(itemid) == "number" and (overwrite or result[slot] == 0) then
					result[slot] = itemid
				end
			end
		end
	end
	scan(player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), false)
	scan(player.Character, true)
	return result
end

local function titleof(player, extra)
	local name = player:GetAttribute("Title") or player:GetAttribute("EquippedTitle") or extra.EquippedTitle
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return "", Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local text, color = name, nil
	if displaytitle then
		pcall(function()
			text = displaytitle.GetTitleText(name)
			color = displaytitle.GetTitleColor(name)
		end)
	end
	if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	end
	return string.sub(tostring(text), 1, 32), color
end

local function crewof(player)
	local crew = datavalue(player, "CrewID")
	if type(crew) == "string" and crew ~= "" then
		return string.sub(player:GetAttribute("CrewName") or crew, 1, 32)
	end
	return ""
end

local function location(player)
	local current = player:GetAttribute("CurrentLocation")
	if type(current) == "string" and locationids[current] then
		return locationids[current]
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	local locations = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
	if not root or not locations then
		return 0
	end
	local best, bestdistance = 0, 2500
	for _, part in ipairs(locations:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and locationids[part.Name] then
			local distance = (Vector3.new(part.Position.X, 0, part.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)).Magnitude
			if distance < bestdistance then
				best, bestdistance = locationids[part.Name], distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rarityof(itemid)
	local item = itemid ~= 0 and itemconfig.tryGet(itemid) or nil
	local rarity = item and item.Quality and item.Quality.Rarity
	return rarities[rarity] or (item and 1 or 0)
end

local function quantityof(extra, itemid)
	local shop = extra.Shop
	local amount = type(shop) == "table" and type(shop.quantity) == "table" and tonumber(shop.quantity[tostring(itemid)]) or nil
	return math.clamp(amount or 1, 0, 65535)
end

local function buildprofile(player)
	local profile, extra = profileof(player)
	if not profile then
		return nil
	end
	local race, level = racelevel(player)
	local gear = equipped(player)
	local titletext, titlecolor = titleof(player, extra)
	local crew = crewof(player)
	local shop = extra.Shop
	local accessory = type(shop) == "table" and tonumber(shop.accessory) or 0
	local data = {
		Verified = false,
		Online = true,
		IsInCrew = crew ~= "",
		IsStarCreator = false,
		IsDeveloper = player.UserId == game.CreatorId or player.UserId == 5425038292,
		Race = race,
		RaceLevel = level,
		Level = datavalue(player, "Level") or 1,
		EquippedAccessory = accessory or 0,
		EquippedFightingStyle = gear.Melee,
		EquippedFruit = gear.Demon,
		EquippedGun = gear.Gun,
		EquippedSword = gear.Sword,
		EquippedTrinket1 = 0,
		EquippedTrinket2 = 0,
		Settings = table.clone(profile.Settings),
		CrewName = crew,
		TitleText = titletext,
		TitleColor = titlecolor,
		StatusId = profile.StatusId,
		SubStatusId = profile.SubStatusId,
		LastLocation = location(player),
		BackgroundIndex = profile.BackgroundIndex,
		StanceOverrideId = 0,
	}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local itemid = tonumber(profile.Showcase[tostring(i)]) or 0
		data[`ShowcaseSlot{ i }Id`] = itemid
		data[`ShowcaseSlot{ i }Rarity`] = rarityof(itemid)
		data[`ShowcaseSlot{ i }Quantity`] = itemid ~= 0 and quantityof(extra, itemid) or 0
	end
	local values = statvalues(player)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local statid = tonumber(profile.Stats[tostring(i)])
		data[`Stat{ i }`] = statid and values and statentry(values, statid) or nil
	end
	return data
end

local function serialize(data)
	local copy = table.clone(data)
	copy.Settings = table.clone(data.Settings)
	copy.TitleColor = { data.TitleColor.R, data.TitleColor.G, data.TitleColor.B }
	copy.Online = false
	return copy
end

local function deserialize(copy)
	if type(copy) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local data = table.clone(copy)
	local color = copy.TitleColor
	data.TitleColor = type(color) == "table" and Color3.new(color[1] or 0, color[2] or 0, color[3] or 0) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	data.Online = false
	return data
end

local function snapshot(player)
	local _, extra = profileof(player)
	if not extra then
		return
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(buildprofile, player)
	if ok and data then
		extra.ProfileSnapshot = serialize(data)
	end
end

local store = nil
local function readoffline(userid)
	if store == nil then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return datastoreservice:GetDataStore(config.DataStoreName)
		end)
		store = ok and result or false
	end
	if not store then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, record = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. tostring(userid))
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false
	end
	local extra = type(record) == "table" and type(record.data) == "table" and record.data.Extra
	return type(extra) == "table" and deserialize(extra.ProfileSnapshot) or nil
end

local function addrecent(player, other, context)
	if not other or other == player or not serverdata.IsReady(player) then
		return
	end
	local profile = profileof(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local otherprofile = serverdata.IsReady(other) and profileof(other) or nil
	if otherprofile and otherprofile.Settings.FindInRecent == "Nobody" then
		return
	end
	for index = #profile.Recent, 1, -1 do
		if profile.Recent[index].UserId == other.UserId then
			table.remove(profile.Recent, index)
		end
	end
	table.insert(profile.Recent, 1, { UserId = other.UserId, Username = other.Name, Context = context, Time = os.time() })
	while #profile.Recent > recentlimit do
		table.remove(profile.Recent)
	end
end

local function friendsonline(player)
	local ok, list = pcall(player.GetFriendsOnline, player, 200)
	local map = {}
	if ok and type(list) == "table" then
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			map[entry.VisitorId] = entry
		end
	end
	return map
end

local function isfriend(player, userid)
	local ok, result = pcall(player.IsFriendsWith, player, userid)
	return ok and result == true
end

local function lookup(player, category)
	local result = {}
	if category == "Server" then
		for _, other in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
			if other ~= player then
				table.insert(result, {
					UserId = other.UserId,
					Username = other.Name,
					Context = "In your server",
					IsFriend = isfriend(player, other.UserId),
					IsOnline = true,
				})
			end
		end
	elseif category == "Recent" then
		local profile = profileof(player)
		local online = friendsonline(player)
		for _, entry in ipairs(profile and profile.Recent or {}) do
			table.insert(result, {
				UserId = entry.UserId,
				Username = entry.Username,
				Context = entry.Context or "Recently interacted",
				IsFriend = isfriend(player, entry.UserId),
				IsOnline = players:GetPlayerByUserId(entry.UserId) ~= nil or online[entry.UserId] ~= nil,
			})
		end
	elseif category == "Global" then
		local online = friendsonline(player)
		local ok, pages = pcall(players.GetFriendsAsync, players, player.UserId)
		if ok and pages then
			local count = 0
			while count < 200 do
				for _, friend in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
					count += 1
					table.insert(result, {
						UserId = friend.Id,
						Username = friend.Username,
						Context = "Friend",
						IsFriend = true,
						IsOnline = online[friend.Id] ~= nil or players:GetPlayerByUserId(friend.Id) ~= nil,
					})
				end
				if pages.IsFinished then
					break
				end
				local advanced = pcall(pages.AdvanceToNextPageAsync, pages)
				if not advanced then
					break
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(result, function(a, b)
			if a.IsOnline ~= b.IsOnline then
				return a.IsOnline
			end
			return a.Username < b.Username
		end)
	end
	return result
end

local function ownsbackground(player, profile, name, index)
	if index == 0 or name == "Default" then
		return true
	end
	local entry = profilebackgrounds.List[name]
	if entry and entry.SelectCriteria then
		local ok, allowed = pcall(entry.SelectCriteria, player.UserId, { IsDeveloper = player.UserId == game.CreatorId or player.UserId == 5425038292 })
		if ok and allowed then
			return true
		end
	end
	return profile.OwnedBackgrounds[name] == true
end

local function ownsitem(player, extra, itemid)
	local item = itemconfig.tryGet(itemid)
	if not item then
		return false
	end
	local shop = extra.Shop
	if type(shop) == "table" and type(shop.quantity) == "table" and (tonumber(shop.quantity[tostring(itemid)]) or 0) > 0 then
		return true
	end
	for _, container in ipairs({ player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), player.Character }) do
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Tool") and (child:GetAttribute("ItemId") == itemid or child.Name == item.Index.StorageKey) then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if item.Index.IdType == "Title" and type(extra.Titles) == "table" and extra.Titles[item.Index.StorageKey] then
		return true
	end
	return type(shop) == "table" and type(shop.weapons) == "table" and shop.weapons[item.Index.StorageKey] == true
end

local function update(player, action, first, second)
	local profile, extra = profileof(player)
	if not profile then
		return false, "Data not loaded"
	end
	if action == "Background" then
		local index = tonumber(first)
		local name = index and profilebackgrounds.IdToNameMap[index]
		if not name or not ownsbackground(player, profile, name, index) then
			return false, "Background not owned"
		end
		profile.BackgroundIndex = index
	elseif action == "ClearNewBackground" then
		if type(first) ~= "string" then
			return false, "Bad background"
		end
		profile.NewBackgrounds[first] = nil
	elseif action == "Showcase" then
		local slot = tonumber(first)
		local itemid = tonumber(second)
		if not slot or slot < 1 or slot > 6 or slot % 1 ~= 0 or not itemid then
			return false, "Bad slot"
		end
		if itemid ~= 0 then
			if not ownsitem(player, extra, itemid) then
				return false, "Item not owned"
			end
			for i = 1, 6 do
				if tonumber(profile.Showcase[tostring(i)]) == itemid then
					profile.Showcase[tostring(i)] = nil
				end
			end
			profile.Showcase[tostring(slot)] = itemid
		else
			profile.Showcase[tostring(slot)] = nil
		end
	elseif action == "Stat" then
		local slot = tonumber(first)
		local statid = tonumber(second)
		if not slot or slot < 1 or slot > 4 or slot % 1 ~= 0 or not statid or not statnames[statid + 1] then
			return false, "Bad stat"
		end
		local wasselected = tonumber(profile.Stats[tostring(slot)]) == statid
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if tonumber(profile.Stats[tostring(i)]) == statid then
				profile.Stats[tostring(i)] = nil
			end
		end
		if not wasselected then
			profile.Stats[tostring(slot)] = statid
		end
	elseif action == "Status" then
		local statusid = tonumber(first)
		if not statusid or statusid < 0 or statusid > 200 or statusid % 1 ~= 0 then
			return false, "Bad status"
		end
		profile.StatusId = statusid ~= 0 and statusid or 9
		profile.SubStatusId = 0
	elseif action == "SubStatus" then
		local substatus = tonumber(first)
		if not substatus or substatus < 0 or substatus > 32 or substatus % 1 ~= 0 then
			return false, "Bad sub status"
		end
		profile.SubStatusId = substatus
	elseif action == "Setting" then
		if not table.find(settingnames, first) or not settingvalues[second] then
			return false, "Bad setting"
		end
		profile.Settings[first] = second
	else
		return false, "Unknown action"
	end
	task.defer(snapshot, player)
	return true
end

local function profiledata(player, userid)
	userid = tonumber(userid)
	if not userid then
		return nil
	end
	local target = players:GetPlayerByUserId(userid)
	if target then
		if not serverdata.WaitReady(target, 10) then
			return nil
		end
		if target ~= player then
			addrecent(player, target, "Viewed their profile")
		end
		return buildprofile(target)
	end
	return readoffline(userid)
end

local function onlinestatus(player, userid)
	userid = tonumber(userid)
	if not userid then
		return false
	end
	if players:GetPlayerByUserId(userid) then
		return true
	end
	return friendsonline(player)[userid] ~= nil
end

local function joinplayer(player, userid)
	userid = tonumber(userid)
	if not userid or players:GetPlayerByUserId(userid) then
		return
	end
	local entry = friendsonline(player)[userid]
	if not entry or entry.PlaceId ~= game.PlaceId or type(entry.GameId) ~= "string" then
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>That player isn't in a joinable server.<Color=/>")
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(teleportservice.TeleportToPlaceInstance, teleportservice, game.PlaceId, entry.GameId, player)
	if not ok then
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>Failed to join that player.<Color=/>")
	end
end

return function(router, data)
	serverdata = data
	local rf = { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 4, burst = 10 } }
	router.remote("GetPlayerProfileData", profiledata, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 2, burst = 6 } })
	router.remote("GetPlayerStats", function(player)
		local values = statvalues(player)
		if not values then
			return {}
		end
		local list = {}
		for index, name in ipairs(statnames) do
			local entry = statentry(values, index - 1)
			entry.DisplayName = name
			table.insert(list, entry)
		end
		return list
	end, rf)
	router.remote("GetPlayerStatDisplayNames", function()
		return table.clone(statnames)
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", requireData = false, limit = { rate = 4, burst = 10 } })
	router.remote("GetProfileBackgroundList", function(player)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		if not profile then
			return false
		end
		local owned = { Default = true }
		for index, name in pairs(profilebackgrounds.IdToNameMap) do
			if ownsbackground(player, profile, name, index) then
				owned[name] = true
			end
		end
		return true, owned, table.clone(profile.NewBackgrounds)
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 4, burst = 10 } })
	router.remote("UpdatePlayerProfileValue", update, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 6, burst = 12 } })
	router.remote("MarkPlayerProfileOpened", function(player)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		if profile then
			profile.Opened = true
		end
	end, { limit = { rate = 2, burst = 4 } })
	router.remote("GetPlayerProfileOpened", function(player)
		local profile = profileof(player)
		return profile ~= nil and profile.Opened == true
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 4, burst = 8 } })
	router.remote("GetPlayerLookupInfo", function(player, category)
		if category ~= "Server" and category ~= "Recent" and category ~= "Global" then
			return {}
		end
		return lookup(player, category)
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 3, burst = 6 } })
	router.remote("GetPlayerLookupOnlineStatus", onlinestatus, { className = "RemoteFunction", limit = { rate = 3, burst = 6 } })
	router.remote("JoinPlayerFromProfile", joinplayer, { limit = { rate = 1, burst = 2 } })

	local events = serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitboxevents", 30)
	local damaged = events and events:FindFirstChild("damaged")
	if damaged and damaged:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		damaged.Event:Connect(function(attacker, model)
			local victim = model and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if attacker and attacker:IsA("Player") and victim then
				addrecent(attacker, victim, "Fought in PvP")
				addrecent(victim, attacker, "Fought in PvP")
			end
		end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
				if serverdata.IsReady(player) then
					task.spawn(snapshot, player)
				end
			end
			task.wait(60)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("ServerSignals")).PlayerDataSaving():Connect(function(player)
			pcall(snapshot, player)
		end)
	end)
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local server = script.Parent.Parent
local config = require(server.Config)

local statnames = { "Melee", "Defense", "Sword", "Gun", "Demon Fruit" }
local racechances = {
	{ "Human", 62.5 },
	{ "Mink", 12.5 },
	{ "Fishman", 12.5 },
	{ "Skypiea", 12.5 },
}
local random = Random.new()

local serverdata

local function datafolder(player)
	return player:FindFirstChild("Data")
end

local function statlevel(player, name)
	local data = datafolder(player)
	local stats = data and data:FindFirstChild("Stats")
	local stat = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(name)
	return stat and stat:FindFirstChild("Level")
end

local function levelcap(player)
	local cap = player:GetAttribute("LevelCap")
	if type(cap) ~= "number" then
		cap = config.StatCap
	end
	return math.min(cap, config.StatCap)
end

local function addpoint(player, statname, amount)
	if type(statname) ~= "string" or not table.find(statnames, statname) then
		return false
	end
	amount = tonumber(amount)
	if not amount or amount < 1 or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local level = statlevel(player, statname)
	local points = datafolder(player) and datafolder(player):FindFirstChild("Points")
	if not level or not points then
		return false
	end
	amount = math.min(amount, points.Value, levelcap(player) - level.Value)
	if amount <= 0 then
		if level.Value >= levelcap(player) then
			serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>This stat is already maxed!<Color=/>")
		end
		return false
	end
	level.Value += amount
	points.Value -= amount
	serverdata.RefreshCharacter(player)
	return true
end

local function refund(player)
	local data = datafolder(player)
	local refunds = data and data:FindFirstChild("StatRefunds")
	local points = data and data:FindFirstChild("Points")
	if not refunds or not points then
		return false
	end
	if refunds.Value <= 0 then
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>You don't have any Stat Refunds.<Color=/>")
		return false
	end
	local returned = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(statnames) do
		local level = statlevel(player, name)
		if level and level.Value > 1 then
			returned += level.Value - 1
			level.Value = 1
		end
	end
	refunds.Value -= 1
	points.Value += returned
	serverdata.RefreshCharacter(player)
	serverdata.Notify(player, "Your stats have been reset! <Color=Green>" .. tostring(returned) .. "<Color=/> points refunded.")
	return true
end

local function rollrace(current)
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local roll = random:NextNumber(0, 100)
		local total = 0
		for _, entry in ipairs(racechances) do
			total += entry[2]
			if roll <= total then
				if entry[1] ~= current then
					return entry[1]
				end
				break
			end
		end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(racechances) do
		if entry[1] ~= current then
			return entry[1]
		end
	end
	return "Human"
end

local function reroll(player)
	local data = datafolder(player)
	local rerolls = data and data:FindFirstChild("RaceRerolls")
	local race = data and data:FindFirstChild("Race")
	if not rerolls or not race then
		return false
	end
	if rerolls.Value <= 0 then
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>You don't have any Race Rerolls.<Color=/>")
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if character and character:GetAttribute("InCombat") == true then
		serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>You cannot do this while in combat.<Color=/>")
		return false
	end
	local newrace = rollrace(race.Value)
	rerolls.Value -= 1
	race.Value = newrace
	for _, name in ipairs({ "A", "B", "C" }) do
		local value = race:FindFirstChild(name)
		if value and value:IsA("IntValue") then
			value.Value = 0
		end
	end
	local evolved = race:FindFirstChild("Evolved")
	if evolved then
		evolved:Destroy()
	end
	serverdata.Notify(player, "You are now a <Color=Green>" .. newrace .. "<Color=/>!")
	task.defer(serverdata.Spawn, player)
	return newrace
end

local function onplayer(player)
	if not serverdata.WaitReady(player, 30) then
		return
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(statnames) do
		local level = statlevel(player, name)
		if level and level.Value < 1 then
			level.Value = 1
		end
	end
end

return function(router, data)
	serverdata = data
	router.commF("AddPoint", addpoint, { rate = 10, burst = 20 })
	router.commF("redeemRefundPoints", refund, { rate = 1, burst = 2 })
	router.commF("RerollRace", reroll, { rate = 1, burst = 2 })
	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onplayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(onplayer, player)
	end
end

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local itemconfig = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemConfig"))
local itemreplication = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("ItemReplicationService"))
local modification = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("Modification"))
local skinvfxhandle = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SkinVFXHandle"))
local skinvfx = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("SkinVFX"))
local skinnedrigs = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Assets"):FindFirstChild("SkinnedRigs")

local keys = itemreplication.KEYS

local admins = { notbloxfruitscopy = true, Zakouplays6 = true }
local vfxnames = { Tiger = "Leopard" }
local auraadornee = 1445

local catalog = {}
local byadornee = {}
local handles = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local serverdata
local modevent

local function nullable(result)
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return result:asNullable()
	end)
	return ok and value or nil
end

local function buildcatalog()
	for _, idtype in ipairs({ "Skin", "Mutation" }) do
		local ok, list = pcall(itemconfig.Query.select, { Index = { IdType = idtype } })
		if not ok then
			warn("[modifications] query " .. idtype .. " failed: " .. tostring(list))
		end
		if ok then
			for _, item in list do
				local id = item.Index.ItemId
				local adornee = nullable(modification.matchAdornee(id))
				if adornee then
					local entry = {
						id = id,
						kind = idtype,
						adornee = adornee,
						name = item.Index.StorageKey,
						display = (item.Display and (item.Display.Name or item.Display.Title)) or item.Index.StorageKey,
						isdefault = item.Skin ~= nil and item.Skin.IsDefault == true,
					}
					catalog[id] = entry
					byadornee[adornee] = byadornee[adornee] or {}
					table.insert(byadornee[adornee], entry)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function mutationtarget(entry)
	if entry.kind ~= "Mutation" then
		return nil
	end
	local item = itemconfig.tryGet(entry.id)
	local physical = item and item.Mutation and item.Mutation.Physical
	local physicalitem = physical and itemconfig.tryGet(physical)
	return physicalitem and physicalitem.Index.StorageKey or nil
end

local function store(player)
	local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
	if not extra then
		return nil
	end
	if type(extra.Modifications) ~= "table" then
		extra.Modifications = {}
	end
	local data = extra.Modifications
	data.owned = type(data.owned) == "table" and data.owned or {}
	data.preferred = type(data.preferred) == "table" and data.preferred or {}
	return data
end

local function replicate(player, key, id, value)
	pcall(function()
		itemreplication:ReplicateItem(player, key, id, nil, value)
	end)
end

local function isfruittool(tool)
	return tool:IsA("Tool") and type(tool:GetAttribute("ItemId")) == "number"
		and (tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") == "Demon Fruit" or tool.ToolTip == "Blox Fruit" or string.match(tool.Name, "^(.+)%-%1$") ~= nil)
end

local function adorneeof(player, tool)
	local id = tool:GetAttribute("ItemId")
	if tool.Name == "Dragon-Dragon" then
		local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local devil = data and data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
		local kind = (devil and devil:GetAttribute("DragonType")) or tool:GetAttribute("DragonType")
		if kind == "East" or kind == "Eastern" then
			return 1436
		end
		return 1435
	end
	return id
end

local function fruittools(player)
	local list = {}
	for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if isfruittool(child) then
					table.insert(list, child)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function hasbuso(player)
	local extra = serverdata.GetExtra(player)
	return extra and type(extra.Abilities) == "table" and extra.Abilities.Buso == true
end

local function ownedmods(player)
	local data = store(player)
	local owned = {}
	if not data then
		return owned
	end
	for key in pairs(data.owned) do
		local id = tonumber(key)
		if id and catalog[id] then
			owned[id] = true
		end
	end
	if hasbuso(player) then
		for _, entry in ipairs(byadornee[auraadornee] or {}) do
			if entry.isdefault then
				owned[entry.id] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _, tool in ipairs(fruittools(player)) do
		local adornee = adorneeof(player, tool)
		for _, entry in ipairs(byadornee[adornee] or {}) do
			if entry.isdefault then
				owned[entry.id] = true
			end
		end
		for _, entries in pairs(byadornee) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				if entry.kind == "Mutation" and mutationtarget(entry) == tool.Name then
					owned[entry.id] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return owned
end

local function payload(player)
	local ok, data = pcall(modification.Data.Modification.fromItemReplication, player)
	if ok and data then
		return data
	end
	return buffer.create(5)
end

local function dosync(player)
	local data = store(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local owned = ownedmods(player)
	local ownedcount = 0
	for _ in pairs(owned) do
		ownedcount += 1
	end
	player:SetAttribute("modificationsowned", ownedcount)
	player:SetAttribute("modificationtools", #fruittools(player))
	local stacks = {}
	for id, entry in pairs(catalog) do
		local preferred = owned[id] and data.preferred[tostring(id)] or nil
		replicate(player, keys.IS_OWNED, id, owned[id] or nil)
		replicate(player, keys.QUANTITY, id, owned[id] and 1 or nil)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_PREFERRED, id, preferred)
		if owned[id] then
			local item = itemconfig.tryGet(id)
			local stackkey = item and item.Inventory and item.Inventory.StackKey or tostring(id)
			local score = (preferred and entry.kind == "Skin" and 4) or (preferred and 3) or (entry.isdefault and 2) or 1
			local current = stacks[stackkey]
			if not current or score > current.score or (score == current.score and id < current.id) then
				stacks[stackkey] = { id = id, score = score }
			end
		end
	end
	local leaders = {}
	for _, leader in pairs(stacks) do
		leaders[leader.id] = true
	end
	for id in pairs(catalog) do
		replicate(player, keys.IS_STACK_LEADER, id, leaders[id] or nil)
	end
	local current = player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
	for _, tool in ipairs(fruittools(player)) do
		local adornee = adorneeof(player, tool)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_OWNED, adornee, true)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_EQUIPPED, adornee, (current == nil or current.Value == "" or current.Value == tool.Name) or nil)
		local skin, mutation = nil, nil
		for _, entry in ipairs(byadornee[adornee] or {}) do
			if entry.kind == "Skin" and entry.isdefault and skin == nil then
				skin = entry.id
			end
		end
		for _, entries in pairs(byadornee) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				if owned[entry.id] and data.preferred[tostring(entry.id)] then
					if entry.kind == "Skin" and entry.adornee == adornee then
						skin = entry.id
					elseif entry.kind == "Mutation" and mutationtarget(entry) == tool.Name then
						mutation = entry.id
					end
				end
			end
		end
		replicate(player, keys.EQUIPPED_SKIN, adornee, skin)
		replicate(player, keys.PREFERRED_MUTATION, adornee, mutation)
	end
	local auraskin = nil
	for _, entry in ipairs(byadornee[auraadornee] or {}) do
		if entry.kind == "Skin" and owned[entry.id] then
			if data.preferred[tostring(entry.id)] then
				auraskin = entry.id
				break
			elseif entry.isdefault then
				auraskin = entry.id
			end
		end
	end
	if hasbuso(player) then
		replicate(player, keys.IS_OWNED, auraadornee, true)
		replicate(player, keys.IS_EQUIPPED, auraadornee, true)
		replicate(player, keys.EQUIPPED_SKIN, auraadornee, auraskin)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("auraskin", auraskin or 0)
	if modevent then
		pcall(function()
			modevent:FireClient(player, { Type = "DataChanged", Data = payload(player) })
		end)
	end
end

local function sync(player)
	local ok, err = pcall(dosync, player)
	if not ok then
		warn("[modifications] sync failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function vfxname(tool)
	local base = tool.Name:match("^(.-)%-") or tool.Name
	local inner = base:match("%((.-)%)")
	base = inner or base
	return (vfxnames[base] or base) .. "FruitVFXColor"
end

local function rigpath(player, tool)
	local name = tool.Name
	if name == "Dragon-Dragon" then
		name = adorneeof(player, tool) == 1436 and "Dragon (East)-Dragon (East)" or "Dragon (West)-Dragon (West)"
	end
	local transformations = skinnedrigs and skinnedrigs:FindFirstChild("Transformations")
	if transformations and transformations:FindFirstChild(name) then
		return "Transformations." .. name
	end
	return nil
end

local function bindrig(player, tool, handle)
	local rigobject = tool:FindFirstChild("TransformedRigObject")
	if not rigobject or not rigobject:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		return
	end
	local function apply(skinid)
		local rig = rigobject.Value
		local path = rig and rigpath(player, tool)
		if not path or not rig.Parent then
			return
		end
		skinid = skinid or handle:GetEquippedSkin()
		local okapply, err = pcall(skinvfx.applySkin, skinid, { [rig] = path })
		if not okapply then
			warn("[modifications] rig skin failed for " .. tool.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	local changed = rigobject.Changed:Connect(function()
		task.defer(apply)
	end)
	local disconnect = handle:ConnectUpdateLoop(function(skinid)
		apply(skinid)
	end)
	table.insert(handle._CleanUpCallbacks, function()
		changed:Disconnect()
		disconnect()
	end)
	if rigobject.Value then
		task.defer(apply)
	end
end

local function attachskin(player, tool)
	if handles[tool] or not isfruittool(tool) then
		return
	end
	local adornee = adorneeof(player, tool)
	if not byadornee[adornee] then
		return
	end
	local ok, handle = pcall(skinvfxhandle.new, player, adornee, tool, vfxname(tool))
	if ok and handle then
		handles[tool] = handle
		pcall(handle.BindToHandle, handle, tool)
		bindrig(player, tool, handle)
	else
		warn("[modifications] skin handle failed for " .. tool.Name .. ": " .. tostring(handle))
	end
end

local function swapfruit(player, toolname)
	local items = serverstorage:FindFirstChild("Items")
	local template = items and items:FindFirstChild(toolname)
	if not template then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local wasequipped = false
	for _, tool in ipairs(fruittools(player)) do
		if tool.Name ~= toolname then
			wasequipped = wasequipped or tool.Parent == character
			if humanoid and tool.Parent == character then
				humanoid:UnequipTools()
			end
			tool:SetAttribute("ending", true)
			task.wait(0.1)
			if tool.Parent then
				tool:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	local existing = nil
	for _, tool in ipairs(fruittools(player)) do
		if tool.Name == toolname then
			existing = tool
		end
	end
	local tool = existing or template:Clone()
	tool.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local devil = data and data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
	if devil then
		devil.Value = toolname
	end
	if wasequipped and humanoid then
		task.defer(function()
			if tool.Parent then
				humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
			end
		end)
	end
	return true
end

local function setequip(player, itemid, isequipped)
	local entry = catalog[itemid]
	if not entry then
		return { Type = "Generic", Success = false, Message = "Unknown item." }
	end
	local data = store(player)
	if not data then
		return { Type = "Generic", Success = false, Message = "Data not loaded." }
	end
	local owned = ownedmods(player)
	if not owned[itemid] then
		return { Type = "Generic", Success = false, Message = "You don't own this." }
	end
	if isequipped then
		for _, other in ipairs(byadornee[entry.adornee] or {}) do
			if other.kind == entry.kind then
				data.preferred[tostring(other.id)] = nil
			end
		end
		if not entry.isdefault then
			data.preferred[tostring(itemid)] = true
		end
		if entry.kind == "Mutation" then
			local target = mutationtarget(entry)
			if target and not swapfruit(player, target) then
				serverdata.Notify(player, "<Color=Red>" .. tostring(entry.display) .. " isn't available yet.<Color=/>")
			end
		end
	else
		data.preferred[tostring(itemid)] = nil
	end
	sync(player)
	return { Type = "GetData", Data = payload(player) }
end

local function grant(player, query, kind)
	local data = store(player)
	if not data then
		return 0
	end
	query = string.lower(query or "")
	local count = 0
	for id, entry in pairs(catalog) do
		if (kind == nil or entry.kind == kind) and not entry.isdefault and (query == "all" or string.find(string.lower(entry.name), query, 1, true) or string.find(string.lower(tostring(entry.display)), query, 1, true)) then
			data.owned[tostring(id)] = true
			count += 1
		end
	end
	sync(player)
	return count
end

local function isadmin(player)
	return admins[string.lower(player.Name)] == true or player.UserId == game.CreatorId or game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio()
end

local function watch(player)
	if not serverdata.WaitReady(player, 30) then
		return
	end
	local function hook(container)
		if not container then
			return
		end
		container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if isfruittool(child) then
				task.defer(attachskin, player, child)
				task.delay(0.2, sync, player)
			end
		end)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isfruittool(child) then
				task.defer(attachskin, player, child)
			end
		end
	end
	hook(player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
	hook(player.Character)
	player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Backpack") then
			hook(child)
		end
	end)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(hook)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		if not isadmin(player) then
			return
		end
		local command, rest = message:match("^/(%w+)%s*(.*)$")
		command = command and command:lower()
		if command == "skin" or command == "mutation" then
			local count = grant(player, rest ~= "" and rest or "all", command == "skin" and "Skin" or "Mutation")
			serverdata.Notify(player, "Unlocked <Color=Green>" .. count .. "<Color=/> " .. command .. (count == 1 and "" or "s") .. ".")
		end
	end)
	sync(player)
end

return function(router, data)
	serverdata = data
	local built, err = pcall(buildcatalog)
	if not built then
		warn("[modifications] catalog failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(catalog) do
		count += 1
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute("modificationcatalog", count)
	local ok, net = pcall(require, replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Net"))
	if ok then
		modevent = net:RemoteEvent("ModificationEvent")
	end
	router.netFunction("ModificationFunction", function(player, request)
		if type(request) ~= "table" then
			return { Type = "Generic", Success = false }
		end
		if request.Type == "GetData" then
			return { Type = "GetData", Data = payload(player) }
		elseif request.Type == "SetEquip" and type(request.ItemId) == "number" and type(request.IsEquipped) == "boolean" then
			return setequip(player, request.ItemId, request.IsEquipped)
		end
		return { Type = "Generic", Success = false }
	end)
	players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.spawn(watch, player)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(watch, player)
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Server = script.Parent.Parent
local Config = require(Server.Config)

local Result = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Result"))

local function getPrefix()
	local ok, constants = pcall(function()
		return require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TestingGroupUtil"):WaitForChild("CONSTANTS"))
	end)
	if ok and type(constants) == "table" and type(constants.TESTING_GROUP_PREFIX) == "string" then
		return constants.TESTING_GROUP_PREFIX
	end
	return "TestingGroupUtil_"
end

local PREFIX = getPrefix()

local TestingService = {}

local initialized = false

local function hash(text)
	local value = 5381
	for index = 1, #text do
		value = (value * 33 + string.byte(text, index)) % 4294967296
	end
	return value
end

local function sortedGroupNames(experiment)
	local names = {}
	for name in pairs(experiment.groups) do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

function TestingService.Resolve(userId, experimentName)
	local experiment = Config.Experiments[experimentName]
	if not experiment then
		return nil
	end
	local forced = Config.ForcedGroups[experimentName]
	if forced ~= nil and experiment.groups[forced] ~= nil then
		return forced
	end
	local names = sortedGroupNames(experiment)
	local total = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		total += experiment.groups[name]
	end
	if total <= 0 then
		return experiment.default
	end
	local bucket = hash(tostring(userId) .. ":" .. experimentName) % total
	local running = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		running += experiment.groups[name]
		if bucket < running then
			return name
		end
	end
	return experiment.default
end

function TestingService.AssignPlayer(player)
	for experimentName in pairs(Config.Experiments) do
		player:SetAttribute(PREFIX .. experimentName, TestingService.Resolve(player.UserId, experimentName))
	end
end

function TestingService:GetIfInitialized()
	return initialized
end

function TestingService:GetGroup(userId, experimentName)
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or type(experimentName) ~= "string" then
		return Result.err("BadArguments")
	end
	local value = TestingService.Resolve(userId, experimentName)
	if value == nil then
		return Result.err("UnknownExperiment")
	end
	return Result.ok(value)
end

function TestingService.getGroup(data, experimentName)
	local userId = type(data) == "table" and data.UserId or nil
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or type(experimentName) ~= "string" then
		return Result.err("BadArguments")
	end
	local value = TestingService.Resolve(userId, experimentName)
	if value == nil then
		return Result.err("UnknownExperiment")
	end
	return Result.ok(value)
end

function TestingService:GetAllGroups(userId)
	local groups = {}
	for experimentName in pairs(Config.Experiments) do
		groups[experimentName] = TestingService.Resolve(userId, experimentName)
	end
	return groups
end

function TestingService.Register(Router)
	Router.netFunction("GetTestingGroup", function(player, experimentName)
		if type(experimentName) ~= "string" or #experimentName > 64 then
			return nil
		end
		return TestingService.Resolve(player.UserId, experimentName)
	end, { requireData = false, rate = 10, burst = 20 })
end

function TestingService.Init()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(TestingService.AssignPlayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		TestingService.AssignPlayer(player)
	end
	initialized = true
end

return TestingService

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local AssetStreaming = {}

local ALLOWED_KINDS = { FX = true }

local cache = {}

local function findAsset(kind, name)
	local serverContainer = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(kind)
	local asset = serverContainer and serverContainer:FindFirstChild(name)
	if asset then
		return asset
	end
	local sharedContainer = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(kind)
	return sharedContainer and sharedContainer:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
end

function AssetStreaming.Register(Router)
	local ok, xisd = pcall(function()
		return require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("xisd", 30))
	end)
	if not ok or type(xisd) ~= "table" or type(xisd.ser) ~= "function" then
		warn("[AssetStreaming] xisd serializer unavailable: " .. tostring(xisd))
		return
	end
	if not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("xisd_SurfaceAppearances") then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "xisd_SurfaceAppearances"
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	Router.remote("xisd", function(_, kind, name)
		if type(kind) ~= "string" or type(name) ~= "string" or #kind > 32 or #name > 100 then
			return false
		end
		if not ALLOWED_KINDS[kind] then
			return false
		end
		local key = kind .. "/" .. name
		local cached = cache[key]
		if cached then
			return true, cached
		end
		local asset = findAsset(kind, name)
		if not asset then
			return false
		end
		local serialized, data = pcall(xisd.ser, asset)
		if not serialized or type(data) ~= "string" then
			warn(("[AssetStreaming] could not serialize %s: %s"):format(key, tostring(data)))
			return false
		end
		cache[key] = data
		return true, data
	end, { className = "RemoteFunction", requireData = false, rate = 20, burst = 60 })
end

return AssetStreaming

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local aurastats = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("aurastats"))

local combatservice = {}

local statnames = {
	Melee = "Melee",
	Sword = "Sword",
	Gun = "Gun",
	["Demon Fruit"] = "Demon Fruit",
}
local damageperlevel = 0.04
local creatorlifetime = 10

local net = nil
local combatutil = nil
local animations = {}

local function getnet()
	if not net then
		net = require(replicatedstorage.Modules.Net)
	end
	return net
end

local function getcombatutil()
	if not combatutil then
		combatutil = require(replicatedstorage.Modules.CombatUtil)
	end
	return combatutil
end

local function statlevel(player, weapontype)
	local stat = statnames[weapontype]
	local data = player and player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local stats = data and data:FindFirstChild("Stats")
	local folder = stat and stats and stats:FindFirstChild(stat)
	local level = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Level")
	return level and level.Value or 0
end

local function canhurt(attackercharacter, rig)
	if not rig or rig == attackercharacter then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
		return false
	end
	local attacker = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attackercharacter)
	local victim = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(rig)
	if victim and victim:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") then
		return false
	end
	if attacker and victim then
		if attackercharacter:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") ~= false or rig:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") ~= false then
			return false
		end
		if attacker:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") or victim:GetAttribute("InSafeZone") then
			return false
		end
		if attacker.Team and attacker.Team == victim.Team and attacker.Team.Name == "Marines" then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function combatservice:scaledamage(player, weapontype, base)
	if type(base) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	local statscaling = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("statscaling"))
	local character = player and player.Character
	local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local stat = statnames[weapontype] or statscaling.stattype(tool)
	if not stat then
		return base
	end
	return base * statscaling.multiplier(statscaling.effective(player, stat, tool))
end

function combatservice:damagerig(attackercharacter, rig, amount, weaponname, weapontype, hitpart)
	if not canhurt(attackercharacter, rig) or type(amount) ~= "number" or amount <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	amount = aurastats.outgoing(attackercharacter, amount, weapontype)
	amount = aurastats.incoming(rig, amount)
	local before = humanoid.Health
	humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
	if humanoid.Health < before then
		aurastats.record(attackercharacter, rig, weapontype)
	end

	local attacker = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attackercharacter)
	local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if tag then
		tag:Destroy()
	end
	tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	tag.Name = "creator"
	tag.Value = attacker
	tag.Parent = humanoid
	debris:AddItem(tag, creatorlifetime)
	rig:SetAttribute("LastAttacker", attacker and attacker.UserId or 0)

	local remote = getnet():RemoteEvent("ReceivedHit")
	for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= attacker then
			remote:FireClient(player, rig, attackercharacter, weaponname, weapontype, hitpart)
		end
	end
	return true
end

function combatservice:RegisterHit(attackercharacter, hitpart)
	if typeof(attackercharacter) ~= "Instance" or typeof(hitpart) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end
	local util = getcombatutil()
	local rig = util:GetRigOfHitPart(hitpart)
	local tool = util:GetEquippedWeaponTool(attackercharacter) or attackercharacter:FindFirstChild("EquippedWeapon")
	if not rig or not tool then
		return nil
	end
	local name = util:GetWeaponName(tool)
	local data = util:GetWeaponData(name)
	if not data then
		return nil
	end
	local basic = data.Moveset and data.Moveset.Basic
	local damage = basic and basic[1] and basic[1].Damage or data.Damage or 0
	local attacker = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attackercharacter)
	damage = attacker and self:scaledamage(attacker, data.WeaponType, damage) or damage * (attackercharacter:GetAttribute("DamageMultiplier") or 1)
	return self:damagerig(attackercharacter, rig, damage, name, data.WeaponType, hitpart)
end

function combatservice.Attack(attacker, targetcharacter, weaponname, damage)
	local character = typeof(attacker) == "Instance" and (attacker:IsA("Player") and attacker.Character or attacker) or nil
	local data = getcombatutil():GetWeaponData(tostring(weaponname or ""))
	local root = targetcharacter and (targetcharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetcharacter.PrimaryPart)
	return combatservice:damagerig(character, targetcharacter, damage, weaponname, data and data.WeaponType or "Melee", root)
end

function combatservice:RegisterEquipAnimation(player, _, animation)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end
	local source = animation
	if type(animation) == "string" then
		source = animations[animation]
		if not source then
			source = Instance.new("Animation")
			source.AnimationId = animation
			animations[animation] = source
		end
	end
	if typeof(source) ~= "Instance" or not source:IsA("Animation") then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, source)
	return ok and track or nil
end

return combatservice
