local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local util = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"))
local masterclock = util.MasterClock

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))

local basecooldown = table.clone(data.Cooldown)

local kit
local form = "base"
local formbefore = "base"
local combo, lastm1 = 0, 0
local hold = nil
local healthconnection, lasthealth = nil, nil
local soar = nil
local dragon = nil

local function isnpc(model)
	return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) == nil
end

local function rootof(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function enemyof(character, model)
	if model == character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if isnpc(model) then
		return true
	end
	return character:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false and model:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false
end

local function stun(model, duration)
	local value = model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if not value or not value:IsA("ValueBase") then
		return
	end
	value.Value = math.max(value.Value, duration)
	if isnpc(model) then
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if value.Parent and value.Value <= duration then
				value.Value = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function spend(character, cost)
	local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	if not energy or not cost or cost <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if energy.Value < cost then
		return false
	end
	energy.Value -= cost
	return true
end

local function enemiesnear(character, position, radius, callback)
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, root)
		if enemyof(character, model) and (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
			callback(model, humanoid, root)
		end
	end)
end

local function blast(character, position, radius, amount, stunfor)
	local hits = {}
	enemiesnear(character, position, radius, function(model, humanoid, root)
		if kit:hit(humanoid, amount, root) then
			table.insert(hits, model)
			if stunfor then
				stun(model, stunfor)
			end
		end
	end)
	return hits
end

local function drivenpc(victimroot, duration, path, onfinish)
	local npc = isnpc(victimroot.Parent)
	local wasanchored = victimroot.Anchored
	if npc then
		victimroot.Anchored = true
	end
	local started = os.clock()
	local connection
	connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - started
		if not victimroot.Parent or elapsed >= duration then
			connection:Disconnect()
			if victimroot.Parent then
				if npc then
					victimroot.CFrame = path(1)
					victimroot.Anchored = wasanchored
				end
				if onfinish then
					onfinish()
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if npc then
			victimroot.CFrame = path(elapsed / duration)
		end
	end)
end

local function worldparams(character)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
	return params
end

local function worldhit(character, from, to)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, worldparams(character))
	if result then
		return result.Position, result.Normal, result.Instance
	end
	return to, Vector3.yAxis, nil
end

local function burn(model, ticks, amount)
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, ticks do
			task.wait(1)
			local humanoid = model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			kit:hit(humanoid, amount, rootof(model))
		end
	end)
end

local function base(player, root, extra)
	local params = { player = player, Player = player, Root = root, hrp = root }
	for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do
		params[k] = v
	end
	return params
end

local function dragontype(player)
	local fruit = player and player:FindFirstChild("Data") and player.Data:FindFirstChild("DevilFruit")
	local value = fruit and fruit:GetAttribute("DragonType")
	if value ~= "East" and value ~= "West" then
		value = tool:GetAttribute("DragonType")
	end
	if value ~= "East" and value ~= "West" then
		value = "West"
	end
	if fruit and fruit:GetAttribute("DragonType") ~= value then
		fruit:SetAttribute("DragonType", value)
	end
	return value
end

local function rage()
	return kit:ragevalue()
end

local function setrage(amount)
	local value = rage()
	if value then
		value.Value = math.clamp(amount, 0, 100)
	end
end

local function addrage(amount)
	local value = rage()
	if value then
		setrage(value.Value + amount)
	end
end

local function ishybrid()
	return form == "hybrid"
end

local function hybridscale(a, b)
	return ishybrid() and b or a
end

local function aimcframe(root)
	local aim = kit:aim(root)
	return CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, aim.target), aim
end

local function forcerelease(token, after)
	task.delay(after, function()
		if hold == token and kit.active and kit.active.key == token.key then
			kit:release(token.player, token.character, token.root, token.key)
		end
	end)
end

local hybridstowed = false

local function sethybrid(character, root, player, enabled)
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild("DragonHybrid")
	if enabled then
		if not existing then
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = "DragonHybrid"
			folder:SetAttribute("Scaler", 1)
			folder.Parent = character
		end
		kit:play("Dragon2.Hybrid.Transform", { ID = 1, Root = root, player = player })
		kit:play("Dragon2.Hybrid.State", { ID = 1, Character = character, Scaler = 1, player = player })
		form = "hybrid"
	else
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
		kit:play("Dragon2.Hybrid.Untransform", { ID = 1, Root = root, player = player })
		kit:play("Dragon2.Hybrid.State", { ID = 2, Character = character, player = player })
		form = "base"
	end
end

local function m1(player, character, root)
	if os.clock() - lastm1 > data.m1.reset then
		combo = 0
	end
	lastm1 = os.clock()
	local maxcombo = hybridscale(data.m1.combo, data.m1.hybridcombo)
	combo = combo % maxcombo + 1
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector)
	kit:play("Dragon2.M1", base(player, root, {
		Combo = combo,
		MaxCombo = maxcombo,
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
		CFrame = facing,
	}))
	local range = hybridscale(data.m1.range, data.m1.hybridrange)
	local radius = hybridscale(data.m1.radius, data.m1.hybridradius)
	local amount = hybridscale(data.damage.m1, data.damage.m1hybrid) * (combo == maxcombo and 1.4 or 1)
	task.delay(0.12, function()
		if not root.Parent then
			return
		end
		local center = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * range
		for _, model in ipairs(blast(character, center, radius, amount, 0.35)) do
			if ishybrid() then
				burn(model, 1, amount * 0.25)
			end
		end
	end)
	if combo == maxcombo then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.45
	end
end

local function zstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	token.zstart = masterclock:GetTime()
	token.zclock = os.clock()
	kit:play("Dragon2.Z", {
		player = player,
		ID = 1,
		Head = character:FindFirstChild("Head"),
		HoldValue = kit.effectholding,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		Start = token.zstart,
		Charge = data.z.charge,
		WindUp = data.z.windup,
		Offset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.5),
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
		SuperCharge = false,
	})
	forcerelease(token, data.z.maxhold)
end

local function zfire(token, aim)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
	local held = math.clamp((os.clock() - (token.zclock or os.clock())) / data.z.charge, 0, 1)
	local range = hybridscale(data.z.range, data.z.hybridrange) * (1 + (data.z.heldrange - 1) * held)
	local origin = head.Position
	local target = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, range)
	if (target - origin).Magnitude < 1 then
		target = origin + root.CFrame.LookVector * range
	end
	local direction = (target - origin).Unit
	local hitpos, normal, instance = worldhit(character, origin, origin + direction * range)
	local victim = kit:firstalong(character, origin, hitpos, data.z.beamradius)
	local explosion = victim and victim.Position or hitpos
	local life = data.z.life
	kit:play("Dragon2.Z", {
		player = player,
		ID = 2,
		Head = head,
		Character = character,
		CFrame = head.CFrame,
		ExplosionPosition = explosion,
		Offset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.5),
		Scale = hybridscale(1, 1.6) + held,
		chargeTime = held,
		SpawnTime = masterclock:GetTime(),
		Life = life,
		Distance = range,
		RayData = { Hit = victim or instance, Norm = normal },
		SuperCharge = held >= 1 and 1 or nil,
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	local amount = data.damage.z + (data.damage.zheld - data.damage.z) * held
	local travel = (explosion - origin).Magnitude / math.max(range, 1) * life
	task.delay(travel, function()
		kit:damagealong(character, origin, explosion, data.z.beamradius, amount * 0.25)
		local radius = hybridscale(data.z.radius, data.z.hybridradius) * (1 + held * 0.4)
		for _, model in ipairs(blast(character, explosion, radius, amount * 0.75, 0.8)) do
			local victimroot = rootof(model)
			if victimroot and isnpc(model) and not victimroot.Anchored then
				victimroot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (victimroot.Position - explosion).Unit * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
	addrage(-data.fury.z)
end

local function xstart(token)
	local player, character = token.player, token.character
	kit:play("Dragon2.X", {
		player = player,
		ID = 1,
		Character = character,
		HoldValue = kit.effectholding,
		ChargeTime = data.x.charge,
	})
	forcerelease(token, data.x.maxhold)
end

local function xthrow(player, character, root, victimmodel, aim)
	local victimroot = rootof(victimmodel)
	local victimhumanoid = victimmodel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not victimroot or not victimhumanoid then
		return
	end
	local origin = victimroot.Position
	local target = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, data.x.throwrange)
	local hitpos, normal = worldhit(character, origin, origin + (target - origin).Unit * data.x.throwrange)
	if (target - origin).Magnitude < 1 then
		hitpos, normal = worldhit(character, origin, origin + root.CFrame.LookVector * data.x.throwrange)
	end
	local landing = hitpos + normal * 3
	kit:play("Dragon2.X", {
		player = player,
		Player = player,
		ID = 4,
		Hit = true,
		Pos = landing,
		Norm = normal,
		Origin = origin,
		Root = victimroot,
		FlightDuration = data.x.flight,
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
	})
	local rotation = victimroot.CFrame.Rotation
	drivenpc(victimroot, data.x.flight, function(alpha)
		return rotation + origin:Lerp(landing, alpha)
	end, function()
		local amount = data.damage.ximpact * (ishybrid() and 1.2 or 1)
		kit:hit(victimhumanoid, amount, victimroot)
		blast(character, landing, data.x.impactradius, amount * 0.35, 0.6)
		stun(victimmodel, 1.2)
		burn(victimmodel, 2, data.damage.xburn)
	end)
end

local function xdash(token, aim)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local look = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, aim.target)
	local duration = hybridscale(data.x.duration, data.x.hybridduration)
	local speed = hybridscale(data.x.speed, data.x.hybridspeed)
	local started = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	kit:play("Dragon2.X", {
		player = player,
		ID = 2,
		Character = character,
		Time = started,
		Look = look,
		Duration = duration,
		DashSpeed = speed,
		Height = data.x.height,
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.3
	addrage(-data.fury.x)
	local radius = hybridscale(data.x.radius, data.x.hybridradius)
	task.spawn(function()
		local stop = os.clock() + duration + 0.15
		local last = root.Position
		while os.clock() < stop and root.Parent do
			local now = root.Position
			local victim = kit:firstalong(character, last, now + look.LookVector * 3, radius)
			last = now
			if victim then
				local model = victim.Parent
				local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.xgrab, victim) then
					stun(model, data.x.drag + data.x.throwdelay + data.x.flight + 0.4)
					kit:play("Dragon2.X", {
						player = player,
						ID = 3,
						Character = character,
						VictimCharacter = model,
						Time = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
						Duration = data.x.drag,
						ThrowDelay = data.x.throwdelay,
						CaughtPos = victim.Position,
						UserLook = root.CFrame.LookVector,
						UserMouse = kit.mousepos,
						DashSpeed = speed,
						Hybrid = ishybrid(),
					})
					kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + data.x.drag + data.x.throwdelay + 0.3
					drivenpc(victim, data.x.drag + data.x.throwdelay, function()
						return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
					end, function()
						xthrow(player, character, root, model, kit:aim(root))
					end)
					return
				end
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

local function cstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	kit:play("Dragon2.C", { ID = 1, player = player, Position = root.Position, Root = root, Hybrid = ishybrid() })
	addrage(-data.fury.c)
	local hybrid = ishybrid()
	task.delay(data.c.jump, function()
		if hold ~= token or not root.Parent then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local holdmax = hybrid and data.c.hybridholdmax or data.c.holdmax
		local life = data.c.life
		local deviation = hybrid and data.c.hybriddeviation or data.c.deviation
		local distance = math.clamp((kit.mousepos.Value - root.Position).Magnitude, 30, 160)
		kit:play("Dragon2.C", {
			ID = 2,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
			Mouse = kit.mousepos,
			Humanoid = humanoid,
			Timestamp = masterclock:GetTime(),
			Life = life,
			Dist = distance,
			Devi = deviation,
			Dely = 0,
			HoldMin = data.c.holdmin,
			HoldMax = holdmax,
			Hybrid = hybrid,
		})
		forcerelease(token, holdmax)
		local started = os.clock()
		local taken = {}
		local cap = data.damage.cfireball * (holdmax / (hybrid and data.c.hybridinterval or data.c.interval)) * data.c.capfraction * 0.35
		local spent = data.fury.c
		local maxspend = hybrid and data.fury.cmaxhybrid or data.fury.cmax
		local interval = hybrid and data.c.hybridinterval or data.c.interval
		local radius = hybrid and data.c.hybridradius or data.c.radius
		while root.Parent and os.clock() - started <= holdmax and (os.clock() - started < data.c.holdmin or kit.effectholding.Value) do
			local aimpos = kit.mousepos.Value
			local flat = (aimpos - root.Position)
			local direction = flat.Magnitude > 1 and flat.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
			local point = root.Position + direction * distance + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * deviation, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * deviation)
			local impact = worldhit(character, point + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0), point - Vector3.new(0, 80, 0))
			task.delay(life, function()
				enemiesnear(character, impact, radius, function(model, victimhumanoid, victimroot)
					local dealt = taken[model] or 0
					local amount = data.damage.cfireball * (hybrid and 1.25 or 1)
					if dealt >= cap then
						amount *= data.c.reduced
					end
					if kit:hit(victimhumanoid, amount, victimroot) then
						taken[model] = dealt + amount
						stun(model, 0.4)
						if spent < maxspend then
							spent += data.fury.cperfireball
							addrage(-data.fury.cperfireball)
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
			task.wait(interval)
		end
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.4
	end)
end

local function endsoar()
	local current = soar
	if not current then
		return
	end
	soar = nil
	if current.marker and current.marker.Parent then
		current.marker:Destroy()
	end
	if current.root and current.root.Parent then
		kit:play("Dragon2.Wings", { HRP = current.root, Enabled = false, player = current.player })
	end
end

local function soargrab(current, model, victimroot)
	local player, character, root = current.player, current.character, current.root
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	current.caught = true
	stun(model, data.f.carry + 0.8)
	local victimplayer = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	kit:play("Dragon2.F", {
		Root = root,
		Player = player,
		Stage = 2,
		Caught = model,
		VictimPlayers = victimplayer and { victimplayer } or {},
		Iterations = data.f.iterations,
		Look = root.CFrame,
		Hybrid = ishybrid(),
	})
	local ticks = 5
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, ticks do
			if not model.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				break
			end
			kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.f, victimroot)
			task.wait(data.f.carry / ticks)
		end
		if model.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.fslash, victimroot)
			if isnpc(model) and not victimroot.Anchored then
				victimroot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 80 + Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
	drivenpc(victimroot, data.f.carry, function()
		return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1, -5)
	end)
end

local function fstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	endsoar()
	addrage(-data.fury.f)
	kit:play("Dragon2.F", { Root = root, Player = player, Stage = 0, Hybrid = ishybrid() })
	kit:play("Dragon2.Wings", { HRP = root, Enabled = true, player = player })
	local marker = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	marker.Name = "DragonSoar"
	marker:SetAttribute("Speed", data.f.speed * (ishybrid() and 1.1 or 1))
	marker:SetAttribute("DiveSpeed", data.f.divespeed * (ishybrid() and 1.1 or 1))
	marker.Parent = root
	local current = { player = player, character = character, root = root, marker = marker, started = os.clock(), token = token }
	soar = current
	task.delay(0.2, function()
		if soar ~= current or not root.Parent then
			return
		end
		kit:play("Dragon2.F", { Root = root, Player = player, Stage = 1, Look = root.CFrame, Hybrid = ishybrid() })
	end)
	forcerelease(token, data.f.maxhold)
	task.spawn(function()
		while soar == current and root.Parent do
			if not current.caught then
				local found = nil
				enemiesnear(character, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 3, data.f.grabradius, function(model, _, victimroot)
					if not found then
						found = { model, victimroot }
					end
				end)
				if found then
					soargrab(current, found[1], found[2])
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end

local function basehold(player, character, root, key)
	local token = { key = key, player = player, character = character, root = root }
	hold = token
	if key == "Z" then
		zstart(token)
	elseif key == "X" then
		xstart(token)
	elseif key == "C" then
		cstart(token)
	elseif key == "F" then
		fstart(token)
	end
end

local function baserelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	local token = hold
	hold = nil
	if not token or token.key ~= key then
		return
	end
	if key == "Z" then
		zfire(token, aim)
	elseif key == "X" then
		xdash(token, aim)
	elseif key == "C" then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.3
	elseif key == "F" then
		local current = soar
		task.delay(current and current.caught and 0.3 or 0.05, function()
			if soar == current then
				endsoar()
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function watchhealth(character)
	if healthconnection then
		healthconnection:Disconnect()
		healthconnection = nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	lasthealth = humanoid.Health
	healthconnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		local loss = (lasthealth or health) - health
		lasthealth = health
		if loss <= 0 or health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local reduction = form == "dragon" and data.defense.dragon or (form == "hybrid" and data.defense.hybrid or 0)
		if reduction > 0 then
			humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, health + loss * reduction)
			lasthealth = humanoid.Health
		end
	end)
end

local function setcooldowns(kind)
	local source = kind and data.TransformedCooldown[kind] or basecooldown
	for key, value in pairs(source) do
		data.Cooldown[key] = value
	end
end

local dragonmodule = script:FindFirstChild("dragonform") and require(script.dragonform) or nil

local function imperial(player, character, root, humanoid)
	local value = rage()
	local fury = value and value.Value or 0
	if form == "dragon" then
		if dragonmodule then
			dragonmodule.untransform(false)
		end
		return
	end
	if fury >= data.fury.dragonneed and dragonmodule then
		formbefore = form
		if dragonmodule.transform(player, character, root, humanoid, dragontype(player)) then
			addrage(-data.fury.dragoncost)
		end
		return
	end
	if form == "hybrid" then
		sethybrid(character, root, player, false)
		return
	end
	if fury >= data.fury.hybridneed then
		sethybrid(character, root, player, true)
		addrage(-data.fury.hybridcost)
	end
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true, F = true },
	maxhold = 8,
	canhold = function(player, character, root, key)
		if form == "dragon" then
			return dragonmodule ~= nil and dragonmodule.canhold(key)
		end
		return spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(player, character, root, key)
		if form == "dragon" then
			dragonmodule.holdstart(player, character, root, key)
			return
		end
		basehold(player, character, root, key)
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key, aim)
		if form == "dragon" then
			dragonmodule.release(player, character, root, key, aim)
			return
		end
		baserelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	end,
	onm1 = function(player, character, root, humanoid)
		if form == "dragon" then
			dragonmodule.m1(player, character, root)
			return
		end
		m1(player, character, root)
	end,
	onkey = function(player, character, root, humanoid, key, argument)
		if key == "V" then
			if not kit:canuse(character, "V") or not spend(character, data.Cost.V) then
				return
			end
			kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
			imperial(player, character, root, humanoid)
		elseif key == "TAPEND" and form == "dragon" then
			dragonmodule.m1end()
		end
	end,
	onhit = function(amount)
		local gain = form == "dragon" and data.fury.dragongainperdamage or data.fury.gainperdamage
		addrage(amount * gain)
	end,
	onequip = function(player, character)
		dragontype(player)
		local root = rootof(character)
		if hybridstowed and root and form == "base" then
			hybridstowed = false
			sethybrid(character, root, player, true)
		end
		hybridstowed = false
	end,
	onunequip = function(owner)
		endsoar()
		hold = nil
		local character = owner and owner.Character
		local root = character and rootof(character)
		if form == "hybrid" and root then
			sethybrid(character, root, owner, false)
			hybridstowed = true
		end
	end,
	onpassivestart = function(player, character)
		dragontype(player)
		watchhealth(character)
		local value = kit:ragevalue(character)
		if value then
			value.Value = math.clamp(value.Value, 0, 100)
		end
	end,
	onpassiveend = function(character)
		endsoar()
		if dragonmodule and form == "dragon" then
			dragonmodule.untransform(true)
		end
		local root = rootof(character)
		if character:FindFirstChild("DragonHybrid") and root then
			sethybrid(character, root, players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character), false)
		end
		hybridstowed = false
		form = "base"
		setcooldowns(nil)
		if healthconnection then
			healthconnection:Disconnect()
			healthconnection = nil
		end
	end,
})

if dragonmodule then
	dragonmodule.init({
		kit = kit,
		data = data,
		tool = tool,
		helpers = {
			isnpc = isnpc,
			rootof = rootof,
			enemyof = enemyof,
			stun = stun,
			spend = spend,
			enemiesnear = enemiesnear,
			blast = blast,
			drivenpc = drivenpc,
			worldhit = worldhit,
			burn = burn,
			addrage = addrage,
			setrage = setrage,
			rage = rage,
			sethybrid = sethybrid,
			setcooldowns = setcooldowns,
		},
		getform = function()
			return form
		end,
		setform = function(value)
			form = value
		end,
		getformbefore = function()
			return formbefore
		end,
	})
end

task.spawn(function()
	local step = 0.25
	while true do
		task.wait(step)
		local character = kit:getcharacter() or (kit.passivecharacter and kit.passivecharacter.Parent and kit.passivecharacter)
		local value = character and character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
		if value then
			if form == "base" and value.Value < data.fury.hybridneed then
				value.Value = math.min(data.fury.hybridneed, value.Value + data.fury.orangeregen * step)
			elseif form == "dragon" then
				value.Value = math.max(0, value.Value - data.fury.dragondrain * step)
				if value.Value <= 0 and dragonmodule then
					dragonmodule.untransform(false)
				end
			end
		end
		if soar and not soar.root.Parent then
			endsoar()
		end
	end
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local util = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"))
local masterclock = util.MasterClock

local dragonform = {}

local kit, data, tool, h
local getform, setform, getformbefore
local state = nil
local hold = nil
local breath = nil
local fuel = 1
local relayready = false
local trailing = nil

local rigs = serverstorage:WaitForChild("Rigs")

local function now()
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function value(parent, class, name, initial)
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing.ClassName == class then
		if initial ~= nil then
			existing.Value = initial
		end
		return existing
	end
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local v = Instance.new(class)
	v.Name = name
	if initial ~= nil then
		v.Value = initial
	end
	v.Parent = parent
	return v
end

local function buildstate()
	local folder = tool:FindFirstChild("EasternState")
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "EasternState"

	local x = value(folder, "BoolValue", "XSpiralActive", false)
	value(x, "NumberValue", "TIME_SPIRALLING", 1.6)
	value(x, "NumberValue", "TIME_UNTIL_IMPACT", 0.45)
	value(x, "Vector3Value", "Origin", Vector3.zero)
	value(x, "Vector3Value", "ImpactPosition", Vector3.zero)

	local v = value(folder, "BoolValue", "VActive", false)
	value(v, "NumberValue", "V_ANIMATION_LASTS_FOR", 2.2)
	value(v, "CFrameValue", "Origin", CFrame.new())
	value(v, "CFrameValue", "Impact", CFrame.new())

local function headaim()

local function ground(character, position, depth)
	local hitpos, normal, instance = h.worldhit(character, position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0), position - Vector3.new(0, depth or 600, 0))
	return hitpos, normal, instance
end

local function setbusy(character, busy)
	local value = character:FindFirstChild("Busy")
	if value and value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		value.Value = busy
	end
end

local function hidebody(character, hidden)
	if hidden then
		state.hidden = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local ofdragon = (state.rig and d:IsDescendantOf(state.rig)) or (state.model and d:IsDescendantOf(state.model)) or (state.mover and d:IsDescendantOf(state.mover))
			if not ofdragon and (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
				state.hidden[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	else
		for d, t in pairs(state.hidden or {}) do
			if d.Parent then
				d.Transparency = t
			end
		end
		state.hidden = {}
	end
end

local function connectrelay()
	if relayready then
		return
	end
	relayready = true
	local function owner(player)
		return state and state.player == player
	end
	local function others(player, remote, ...)
		for _, other in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
			if other ~= player then
				remote:FireClient(other, ...)
			end
		end
	end
	local cframevalue = tool:WaitForChild("DragonCFrameWithoutOffset")
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonCFrameRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cf)
		if not owner(player) or typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then
			return
		end
		cframevalue.Value = cf
		others(player, tool.DragonCFrameRemote, cf)
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonTrailingPositionsRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, first, buffered)
		if not owner(player) or typeof(first) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(buffered) ~= "buffer" then
			return
		end
		trailing = { first, buffered }
		others(player, tool.DragonTrailingPositionsRemote, first, buffered)
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonSetupRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, setup)
		if setup ~= true or not state or state.kind ~= "East" then
			return
		end
		local first = trailing and trailing[1] or (state.mover and state.mover.Handle.Position) or Vector3.zero
		local buffered = trailing and trailing[2] or buffer.create(29 * 6)
		tool.DragonTrailingPositionsRemote:FireClient(player, first, buffered)
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonIdleRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, idle)
		if owner(player) and type(idle) == "boolean" then
			tool.IsIdle.Value = idle
		end
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonHaloCurrentSpeed").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, speed)
		if owner(player) and type(speed) == "number" then
			tool.HaloCurrentSpeed.Value = speed
		end
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonHeadAimRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, direction)
		if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or player ~= kit:getowner() then
			return
		end
		local aim = headaim()
		if aim then
			aim.Value = direction
			aim.LastHeadAimUpdate.Value = now()
		end
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("AccumulatedInputTimeRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, amount)
		if owner(player) and type(amount) == "number" and state.script then
			state.script.AccumulatedInputTime.Value = amount
		end
	end)
	tool:WaitForChild("DragonCollisionVFXRemote").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cf)
		if owner(player) and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
			kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.WallCollision", { player = player, cf = cf })
		end
	end)
	local camera = tool:FindFirstChild("CameraCFrameRemote")
	if camera then
		camera.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cf)
			if owner(player) and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
				tool.CameraCFrame.Value = cf
			end
		end)
	end
	pcall(function()
		require(replicatedstorage.EffectContainer.Dragon2.Controllers.DragonFlight)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("DragonAim"))
	end)
end

local function headpart()
	if not state then
		return nil
	end
	if state.kind == "West" then
		return state.rig and (state.rig:FindFirstChild("HeadProxy") or state.rig.RootPart)
	end
	return state.model and (state.model:FindFirstChild("HeadProxy") or state.model.RootPart)
end

local function dragonmodel()
	if state and state.kind == "East" then
		return state.model
	end
	return nil
end

local function aimdirection(root)
	local aim = tool:FindFirstChild("HeadAim")
	if aim and aim:FindFirstChild("LastHeadAimUpdate") and now() - aim.LastHeadAimUpdate.Value < 1 and aim.Value.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		return aim.Value.Unit
	end
	local origin = (headpart() or root).Position
	local target = kit.mousepos.Value
	if (target - origin).Magnitude < 1 then
		return root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	return (target - origin).Unit
end

local function cone(character, origin, direction, range, width, amount)
	local hits = {}
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, root)
		if not h.enemyof(character, model) then
			return
		end
		local offset = root.Position - origin
		local t = offset:Dot(direction)
		if t < 0 or t > range then
			return
		end
		local spread = width * (0.35 + 0.65 * t / range)
		if (origin + direction * t - root.Position).Magnitude <= spread then
			if kit:hit(humanoid, amount, root) then
				table.insert(hits, model)
			end
		end
	end)
	return hits
end

local function buildwest(player, character, root, humanoid)
	local holder = Instance.new("Model")
	holder.Name = "WesternDragonRig"
	local rig = rigs.WesternDragon:Clone()
	rig.Name = "Rig"
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.Massless = true
		end
	end
	rig.Parent = holder
	rig:PivotTo(root.CFrame)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "DragonWeld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = rig.RootPart
	weld.Parent = rig.RootPart
	rig:SetAttribute("Loaded", true)
	holder.Parent = character
	state.rig = rig
	state.holder = holder
	state.hipheight = humanoid.HipHeight
	state.walkspeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	state.jumppower = humanoid.JumpPower
	humanoid.HipHeight = 42.5 - root.Size.Y / 2
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 40
	tool.TransformedRigObject.Value = rig
end

local function buildeast(player, character, root, humanoid)
	state.script = buildstate()
	local mover = rigs.DragonMover:Clone()
	mover.Name = "DragonMover"

	goal.Name = "DragonGoal" .. player.UserId
	goal.WorldCFrame = root.CFrame
	goal.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local handle = mover.Handle
	handle.AlignPosition.Attachment1 = goal
	handle.AlignOrientation.Attachment1 = goal
	handle.GoalAttach.Value = goal
	humanoid:AddAccessory(mover)
	local headbox = Instance.new("Part")
	headbox.Name = "DragonDamageHeadPart"

	headbox.CanCollide = false
	headbox.CanTouch = false
	headbox.CanQuery = true

	headbox.CFrame = handle.CFrame
	local headweld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	headweld.Part0 = handle
	headweld.Part1 = headbox
	headweld.Parent = headbox
	headbox.Parent = character

	trailing = nil
	tool.TransformedRigObject.Value = model
	tool.IsIdle.Value = true
	tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value = root.CFrame
	return handle
end

function dragonform.transform(player, character, root, humanoid, kind)
	if state or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	connectrelay()
	state = { kind = kind, player = player, character = character, root = root, humanoid = humanoid, hidden = {} }
	setform("dragon")
	fuel = 1
	h.setcooldowns(kind)
	local marker = Instance.new("Folder")
	marker.Name = "Dragon"
	marker.Parent = character
	state.marker = marker
	tool.IsTransformed.Value = true
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1.6

	if kind == "West" then
		kit:play("Dragon2.V", { player = player, hrp = root, Character = character, SizeMultiplier = 1.5 })
		task.delay(0.25, function()
			if not state or state.player ~= player then
				return
			end
			buildwest(player, character, root, humanoid)
			hidebody(character, true)
		end)
		task.delay(0.35, function()
			h.blast(character, root.Position, 45, data.damage.transformwest, 1)
		end)
	else
		local origin = root.CFrame
		local flyup = 100
		local handle = buildeast(player, character, root, humanoid)
		local impactpos = ground(character, origin.Position + origin.LookVector * 60)
		local s = state.script
		s.VActive.Origin.Value = origin + Vector3.new(0, flyup, 0)
		s.VActive.Impact.Value = CFrame.new(impactpos)
		s.VActive.RootOrigin.Value = origin
		hidebody(character, true)
		kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.Transform", { player = player, hrp = root, flyUpBy = flyup })
		kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.ReplicateBody", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			dragonPart = handle,
			collisionPart = state.mover.CylinderCollision,
			easternDragon = state.model,
			scriptInstance = s,
		})
		s.VActive.Value = true
		task.delay(s.VActive.V_ANIMATION_LASTS_FOR.Value, function()
			if not state or state.script ~= s then
				return
			end
			s.VActive.Value = false
			local fe = s.FMidAirEndActive
			fe.MidAirEndInitCF.Value = CFrame.lookAlong(impactpos + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(origin.LookVector.X, 0, origin.LookVector.Z))
			fe:SetAttribute("FromTransformation", true)
			fe.Value = true
			task.delay(fe.F_MID_AIR_END_ANIMATION_LASTS_FOR.Value, function()
				if state and state.script == s then
					fe.Value = false
					fe:SetAttribute("FromTransformation", nil)
				end
			end)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 5 do
				task.wait(0.3)
				if not state or state.player ~= player then
					return
				end
				local strike = impactpos + Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), 0, math.random(-40, 40))
				h.blast(character, strike, 16, data.damage.transformeast, 0.4)
			end
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function dragonform.untransform(silent)
	local current = state
	if not current then
		return
	end
	dragonform.m1end()
	hold = nil
	local player, character, root, humanoid = current.player, current.character, current.root, current.humanoid
	setbusy(character, false)
	character:SetAttribute("CastingFlamethrower", nil)
	character:SetAttribute("DragonFlightModifier", nil)
	if not silent and root and root.Parent then
		if current.kind == "East" then
			kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.Untransform", { player = player, hrp = root, Character = character, easternDragon = current.model })
		else
			kit:play("Dragon2.Hybrid.Untransform", { ID = 1, Root = root, player = player })
		end
	end
	tool.IsTransformed.Value = false
	tool.TransformedRigObject.Value = nil
	local delay = current.kind == "East" and not silent and 0.6 or 0
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if current.holder then
			current.holder:Destroy()
		end
		if current.mover then
			current.mover:Destroy()
		end
		if current.model then
			current.model:Destroy()
		end
		if current.goal then
			current.goal:Destroy()
		end
		if current.headbox then
			current.headbox:Destroy()
		end
		if current.script then
			current.script:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	if current.marker then
		current.marker:Destroy()
	end
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		if current.hipheight then
			humanoid.HipHeight = current.hipheight
		end
		if current.walkspeed then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = current.walkspeed
		end
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
	if character and character.Parent then
		hidebody(character, false)
	end
	if root and root.Parent then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation
	end
	state = nil
	h.setcooldowns(nil)
	local back = getformbefore()
	if back == "hybrid" and character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent then
		h.sethybrid(character, root, player, true)
	else
		setform("base")
	end
	kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
end

	if key == "C" and state.kind == "West" and state.cbusy then

	return h.spend(state.character, data.Cost[key])

local function westzfire(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local held = math.clamp((os.clock() - (token.zclock or os.clock())) / data.z.charge, 0, 1)
	local head = headpart() or root
	local origin = head.Position
	local direction = aimdirection(root)
	local range = 450 * (1 + held)
	local hitpos, normal, instance = h.worldhit(character, origin, origin + direction * range)
	local victim = kit:firstalong(character, origin, hitpos, 12)
	local explosion = victim and victim.Position or hitpos
	local life = 0.55
	kit:play("Dragon2.Z", {
		player = player,
		ID = 2,
		Head = head,
		Character = character,
		CFrame = head.CFrame,
		ExplosionPosition = explosion,
		Offset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -2),
		Scale = 2 + held * 2,
		chargeTime = held,
		SpawnTime = masterclock:GetTime(),
		Life = life,
		Distance = range,
		RayData = { Hit = victim or instance, Norm = normal },
		SuperCharge = held >= 1 and 2 or nil,
		dragonModel = dragonmodel(),
	})
	if state.kind == "East" then
		state.script.ZActive.Shot.Value = true
	end
	h.addrage(-data.fury.dragonz * (0.5 + held))
	local amount = data.damage.dragonz + (data.damage.dragonzheld - data.damage.dragonz) * held
	local travel = (explosion - origin).Magnitude / math.max(range, 1) * life
	task.delay(travel, function()
		kit:damagealong(character, origin, explosion, 14, amount * 0.2)
		for _, model in ipairs(h.blast(character, explosion, 40 + held * 25, amount * 0.8, 0.6)) do
			local victimroot = h.rootof(model)
			if victimroot and h.isnpc(model) and not victimroot.Anchored then
				victimroot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (victimroot.Position - explosion).Unit * 120 + Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(0.6, function()
		if state and state.character == character then
			setbusy(character, false)
			if state.kind == "East" then
				state.script.ZActive.FullyEnded.Value = true
				state.script.ZActive.DespawnHalo.Value = true
				state.script.ZActive.ZActiveClient.Value = false
				state.script.ZActive.Value = false
				state.script.HeadAimModeActive.Value = false
			end
		end
	end)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
end

local function eastx(token, aim)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local s = state.script
	local origin = root.Position
	local target = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, 220)
	local impact = ground(character, target, 700)
	s.XSpiralActive.Origin.Value = origin
	s.XSpiralActive.ImpactPosition.Value = impact
	local spiral, untilimpact = s.XSpiralActive.TIME_SPIRALLING.Value, s.XSpiralActive.TIME_UNTIL_IMPACT.Value
	s.XSpiralActive.Value = true
	kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.X", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		TIME_UNTIL_IMPACT = untilimpact,
		TIME_SPIRALLING = spiral,
		originCF = CFrame.new(origin),
		impactPosition = impact,
		RAYCAST_DOWN_BY = 70,
	})
	h.addrage(-data.fury.dragonx)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + spiral + untilimpact + 0.3
	local caught = {}
	task.spawn(function()
		local started = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - started < spiral and state and state.script == s do
			local alpha = (os.clock() - started) / spiral
			local center = origin + Vector3.new(0, 140 * alpha, 0)
			h.enemiesnear(character, center, 90, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
				if not caught[model] then
					caught[model] = true
					h.stun(model, spiral + untilimpact + 0.8)
				end
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.eastxspin, victimroot)
			end)
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
		if state and state.script == s then
			s.XSpiralActive.Value = false
		end
		task.wait(untilimpact)
		for _, model in ipairs(h.blast(character, impact, 60, data.damage.eastxslam, 1)) do
			h.burn(model, 2, data.damage.xburn)
		end
		for model in pairs(caught) do
			local victimroot = h.rootof(model)
			if victimroot and victimroot.Parent and h.isnpc(model) then
				victimroot.CFrame = CFrame.new(impact + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), 4, math.random(-12, 12)))
			end
		end
	end)
end

			h.blast(character, strike, 30, data.damage.westcmeteor)
			h.blast(character, landing, 180, data.damage.westcmeteor * 0.25)
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		h.blast(character, landing, 70, data.damage.westcfinal, 1)
		if folder then
			folder:Destroy()
		end
		if state then
			state.cbusy = false
		end
	end)
end

local function eastcstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local s = state.script
	local duration = 4
	s.CActive.C_ANIMATION_LASTS_FOR.Value = duration
	s.CActive.InitCF.Value = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value
	s.CActive.Value = true
	kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.C", {
		player = player,
		Character = character,
		Duration = duration,
		dragonModel = state.model,
		Holding = kit.effectholding,
		DownRayRange = 500,
		AoeRange = 110,
	})
	h.addrage(-data.fury.dragonc)
	token.cstarted = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		local started = os.clock()
		while state and state.script == s and os.clock() - started < duration and (os.clock() - started < 1 or kit.effectholding.Value) do
			local center = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value.Position
			h.blast(character, center, 110, data.damage.eastcstorm)
			task.wait(0.3)
		end
		if state and state.script == s then
			local center = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value.Position
			h.blast(character, center, 90, data.damage.eastcfinal, 1)
			s.CActive.Value = false
		end
	end)
end

local function westfstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local proxy = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	proxy.Name = "WesternFProxy"
	proxy.Value = 0
	proxy.Parent = tool
	token.proxy = proxy
	token.grabbed = false
	local timestamp = now()
	setbusy(character, true)
	character:SetAttribute("DragonFlightModifier", 2.6)
	kit:play("Dragon2.Transformed.F", {
		player = player,
		Root = root,
		Stage = 1,
		Position = kit.mousepos.Value,
		Proxy = proxy,
		Timestamp = timestamp,
	})
	h.addrage(-data.fury.dragonf)
	task.spawn(function()
		local started = os.clock()
		while hold == token and os.clock() - started < 2 and not token.grabbed and root.Parent do
			local front = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 30
			local found
			h.enemiesnear(character, front, 26, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
				if not found then
					found = { model, humanoid, victimroot }
				end
			end)
			if found then
				token.grabbed = true
				dragonform.westfgrab(token, found[1], found[2], found[3])
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end

function dragonform.westfgrab(token, model, humanoid, victimroot)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	if token.proxy then
		token.proxy.Value = 2
	end
	h.stun(model, 2.5)
	kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.westf, victimroot)
	kit:play("Dragon2.Transformed.F", { player = player, Root = root, Stage = 2, Timestamp = now() })
	task.delay(0.45, function()
		local landing, normal = ground(character, victimroot.Position, 400)
		local duration = 0.6
		kit:play("Dragon2.Transformed.F", {
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			Stage = 3,
			Position = landing,
			Normal = normal,
			Height = state and state.humanoid and (state.humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2) or 40,
			Duration = duration,
			Timestamp = now(),
		})
		local start = victimroot.Position
		h.drivenpc(victimroot, duration, function(alpha)
			return CFrame.new(start:Lerp(landing + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), alpha))
		end)
		task.wait(duration)
		h.blast(character, landing, 45, data.damage.westfslam, 1)
		dragonform.westfend(token)
	end)
end

function dragonform.westfend(token)
	if token.ended then
		return
	end
	token.ended = true
	if token.proxy then
		token.proxy.Value = 2
		local proxy = token.proxy
		task.delay(1, function()
			proxy:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if state and state.character then
		setbusy(state.character, false)
		state.character:SetAttribute("DragonFlightModifier", nil)
	end
end

local function eastfstart(token)
	local player, character, root = token.player, token.character, token.root
	local s = state.script
	s.FDrillActive.Value = true
	s.FDrillActive:SetAttribute("Ending", nil)
	kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.F", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		dragonCF = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset,
		FActive = s.FDrillActive,
		DOWNWARD_ANGLE_MAX_OFFSET = s.FDrillActive.DOWNWARD_ANGLE_MAX_OFFSET.Value,
	})
	h.addrage(-data.fury.dragonf)
	token.fstarted = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		local hit = {}
		while hold == token and state and state.script == s and s.FDrillActive.Value and os.clock() - token.fstarted < 4 do
			local cf = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value
			local result = workspace:Raycast(cf.Position, cf.LookVector * 40, (function()
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies") }
				return params
			end)())
			h.enemiesnear(character, cf.Position, 30, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
				if not hit[model] or os.clock() - hit[model] > 0.4 then
					hit[model] = os.clock()
					kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.eastf * 0.35, victimroot)
				end
			end)
			if result and os.clock() - token.fstarted > 0.25 then
				token.fcollided = true
				s.FDrillActive.CollisionPosition.Value = result.Position + result.Normal
				s.FDrillActive:SetAttribute("Ending", now())
				s.FDrillActive.Value = false
				kit:play("Dragon2.TransformedEastern.FImpact", {
					collision = true,
					player = player,
					hrp = root,
					dragonCF = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset,
					rayPosition = result.Position,
					rayNormal = result.Normal,
					rayInstance = result.Instance,
					rayMaterial = result.Material,
				})
				h.blast(character, result.Position, 50, data.damage.eastfcrash, 1)
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end

local function eastfend(token)
	if not state or state.kind ~= "East" then
		return
	end
	local s = state.script
	if token.fcollided or not s.FDrillActive.Value then
		return
	end
	s.FMidAirEndActive.MidAirEndInitCF.Value = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value
	s.FMidAirEndActive:SetAttribute("FromTransformation", nil)
	s.FDrillActive.Value = false
	s.FMidAirEndActive.Value = true
	local center = tool.DragonCFrameWithoutOffset.Value.Position
	task.delay(0.2, function()
		h.blast(state and state.character or token.character, center, 45, data.damage.eastf, 1)
	end)
	task.delay(s.FMidAirEndActive.F_MID_AIR_END_ANIMATION_LASTS_FOR.Value, function()
		if state and state.script == s then
			s.FMidAirEndActive.Value = false
		end
	end)
end

function dragonform.holdstart(player, character, root, key)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local token = { key = key, player = player, character = character, root = root }
	hold = token
	if key == "Z" then
		westz(token)
	elseif key == "C" then
		if state.kind == "West" then
			westcstart(token)
		else
			eastcstart(token)
		end
	elseif key == "F" then
		if state.kind == "West" then
			westfstart(token)
		else
			eastfstart(token)
		end
	end
	local limits = { Z = data.z.maxhold, X = 2, C = state.kind == "West" and 3 or 4, F = state.kind == "West" and 2 or 4 }
	task.delay(limits[key] or 3, function()
		if hold == token and kit.active and kit.active.key == key then
			kit:release(player, character, root, key)
		end
	end)
end

function dragonform.release(player, character, root, key, aim)
	local token = hold
	hold = nil
	if not state or not token or token.key ~= key then
		return
	end
	if key == "Z" then
		westzfire(token)
	elseif key == "X" then
		if state.kind == "West" then
			westx(token, aim)
		else
			eastx(token, aim)
		end
	elseif key == "C" then
		if state.kind == "West" then
			westcfire(token, aim)
		else
			kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.3
		end
	elseif key == "F" then
		if state.kind == "West" then
			if not token.grabbed then
				dragonform.westfend(token)
			end
		else
			eastfend(token)
		end
	end
end

local breathvalue = nil

function dragonform.m1(player, character, root)
	if not state or breath then
		return
	end
	if fuel < 0.1 then
		return
	end
	if not breathvalue or not breathvalue.Parent then
		breathvalue = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		breathvalue.Name = "BreathHolding"
		breathvalue.Parent = tool
	end
	breathvalue.Value = true
	local current = { started = os.clock(), startfuel = fuel }
	breath = current
	character:SetAttribute("CastingFlamethrower", true)
	if state.kind == "East" then
		state.script.HeadAimModeActive.Value = true
	end
	local head = headpart() or root
	kit:play("Dragon2.Transformed.M1", {
		position = head.Position,
		MaxDistance = 100,
		Character = character,
		player = player,
		dragonModel = dragonmodel(),
		Head = head,
		Mouse = kit.mousepos,
		headAim = headaim(),
		FadeIn = 0.25,
		Lifetime = 2 * fuel,
		FadeOut = 1.5,
		percentageofMax = fuel,
		realMaxDistance = 100,
		Holding = breathvalue,
	})
	task.spawn(function()
		while breath == current and state and root.Parent do
			local elapsed = os.clock() - current.started
			fuel = math.max(0, current.startfuel - elapsed / 2)
			local strength = fuel > 0 and 1 or math.max(0.2, 1 - (elapsed - current.startfuel * 2) / 1.5)
			local origin = (headpart() or root).Position
			local direction = aimdirection(root)
			local hits = cone(character, origin, direction, 100 * strength, 14, data.damage.breath)
			if #hits == 0 then
				h.addrage(-data.fury.breathpersecond * 0.15)
			end
			if strength <= 0.2 and elapsed > 4 then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
		if breath == current then
			dragonform.m1end()
		end
	end)
end

function dragonform.m1end()
	if not breath then
		return
	end
	breath = nil
	if breathvalue then
		breathvalue.Value = false
	end
	if state then
		if state.character then
			state.character:SetAttribute("CastingFlamethrower", nil)
		end
		if state.kind == "East" and state.script then
			state.script.HeadAimModeActive.Value = false
		end
	end
end

function dragonform.init(context)
	kit = context.kit
	data = context.data
	tool = context.tool
	h = context.helpers
	getform = context.getform
	setform = context.setform
	getformbefore = context.getformbefore
	headaim()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.25)
			if not breath and fuel < 1 then
				fuel = math.min(1, fuel + 0.25 * 0.25)
			end
			if state and state.humanoid and state.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				dragonform.untransform(true)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return dragonform

local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local kit
local holdstarted = {}

local function meteortackle(player, character, root, aim)
	local direction = (aim.target - root.Position)
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z))
	kit:play("Combat2V2.Z", { plr = player, hrp = root, CFrame = root.CFrame, mouse = aim.target })
	local hit = {}
	meleekit.dash(character, root, direction, data.Tackle.Speed, data.Tackle.Duration, nil, function()
		for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, root.Position + direction * 2, data.Tackle.Radius)) do
			if not hit[target.model] and meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				hit[target.model] = true
				if kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.Z, target.root) then
					meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.45)
					meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 60, 20)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function rockpoints(character, origin, count, radius)
	local points = {}
	for index = 1, count do
		local angle = (index / count) * math.pi * 2
		local flat = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		local ground = meleekit.ground(character, flat)
		table.insert(points, { Ground = ground, Float = ground + Vector3.new(0, 10 + (index % 3) * 3, 0) })
	end
	return points
end

local function groundbreaker(player, character, root)
	local airborne = not meleekit.grounded(character, root)
	local origin = meleekit.ground(character, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 6)
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + root.CFrame.LookVector)
	local key = tostring(player.UserId) .. "_" .. tostring(os.clock())
	local points = rockpoints(character, origin, 8, data.Breaker.Radius * 0.6)
	local victims = {}
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, origin, data.Breaker.Radius)) do
		if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			table.insert(victims, target)
		end
	end
	local miss = #victims == 0
	local start = meleekit.now()
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.8
	kit:play("Combat2V2.X", {
		Stage = "Cast",
		Origin = origin,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Points = points,
		StartTime = start,
		Rise = 0.35,
		RockKey = key,
		Miss = miss,
		Airborne = airborne,
	})
	if miss then
		task.delay(0.9, function()
			kit:play("Combat2V2.X", { Stage = "Drop", Origin = origin, RockKey = key })
		end)
		return
	end
	local models = {}
	local releases = {}
	for _, target in ipairs(victims) do
		table.insert(models, target.model)
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.X * 0.4, target.root)
		meleekit.stun(target.model, 2)
		table.insert(releases, meleekit.hold(target, nil, 2))
	end
	local sequence = {}
	local elapsed = 0
	for index = 1, math.min(#points, 5) do
		elapsed += 0.16
		table.insert(sequence, { Index = index, Time = elapsed })
	end
	local landing = origin + root.CFrame.LookVector * 10
	task.delay(0.4, function()
		kit:play("Combat2V2.X", {
			Stage = "Bounce",
			Origin = origin,
			Points = points,
			Victims = models,
			RockKey = key,
			Sequence = sequence,
			StartTime = meleekit.now(),
			Landing = landing,
		})
		for index = 1, #sequence do
			task.wait(0.16)
			for _, target in ipairs(victims) do
				if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
					kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.X * 0.1, target.root)
				end
			end
		end
		local lastpoint = points[sequence[#sequence].Index]
		kit:play("Combat2V2.X", {
			Stage = "Slam",
			Origin = origin,
			CFrame = CFrame.new(landing),
			Victims = models,
			Landing = landing,
			From = lastpoint and lastpoint.Float or landing + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0),
			Fall = 0.13,
			StartTime = meleekit.now(),
			RockKey = key,
		})
		task.wait(0.13)
		for _, release in ipairs(releases) do
			release()
		end
		for _, target in ipairs(victims) do
			if target.root and target.root.Parent then
				target.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(landing + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			end
			if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.X * 0.3, target.root)
				meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.6)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function chargedpunch(player, character, root, held)
	local power = math.clamp(1 + math.floor(held / data.Punch.ChargeStep), 1, 3)
	local direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local origin = root.Position + direction * 3
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	kit:play("Combat2V2.C", { CFrame = root.CFrame, Origin = origin, Power = power })
	local length = data.Punch.Range * (0.7 + power * 0.3)
	local finish = origin + direction * length
	meleekit.along(kit, character, origin, finish, data.Punch.Radius + power, data.Damage.C * (0.75 + power * 0.25), { stun = 0.5, push = 50 + power * 20, lift = 15, ignore = {} })
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { C = true },
	maxhold = 2,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(_, _, _, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key)
		local held = meleekit.heldfor(holdstarted[key])
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "C" then
			chargedpunch(player, character, root, held)
		end
	end,
	onkey = function(player, character, root, _, key)
		if not kit:canuse(character, key) or not meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key]) then
			return
		end
		kit.lastused[key] = os.clock()
		if key == "Z" then
			meteortackle(player, character, root, kit:aim(root))
		elseif key == "X" then
			groundbreaker(player, character, root)
		end
	end,
})

local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local tool = script.Parent
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))
local util = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"))
local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local masterclock = util.MasterClock

local holdstarted = {}
local kit

local function alive(model)
	local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function setstun(model, duration)
	local stun = model and model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if stun and stun:IsA("ValueBase") and type(stun.Value) == "number" then
		stun.Value = math.max(stun.Value, duration)
	end
end

local function tier()
	local upgrades = tool:FindFirstChild("Upgrades")
	local value = upgrades and upgrades.Value or 0
	if value >= 2 then
		return 3, "V3"
	elseif value == 1 then
		return 2, "V2"
	end
	return 1, "V1"
end

local function blocked(character, origin, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, target - origin, params)
	if result then
		return result.Position - (target - origin).Unit * 3
	end
	return target
end

local function initial(player, root, origin, direction)
	local stage = tier()
	kit:play("Yoru2.InitialSlash", {
		Stage = stage,
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = direction,
	})
end

local function onethousandslices(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local _, version = tier()
	local data = kit.data.Damage
	local direction = aim.forward
	local origin = root.Position
	local dashing = held >= data.HoldThreshold
	local length = dashing and data.ZDashRange or data.ZRange
	local endpoint = blocked(character, origin, origin + direction * length)
	local duration = dashing and 0.45 or 0.3
	initial(player, root, origin, direction)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.3
	kit:play("Yoru2.SphereSlices" .. version, {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = direction,
		startSlicesPosition = origin + direction * 4,
		endSlicesPosition = endpoint,
		duration = duration,
	})
	if dashing then
		local mover = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		mover.Name = "tdbdash"
		mover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1) * 1e6
		mover.Velocity = direction * ((endpoint - origin).Magnitude / duration)
		mover.Parent = root
		task.delay(duration, function()
			mover:Destroy()
			if root.Parent then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ticks = data.ZTicks
		for index = 1, ticks do
			if not character.Parent then
				return
			end
			local center = dashing and root.Position + direction * 4 or origin:Lerp(endpoint, index / ticks)
			for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, center, data.ZRadius)) do
				if alive(target.model) and kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Z, target.root) then
					setstun(target.model, 0.3)
				end
			end
			task.wait(duration / ticks)
		end
	end)
end

local function darkairslash(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local _, version = tier()
	local data = kit.data.Damage
	local special = held >= data.HoldThreshold
	local direction = aim.forward
	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
	local distance = data.XRange
	local flighttime = special and 0.22 or 0.38
	initial(player, root, origin, direction)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
	for index = -1, 1 do
		local start = origin + right * (index * 4)
		local finish = blocked(character, start, start + direction * distance)
		task.delay((index + 1) * (special and 0.05 or 0.1), function()
			if not character.Parent or not root.Parent then
				return
			end
			local params = {
				player = player,
				hrp = root,
				origin = start,
				fireDir = direction,
				targetPos = finish,
				ClockTime = masterclock:GetTime(),
				fliesFor = flighttime,
			}
			if version ~= "V1" then
				params.specialActivated = special
			end
			kit:play("Yoru2.Slash" .. version, params)
			local hit = {}
			local started = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - started < flighttime and character.Parent do
				local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - started) / flighttime, 0, 1)
				local point = start:Lerp(finish, alpha)
				for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.box(character, CFrame.lookAt(point, point + direction), Vector3.new(3, 16, 6))) do
					if not hit[target.model] and alive(target.model) then
						hit[target.model] = true
						if kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.X, target.root) then
							setstun(target.model, 0.4)
							if target.root and target.root:IsA("BasePart") and not target.root.Anchored then
								target.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += direction * 18
							end
						end
					end
				end
				runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true },
	maxhold = 2,
	onholdstart = function(_, _, _, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = math.clamp(os.clock() - (holdstarted[key] or os.clock()), 0, 2)
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "Z" then
			onethousandslices(player, character, root, aim, held)
		elseif key == "X" then
			darkairslash(player, character, root, aim, held)
		end
	end,
	onunequip = function()
		table.clear(holdstarted)
	end,
})
