local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local effect = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Effect"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local remote = tool:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent")
local remotefunction = tool:WaitForChild("RemoteFunction")
local effectholding = tool:FindFirstChild("effectholding")
if not effectholding then
	effectholding = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	effectholding.Name = "effectholding"
	effectholding.Parent = tool
end
local keyheld = false
local mousepos = tool:WaitForChild("MousePos")
local istransformed = tool:WaitForChild("IsTransformed")
local transformedrig = tool:WaitForChild("TransformedRigObject")
local movesettemplate = serverstorage:WaitForChild("MovesetTemplates"):WaitForChild(tool.Name)
local foxtemplate = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("FX"):WaitForChild("Kitsune"):WaitForChild("Kitsune")

local maxhold = 3
local holdskills = { Z = true, X = true, C = true, F = true }
local foxheight = 6.6

local lastused = {}
local active = nil
local busyuntil = 0
local combo, lastm1 = 0, 0
local tails, lasthit = 0, 0
local transform = { container = nil, token = nil, hidden = {}, walkspeed = nil }
local passivecharacter, passiveconnection = nil, nil

local function getcharacter()
	local parent = tool.Parent
	if parent and parent:IsA("Model") and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		return parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function getowner()
	local parent = tool.Parent
	if parent and parent:IsA("Backpack") then
		return parent.Parent
	end
	local character = getcharacter()
	return character and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
end

local function toollevel()
	return tool:GetAttribute("Level") or (tool:FindFirstChild("Level") and tool.Level.Value) or 1
end

local function play(name, params)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		effect.new(name):replicate(params)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Kitsune] effect " .. name .. " failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function setupmoveset(player)
	local playergui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not playergui then
		return
	end

	local modules = playergui:FindFirstChild("MovesetModules")
	if not modules then
		modules = Instance.new("Folder")
		modules.Name = "MovesetModules"
		modules.Parent = playergui
	end

	local entry = modules:FindFirstChild(tool.Name)
	if not entry then
		entry = Instance.new("Folder")
		entry.Name = tool.Name
		entry.Parent = modules
	end
	entry:SetAttribute("MovesetToolUid", tool:GetAttribute("MovesetToolUid"))

	if not entry:FindFirstChild("LegacyDataAggregate") then
		local aggregate = tool.Data:Clone()
		aggregate.Name = "LegacyDataAggregate"
		aggregate.Parent = entry
	end

	for _, moveset in ipairs(movesettemplate:GetChildren()) do
		if not entry:FindFirstChild(moveset.Name) then
			moveset:Clone().Parent = entry
		end
	end
end

local function tailids(count)
	local ids = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		table.insert(ids, i)
	end
	return ids
end

local function settails(count)
	local character = getcharacter() or passivecharacter
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") then
		return
	end
	tails = count
	play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = tailids(count), Tool = tool })
end

local function ragevalue(character)
	character = character or getcharacter() or passivecharacter
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local rage = character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
	if not rage then
		rage = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		rage.Name = "Rage"
		rage.Parent = character
	end
	return rage
end

local function tailsfor(amount)
	if amount >= 200 / 3 then
		return 3
	elseif amount >= 100 / 3 then
		return 2
	end
	return 1
end

local function setrage(amount)
	local rage = ragevalue()
	if not rage then
		return
	end
	rage.Value = math.clamp(amount, 0, 100)
	if not istransformed.Value then
		local count = tailsfor(rage.Value)
		if count ~= tails then
			settails(count)
		end
	end
end

local function addrage(amount)
	local rage = ragevalue()
	if rage then
		setrage(rage.Value + amount)
	end
end

local function onhitlanded(amount)
	lasthit = os.clock()
	if not istransformed.Value then
		addrage(amount * data.rage.gainperdamage)
	end
end

local endtransform

task.spawn(function()
	local step = 0.25
	while true do
		task.wait(step)
		local character = getcharacter() or (passivecharacter and passivecharacter.Parent and passivecharacter)
		local rage = character and character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
		if rage then
			if istransformed.Value then
				setrage(rage.Value - data.rage.transformdrainpersecond * step)
				if rage.Value <= 0 then
					endtransform(getowner())
				end
			elseif not istransformed.Value and rage.Value < 100 then
				setrage(rage.Value + 100 * step / 300)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function eachtarget(selfcharacter, callback)
	for _, foldername in ipairs({ "Characters", "Enemies" }) do
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(foldername)
		if folder then
			for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if model ~= selfcharacter and model:IsA("Model") then
					local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 then
						callback(model, humanoid, root)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function hit(humanoid, amount)
	local model = humanoid and humanoid.Parent
	local attacker = getcharacter() or passivecharacter
	if model and hitbox.damage(attacker, model, amount, { part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), source = tool.Name }) then
		onhitlanded(amount)
	end
end

local function damageradius(selfcharacter, position, radius, amount)
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(selfcharacter, position, radius)) do
		hit(target.humanoid, amount)
	end
end

local function damagealong(selfcharacter, from, to, radius, amount)
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.line(selfcharacter, from, to, radius)) do
		hit(target.humanoid, amount)
	end
end

local function firstalong(selfcharacter, from, to, radius)
	local target = hitbox.first(selfcharacter, from, to, radius)
	return target and target.root
end

local worldparams = RaycastParams.new()
worldparams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function ignorelist(character)
	return {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
end

local function groundbelow(position, character)
	worldparams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignorelist(character)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0), Vector3.new(0, -120, 0), worldparams)
	return result and result.Position or position
end

local function clamprange(origin, target, range)
	local offset = target - origin
	if offset.Magnitude > range then
		return origin + offset.Unit * range
	end
	return target
end

local function canuse(character, key)
	if active or os.clock() < busyuntil then
		return false
	end
	if toollevel() < (data.Lvl[key] or 1) then
		return false
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastused[key] or -math.huge) < (data.Cooldown[key] or 0) then
		return false
	end
	local stun = character:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if stun and stun:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(stun.Value) and stun.Value > 0 then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function dashroot(root, cframe, duration)
	play("Kitsune.ClientDash", { Root = root, CFrame = cframe, Duration = duration, Linear = true })
end

local release

local function starthold(player, character, root, key)
	if not holdskills[key] or not canuse(character, key) then
		return
	end

	local token = { key = key, started = os.clock(), player = player, character = character, root = root }
	active = token
	effectholding.Value = true
	local fox = istransformed.Value

	if key == "Z" then
		if not fox then
			play("Kitsune.ZCharge", { player = player, hrp = root, holding = effectholding })
		end
	elseif key == "X" then
		play("Kitsune.X", { player = player, ID = 1, Character = character, HoldValue = effectholding })
	elseif key == "C" then
		play("Kitsune.CCharge", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			holding = effectholding,
			transformed = fox,
			mutated = false,
			cutsceneTransition = false,
		})
	elseif key == "F" then
		play("Kitsune.FCharge", { player = player, hrp = root, transformed = fox, holding = effectholding })
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local deadline = token.started + maxhold
		while active == token and keyheld and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		if active == token then
			release(player, character, root, key)
		end
	end)
end

function release(player, character, root, key)
	if not active or active.key ~= key then
		return
	end
	active = nil
	effectholding.Value = false
	lastused[key] = os.clock()

	local fox = istransformed.Value
	local origin = root.Position
	local target = mousepos.Value
	local flat = Vector3.new(target.X, origin.Y, target.Z)
	if (flat - origin).Magnitude < 0.5 then
		flat = origin + root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	local forward = (flat - origin).Unit
	local right = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit

	if key == "Z" and not fox then
		busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
		for i = 1, 3 do
			task.delay((i - 1) * 0.12, function()
				local from = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
				local aimat = mousepos.Value
				if (aimat - from).Magnitude < 1 then
					aimat = from + root.CFrame.LookVector * 50
				end
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") }
				local result = workspace:Raycast(from, (aimat - from).Unit * 160, params)
				local goal = result and result.Position or (from + (aimat - from).Unit * 160)
				local model = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local victimroot = humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
				local travel = math.max((goal - from).Magnitude / 200, 0.15)

				play("Kitsune.Z", {
					player = player,
					hrp = root,
					originPos = from,
					goalPos = goal,
					index = i,
					raycastHitSomething = result ~= nil,
					victimRoot = victimroot,
					timeUntilImpact = travel,
					victimDetonateDelay = 1,
				})
				task.delay(travel, damageradius, character, goal, 7, data.damage.z)
			end)
		end
	elseif key == "Z" and fox then
		local goal = groundbelow(clamprange(origin, flat, 70), character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		play("Kitsune.ZTransformed", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			dashOriginPos = origin,
			dashTargetPos = goal,
			dashFor = 0.35,
		})
		dashroot(root, CFrame.lookAt(goal, goal + forward), 0.35)
		busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
		task.delay(0.35, damagealong, character, origin, goal, 10, data.damage.z * 3)
	elseif key == "X" then
		local legs, leglength, sway, perleg = 4, 16, 7, 0.11
		local points = {}
		for i = 0, legs do
			local along = origin + forward * leglength * i
			local side = (i == 0 or i == legs) and 0 or ((i % 2 == 1) and sway or -sway)
			local position = along + right * side
			if i > 0 then
				position = groundbelow(position, character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
			local nextpos = origin + forward * leglength * (i + 1)
			points[i + 1] = CFrame.lookAt(position, Vector3.new(nextpos.X, position.Y, nextpos.Z))
		end

		play("Kitsune.X", { player = player, ID = 2, DashPoints = points, DurationPer = perleg })
		busyuntil = os.clock() + legs * perleg + 0.4
		for i = 2, #points do
			task.delay((i - 2) * perleg, function()
				dashroot(root, points[i], perleg)
				damagealong(character, points[i - 1].Position, points[i].Position, 7, data.damage.xleg)
			end)
		end
		task.delay(legs * perleg, function()
			local finish = points[#points]
			play("Kitsune.X", { player = player, ID = 3, CFrame = finish })
			damageradius(character, finish.Position, 14, data.damage.xend)
		end)
	elseif key == "C" then
		local goal = groundbelow(clamprange(origin, target, 120), character)
		local travel = math.max((goal - origin).Magnitude / 140, 0.2)
		local burnfor, explodeafter = 3, 0.6
		play("Kitsune.C", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			originPos = origin,
			goalPos = goal,
			transformed = fox,
			fireDamageFor = burnfor,
			delayUntilExplosion = explodeafter,
			timeUntilImpact = travel,
		})
		busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.7
		task.delay(travel, damageradius, character, goal, 12, data.damage.cimpact)
		task.delay(travel + explodeafter, damageradius, character, goal, 20, data.damage.cexplosion)
		for burntick = 1, 6 do
			task.delay(travel + explodeafter + burntick * (burnfor / 6), damageradius, character, goal, 16, data.damage.cburn)
		end
	elseif key == "F" then
		local dashfor = 0.32
		local goal = clamprange(origin, flat, 70)
		local victimroot = firstalong(character, origin, goal, 7)
		if victimroot then
			goal = victimroot.Position - forward * 3
		end
		goal = groundbelow(goal, character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

		play(fox and "Kitsune.FTransformed" or "Kitsune.F", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			originPos = origin,
			goalPos = goal,
			dashFor = dashfor,
		})
		dashroot(root, CFrame.lookAt(goal, goal + forward), dashfor)
		busyuntil = os.clock() + dashfor + 0.5

		task.delay(dashfor, function()
			if victimroot and victimroot.Parent then
				play("Kitsune.FHit", { player = player, hrp = root, transformed = fox, victimRoot = victimroot, index = 1 })
				local humanoid = victimroot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid then
					hit(humanoid, data.damage.f)
				end
			end
			play(fox and "Kitsune.FSlashesTransformed" or "Kitsune.FSlashes", {
				player = player,
				hrp = root,
				originPos = origin,
				goalPos = goal,
				missed = victimroot == nil,
			})
		end)
	end
end

local function m1(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if active or os.clock() < busyuntil then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - (lastused.TAP or -math.huge) < data.Cooldown.TAP then
		return
	end
	lastused.TAP = os.clock()

	if os.clock() - lastm1 > 1.2 then
		combo = 0
	end
	lastm1 = os.clock()
	combo = combo % 5 + 1
	local final = combo == 5
	local fox = istransformed.Value

	play("Kitsune.M1Combo", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		transformed = fox,
		index = combo,
		playerOnGround = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air,
	})

	if final then
		busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	end
	local reach = fox and 12 or 5
	local center = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * reach
	local radius = (fox and 12 or 8) + (final and 4 or 0)
	task.delay(0.12, damageradius, character, center, radius, final and data.damage.m1final or data.damage.m1)
end

local function setbodyhidden(character, hidden)
	if hidden then
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local partoffox = transform.container and d:IsDescendantOf(transform.container)
			if not partoffox and (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 then
				transform.hidden[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	else
		for d, transparency in pairs(transform.hidden) do
			if d.Parent then
				d.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		table.clear(transform.hidden)
	end
end

local function buildfox(root)
	local container = Instance.new("Model")
	container.Name = "Kitsune"

	local fox = foxtemplate:Clone()
	fox.Name = "Kitsune"
	local stray = fox:FindFirstChildOfClass("Script")
	if stray then
		stray:Destroy()
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(fox:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
		end
	end

	local foxroot = fox.PrimaryPart or fox:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
	foxroot.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, foxheight, 0)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "foxweld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = foxroot
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, foxheight, 0)
	weld.Parent = foxroot

	fox.Parent = container
	return container, fox
end

function endtransform(player, skipeffect)
	local container = transform.container
	transform.token = nil
	if not container then
		return
	end

	local character = container.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	transformedrig.Value = nil
	istransformed.Value = false
	if character then
		setbodyhidden(character, false)
	end
	if humanoid and transform.walkspeed then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = transform.walkspeed
	end
	transform.walkspeed = nil
	container:Destroy()
	transform.container = nil

	lastused.V = os.clock()
	busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.8

	if not skipeffect and root then
		play("Kitsune.Untransform", { Root = root })
	end
	tails = 0
	setrage(0)
end

local function starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if transform.container or not canuse(character, "V") then
		return
	end
	local rage = ragevalue(character)
	if not rage or rage.Value < 100 then
		return
	end
	busyuntil = os.clock() + 1

	play("Kitsune.V", { Player = player, Root = root, Toggle = true, Tool = tool })
	play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = {}, Tool = tool })

	local container, fox = buildfox(root)
	transform.container = container
	container.Parent = character
	transformedrig.Value = fox
	istransformed.Value = true
	setbodyhidden(character, true)
	transform.walkspeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 1.35

	task.delay(0.15, damageradius, character, root.Position, 24, data.damage.v)

	local token = {}
	transform.token = token
	task.delay(data.transformduration or 40, function()
		if transform.token == token then
			endtransform(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function endpassive()
	if passiveconnection then
		passiveconnection:Disconnect()
		passiveconnection = nil
	end
	endtransform(getowner(), true)
	local character = passivecharacter
	passivecharacter = nil
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = {}, Tool = tool })
	end
	tails = 0
end

local function claimpassive(character)
	character:SetAttribute("passivefruit", tool.Name)
	if passivecharacter == character then
		return
	end
	endpassive()
	passivecharacter = character
	tails = 0
	local rage = ragevalue(character)
	setrage(rage and rage.Value or 0)
	passiveconnection = character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("passivefruit"):Connect(function()
		if character:GetAttribute("passivefruit") ~= tool.Name then
			endpassive()
		end
	end)
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, value)
	if player ~= getowner() then
		return
	end
	if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then
		mousepos.Value = value
	elseif typeof(value) == "CFrame" then
		mousepos.Value = value.Position
	elseif type(value) == "boolean" then
		keyheld = value
	end
end)

remotefunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player, key)
	if player ~= getowner() or type(key) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local character = getcharacter()
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	if holdskills[key] then
		if istransformed.Value and not active then
			addrage(-data.rage.skillcosttransformed)
		end
		starthold(player, character, root, key)
	elseif key == "TAP" then
		m1(player, character, root, humanoid)
	elseif key == "V" then
		if istransformed.Value then
			if os.clock() >= busyuntil then
				endtransform(player)
			end
		else
			starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	local character = getcharacter()
	local player = character and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	setupmoveset(player)
	claimpassive(character)
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	local token = active
	keyheld = false
	if token and token.root and token.root.Parent then
		release(token.player, token.character, token.root, token.key)
	end
	active = nil
	effectholding.Value = false
end)

tool.Destroying:Connect(function()
	endpassive()
end)

local function onancestry()
	local owner = getowner()
	if owner then
		setupmoveset(owner)
	end
end
tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(onancestry)
onancestry()

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))

local portalradius = 6
local portalreuse = 1.5
local leaprange = 75
local escapeduration = 4
local escaperadius = 18
local warpstartup = 2
local warpchainradius = 25
local riftpullradius = 45
local riftpulltime = 1.5
local riftdrain = 6
local riftexitradius = 18
local riftheight = 12000
local riftspacing = 8000
local riftmincooldown = 12
local riftmaxcooldown = 24
local riftfulltime = 20
local dashassistangle = math.rad(14)

local kit
local escape = { token = nil, hidden = {}, field = nil, walkspeed = nil, door = nil }
local rift = nil
local portalpairs = {}
local riftslots = 0

local function isnpc(model)
	return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) == nil
end

local function rootof(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function enemyof(character, model)
	if model == character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if isnpc(model) then
		return true
	end
	return character:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false and model:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false
end

local function stun(model, duration)
	local value = model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if not value or not value:IsA("ValueBase") then
		return
	end
	value.Value = math.max(value.Value, duration)
	if isnpc(model) then
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if value.Parent and value.Value <= duration then
				value.Value = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function spend(character, cost)
	local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	if not energy or not cost or cost <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if energy.Value < cost then
		return false
	end
	energy.Value -= cost
	return true
end

local function worldend(character, from, direction, distance)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(from, direction * distance, params)
	return result and result.Position or from + direction * distance
end

local function drivenpc(victimroot, duration, path, onfinish)
	local npc = isnpc(victimroot.Parent)
	local wasanchored = victimroot.Anchored
	if npc then
		victimroot.Anchored = true
	end
	local started = os.clock()
	local connection
	connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - started
		if not victimroot.Parent or elapsed >= duration then
			connection:Disconnect()
			if victimroot.Parent then
				if npc then
					victimroot.CFrame = path(1)
					victimroot.Anchored = wasanchored
				end
				if onfinish then
					onfinish()
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if npc then
			victimroot.CFrame = path(elapsed / duration)
		end
	end)
end

local function setescapehidden(character, hidden)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hidden then
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
				escape.hidden[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			elseif d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Enabled then
				escape.hidden[d] = true
				d.Enabled = false
			end
		end
		if humanoid then
			escape.display = humanoid.DisplayDistanceType
			humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
		end
	else
		for d, value in pairs(escape.hidden) do
			if d.Parent then
				if d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
					d.Enabled = value
				else
					d.Transparency = value
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(escape.hidden)
		if humanoid and escape.display then
			humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = escape.display
		end
		escape.display = nil
	end
end

local function endescape(player)
	if not escape.token then
		return
	end
	escape.token = nil
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = rootof(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if character then
		setescapehidden(character, false)
	end
	if escape.field then
		escape.field:Destroy()
		escape.field = nil
	end
	if escape.door then
		escape.door:Destroy()
		escape.door = nil
	end
	if humanoid and escape.walkspeed then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = escape.walkspeed
	end
	escape.walkspeed = nil
	if root then
		kit:play("Portal.XEnd", { player = player, char = character, hrp = root, portalLastsFor = 1.5, origin = root.Position })
	end
end

local function parallelescape(player, character, root, humanoid)
	local origin = root.Position
	kit:play("Portal.XInit", { player = player, char = character, hrp = root, portalLastsFor = escapeduration, origin = origin })
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, victimhumanoid, victimroot)
		if enemyof(character, model) and (victimroot.Position - origin).Magnitude <= escaperadius then
			kit:play("Portal.XDamage", { player = player, origin = origin + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0), victimRoot = victimroot })
			kit:hit(victimhumanoid, data.damage.xentry, victimroot)
			stun(model, 1)
		end
	end)
	local token = {}
	escape.token = token
	local door = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	door.Name = "DoorMode"
	door.Value = true
	door.Parent = character
	escape.door = door
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		if escape.token ~= token then
			return
		end
		setescapehidden(character, true)
		escape.field = Instance.new("ForceField")
		escape.field.Visible = false
		escape.field.Parent = character
		escape.walkspeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 1.4
	end)
	task.delay(escapeduration, function()
		if escape.token == token then
			endescape(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function portaldash(player, character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position
	local direction = aim.target - origin
	direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, math.max(direction.Y, 0), direction.Z)
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or aim.forward
	local length, radius, travel = 90, 7, 0.35
	local finish = worldend(character, origin, direction, length)
	local victimroot = nil
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, _, candidate)
		if victimroot or not enemyof(character, model) then
			return
		end
		local t = (candidate.Position - origin):Dot(direction)
		if t >= 0 and t <= (finish - origin).Magnitude and (origin + direction * t - candidate.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
			victimroot = candidate
		end
	end)
	if not victimroot then
		local best = dashassistangle
		kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, _, candidate)
			if not enemyof(character, model) then
				return
			end
			local offset = candidate.Position - origin
			local distance = offset.Magnitude
			if distance < 1 or distance > length then
				return
			end
			local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(offset.Unit:Dot(direction), -1, 1))
			if angle <= best then
				best = angle
				victimroot = candidate
			end
		end)
		if victimroot then
			direction = (victimroot.Position - origin).Unit
		end
	end
	if victimroot then
		finish = victimroot.Position - direction * 4
	end

	kit:play("Portal.ZDash", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = direction,
		forwardCylinderRadius = radius,
		timeUntilReachedEndPoint = travel,
		victimExists = victimroot ~= nil,
		endPoint = finish,
		forwardCylinderLength = (finish - origin).Magnitude,
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + travel + 0.2
	if not victimroot then
		return
	end

	task.delay(travel, function()
		local model = victimroot.Parent
		local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.zdash, victimroot)
		stun(model, 2)
		local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
		flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
		local impact = kit:groundbelow(victimroot.Position + flat * 37, character)
		local looptime, falltime = 1, 0.4
		kit:play("Portal.ZVictim", {
			player = player,
			origin = victimroot.Position,
			impactPos = impact,
			fireDir = flat,
			enemyRoot = victimroot,
			syncedEndTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 0.2 + looptime + falltime,
			portalLoopTime = looptime,
			timeUntilImpactAfterFinalPortal = falltime,
		})
		local start = victimroot.Position
		local entry = start + flat * 37 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		local above = impact + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
		local drop = impact + Vector3.new(0, 42, 0)
		local land = impact + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		local total = 0.2 + looptime + falltime
		drivenpc(victimroot, total, function(alpha)
			local t = alpha * total
			if t < 0.2 then
				return CFrame.new(start:Lerp(entry, t / 0.2))
			elseif t < 0.2 + looptime then
				local spin = (t - 0.2) / looptime * math.pi * 6
				return CFrame.new(above + Vector3.new(math.cos(spin) * 20, math.sin(spin * 0.5) * 8, math.sin(spin) * 20))
			end
			return CFrame.new(drop:Lerp(land, (t - 0.2 - looptime) / falltime))
		end, function()
			kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.zimpact, victimroot)
			stun(model, 1)
		end)
	end)
end

local function openpair(player, a, b, lookdir, lasts, damage)
	local pair = {
		player = player,
		ends = { a, b },
		lookdir = lookdir,
		expires = os.clock() + lasts,
		used = {},
		damage = damage,
	}
	table.insert(portalpairs, pair)
	return pair
end

local function passthrough(pair, model, root, from, to)
	local now = os.clock()
	if (pair.used[model] or 0) > now then
		return
	end
	local owner = pair.player
	local character = owner and owner.Character
	local isowner = model == character
	if not isowner and not isnpc(model) and model:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") ~= false then
		return
	end
	pair.used[model] = now + portalreuse
	local exit = CFrame.lookAt(to, to + pair.lookdir) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -portalradius - 2)
	local damaged = false
	if not isowner and character and enemyof(character, model) then
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		kit:hit(humanoid, pair.damage, root)
		stun(model, 0.6)
		damaged = true
	end
	if isnpc(model) and root.Anchored then
		root.CFrame = exit
	else
		model:PivotTo(exit)
	end
	kit:play("Portal.FPortalTeleport", { player = owner, rootTeleported = root, teleportCFrame = exit, wasDamagedByTeleport = damaged })
end

runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if #portalpairs == 0 then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	for index = #portalpairs, 1, -1 do
		local pair = portalpairs[index]
		if now > pair.expires then
			table.remove(portalpairs, index)
		else
			for _, foldername in ipairs({ "Characters", "Enemies" }) do
				local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(foldername)
				for _, model in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
					local root = rootof(model)
					local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
						if (root.Position - pair.ends[1]).Magnitude <= portalradius then
							passthrough(pair, model, root, pair.ends[1], pair.ends[2])
						elseif (root.Position - pair.ends[2]).Magnitude <= portalradius then
							passthrough(pair, model, root, pair.ends[2], pair.ends[1])
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function quantumleap(player, character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position
	local target = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, leaprange)
	target = kit:groundbelow(target, character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	local forward = aim.forward
	local lasts = 12
	local here = origin + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local there = target + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	kit:play("Portal.CreatePortal", { player = player, origin = here, lookDir = forward, lastsFor = lasts, emitLightShockwave = true })
	kit:play("Portal.CreatePortal", { player = player, origin = there, lookDir = forward, lastsFor = lasts, emitDarkShockwave = true })
	local pair = openpair(player, here, there, forward, lasts, data.damage.fportal)
	pair.used[character] = os.clock() + portalreuse
	local arrival = CFrame.lookAt(target, target + forward)
	character:PivotTo(arrival)
	kit:play("Portal.PortalJump", { player = player, hrp = root })
	kit:play("Portal.FPortalTeleport", { player = player, rootTeleported = root, teleportCFrame = arrival, wasDamagedByTeleport = false })
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.4
end

local function warpdestination(name)
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	local locations = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
	local part = locations and locations:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or name == "Sea" then
		return nil
	end
	return part.Position
end

local function worldwarp(player, character, root, aim, name)
	local destination = type(name) == "string" and warpdestination(name)
	if not destination then
		return false
	end
	local forward = aim.forward
	local lasts = 14
	local portalpos = root.Position + forward * 8 + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local landing = kit:groundbelow(destination + Vector3.new(0, 300, 0), character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	kit:play("Portal.CPortal", {
		player = player,
		origin = portalpos,
		lookDir = -forward,
		lastsFor = lasts,
		delayPortalSpawnBy = warpstartup,
		targetPos = landing,
	})
	kit:play("Portal.CreatePortal", { player = player, origin = landing + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), lookDir = forward, lastsFor = lasts, delayPortalSpawnBy = warpstartup, emitDarkShockwave = true })
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + warpstartup + 0.2
	local start = root.Position
	local chained = { [character] = "self" }
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, _, victimroot)
		if model ~= character and (victimroot.Position - start).Magnitude <= warpchainradius then
			chained[model] = enemyof(character, model) and "enemy" or "ally"
		end
	end)
	for model, kind in pairs(chained) do
		kit:play("Portal.CChains", { player = player, origin = portalpos, createOrDelete = "Create", lastsFor = warpstartup, lookDir = forward, character = model })
		if kind == "enemy" then
			stun(model, warpstartup + 0.5)
			local victimroot = rootof(model)
			local hold = victimroot and victimroot.CFrame
			if hold then
				drivenpc(victimroot, warpstartup, function()
					return hold
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	task.delay(warpstartup, function()
		if not root.Parent or not rootof(character) then
			return
		end
		local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local slot = 0
		for model, kind in pairs(chained) do
			local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local victimroot = rootof(model)
			if humanoid and victimroot and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				if kind == "enemy" then
					kit:play("Portal.CChains", { player = player, origin = portalpos, createOrDelete = "Delete", lastsFor = 0, lookDir = forward, character = model })
					kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.cchains, victimroot)
					stun(model, 1.5)
				elseif (rootof(character).Position - portalpos).Magnitude > warpchainradius or (victimroot.Position - portalpos).Magnitude > warpchainradius then
					kit:play("Portal.CChains", { player = player, origin = portalpos, createOrDelete = "Delete", lastsFor = 0, lookDir = forward, character = model })
				else
					humanoid:SetAttribute("LastCPortalUseTime", now)
					local offset = kind == "self" and Vector3.zero or Vector3.new(math.cos(slot) * 6, 0, math.sin(slot) * 6)
					slot += 1.3
					local arrival = CFrame.lookAt(landing + offset, landing + offset + forward)
					model:PivotTo(arrival)
					kit:play("Portal.FPortalTeleport", { player = player, rootTeleported = victimroot, teleportCFrame = arrival, wasDamagedByTeleport = false })
				end
			end
		end
		local pair = openpair(player, portalpos, landing + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), forward, lasts - warpstartup, data.damage.fportal)
		pair.used[character] = os.clock() + portalreuse
	end)
	return true
end

local function closerift(normalexit)
	local current = rift
	if not current then
		return
	end
	rift = nil
	for model in pairs(current.members) do
		local member = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if member then
			member:SetAttribute("NormalExit", normalexit == true)
		end
	end
	current.owner:SetAttribute("DimensionCancel", true)
	local function sendback()
		for model, info in pairs(current.members) do
			local root = rootof(model)
			local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if root then
				root:SetAttribute("PortaledToAnotherDimension", nil)
			end
			if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				model:PivotTo(info.returnto)
			end
		end
	end
	if normalexit then
		sendback()
	else
		task.delay(1.33, sendback)
	end
	task.delay(3, function()
		for model in pairs(current.members) do
			local member = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if member then
				member:SetAttribute("NormalExit", nil)
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(2, function()
		current.owner:Destroy()
		current.floor:Destroy()
	end)
	local inside = math.clamp((os.clock() - current.opened) / riftfulltime, 0, 1)
	local cooldown = riftmincooldown + (riftmaxcooldown - riftmincooldown) * inside
	kit.lastused.V = os.clock() - ((data.Cooldown.V or riftmaxcooldown) - cooldown)
end

local function dimensionalrift(player, character, root)
	if rift then
		closerift()
		return
	end
	local center = kit:groundbelow(root.Position, character)
	riftslots = riftslots % 4 + 1
	local arena = Vector3.new(riftspacing * riftslots, riftheight, -riftspacing)
	local template = replicatedstorage.FX.PortalEffects.VArenaDimension
	local pivot = template:GetPivot().Position
	local floor = Instance.new("Model")
	floor.Name = "riftfloor"
	for _, partname in ipairs({ "StagePart", "InvisWall" }) do
		local source = template:FindFirstChild(partname)
		if source then
			local clone = source:Clone()
			local parts = clone:IsA("BasePart") and { clone } or {}
			for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(parts, d)
				elseif not d:IsA("Model") and not d:IsA("Folder") then
					d:Destroy()
				end
			end
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				part.Anchored = true
				part.Transparency = 1
				part.CanCollide = true
				part.CFrame = part.CFrame - pivot + arena
			end
			clone.Parent = floor
		end
	end
	floor.Parent = workspace
	local owner = Instance.new("Part")
	owner.Name = "riftowner"
	owner.Anchored = true
	owner.CanCollide = false
	owner.CanQuery = false
	owner.CanTouch = false
	owner.Transparency = 1
	owner.Size = Vector3.one
	owner.Position = arena
	owner.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") or workspace

	local members = {}
	members[character] = { returnto = character:GetPivot(), npc = false }
	kit:play("Portal.VPortal", { player = player, origin = center, upVector = Vector3.yAxis, lastsFor = riftpulltime })
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, _, victimroot)
		if enemyof(character, model) and (victimroot.Position - center).Magnitude <= riftpullradius then
			members[model] = { returnto = model:GetPivot(), npc = isnpc(model) }
			local from = victimroot.Position
			local to = center + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			kit:play("Portal.VSuckedIn", {
				player = player,
				origin = from,
				endPos = to,
				root = victimroot,
				syncedEndTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + riftpulltime,
				receivingPlayer = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model),
			})
			stun(model, riftpulltime + 0.5)
			local rotation = victimroot.CFrame.Rotation
			drivenpc(victimroot, riftpulltime, function(alpha)
				return rotation + from:Lerp(to, alpha)
			end)
		end
	end)
	rift = { owner = owner, floor = floor, members = members, arena = arena, character = character, player = player, opened = os.clock() }
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + riftpulltime + 0.3

	for model in pairs(members) do
		local member = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if member then
			kit:play("Portal.VLoadDimension", { player = player, createForPlayer = member, origin = arena, owner = owner, delayUntilTeleport = riftpulltime })
		end
	end

	task.delay(riftpulltime, function()
		if not rift or rift.owner ~= owner then
			return
		end
		local index = 0
		for model, info in pairs(members) do
			local root2 = rootof(model)
			if root2 and model.Parent then
				index += 1
				local angle = index * 2.3
				local spot = arena + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 20, 8, math.sin(angle) * 20)
				root2:SetAttribute("PortaledToAnotherDimension", true)
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot))
			end
		end
		for model in pairs(members) do
			local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if model ~= character and humanoid then
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.vpull, rootof(model))
			end
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 0.25
		local exited = false
		task.wait(riftpulltime + 0.5)
		while rift and rift.owner == owner do
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root2 = rootof(character)
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root2 or not character.Parent then
				break
			end
			local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
			if energy then
				energy.Value = math.max(0, energy.Value - math.ceil(riftdrain * step))
				if energy.Value <= 0 then
					break
				end
			end
			if (root2.Position - (arena + Vector3.new(0, 192, 0))).Magnitude <= riftexitradius then
				exited = true
				break
			end
			task.wait(step)
		end
		if rift and rift.owner == owner then
			closerift(exited)
		end
	end)
end

local function onm1(player, character, root)
	if escape.token then
		endescape(player)
	end
	kit:play("Portal.PortalJump", { player = player, hrp = root })
end

local warpexcluded = { Sea = true, Sewers = true, ["Underwater City"] = true, ["Volcano Cave"] = true }
local gatewayopen = false

local function islandlist()
	local list = {}
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	local locations = origin and origin:FindFirstChild("Locations")
	for _, part in ipairs(locations and locations:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and not warpexcluded[part.Name] then
			list[part.Name] = true
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function opengateway(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if gatewayopen or not kit:canuse(character, "C") then
		return
	end
	local remotes = replicatedstorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local gateway = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestGateway")
	if not gateway then
		return
	end
	gatewayopen = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, choice = pcall(function()
			return gateway:InvokeClient(player, islandlist())
		end)
		gatewayopen = false
		if ok and type(choice) == "string" and character.Parent and tool.Parent == character and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			kit.options.onkey(player, character, root, humanoid, "C", choice)
		end
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = {},
	onm1 = onm1,
	onkey = function(player, character, root, humanoid, key, argument)
		if key == "C" and type(argument) ~= "string" then
			opengateway(player, character, root, humanoid)
			return
		end
		if key == "V" and rift and rift.player == player then
			closerift()
			return
		end
		if not kit:canuse(character, key) then
			return
		end
		if escape.token then
			endescape(player)
		end
		if key == "C" and not (type(argument) == "string" and warpdestination(argument)) then
			return
		end
		if not spend(character, data.Cost[key]) then
			return
		end
		local aim = kit:aim(root)
		if key == "Z" then
			kit.lastused.Z = os.clock()
			portaldash(player, character, root, aim)
		elseif key == "X" then
			kit.lastused.X = os.clock()
			parallelescape(player, character, root, humanoid)
		elseif key == "F" then
			kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
			quantumleap(player, character, root, aim)
		elseif key == "C" then
			if worldwarp(player, character, root, aim, argument) then
				kit.lastused.C = os.clock()
			end
		elseif key == "V" then
			kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
			dimensionalrift(player, character, root)
		end
	end,
	onunequip = function(owner)
		endescape(owner)
	end,
})

source-067.source:
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local rigfit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("rigfit"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local istransformed = tool:WaitForChild("IsTransformed")
local transformedrig = tool:WaitForChild("TransformedRigObject")
local rigtemplate = serverstorage:WaitForChild("Rigs"):WaitForChild("MagnetRig")

local combatutil = nil
pcall(function()
	combatutil = require(replicatedstorage.Modules.CombatUtil)
end)

local mechparts = { Arms = true, Head = true, Legs = true, Torso = true, RootPart = true }
local holdthreshold = 0.45
local flightthreshold = 0.5
local pulltiers = { [2] = { radius = 30, power = 12 }, [3] = { radius = 45, power = 18 } }
local scrapgain = 20
local scraplife = 35
local scrapmax = 14
local pickupradius = 7

local kit
local armfunctions, modeproxy = nil, nil
local combo, lastm1 = 0, 0
local transform = { accessory = nil, rig = nil, token = nil, hidden = {} }
local hold = nil
local flight = nil
local scraps = { bin = nil, nextid = 0, list = {}, lastspawn = 0 }
local healthconnection = nil
local lasthealth = nil

local function isnpc(model)
	return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) == nil
end

local function rootof(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function enemyof(character, model)
	if model == character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if isnpc(model) then
		return true
	end
	return character:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false and model:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false
end

local function stun(model, duration)
	local value = model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if not value or not value:IsA("ValueBase") then
		return
	end
	value.Value = math.max(value.Value, duration)
	if isnpc(model) then
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if value.Parent and value.Value <= duration then
				value.Value = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function spend(character, cost)
	local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	if not energy or not cost or cost <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if energy.Value < cost then
		return false
	end
	energy.Value -= cost
	return true
end

local function enemiesnear(character, position, radius, callback)
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, root)
		if enemyof(character, model) and (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
			callback(model, humanoid, root)
		end
	end)
end

local function blast(character, position, radius, amount, stunfor)
	enemiesnear(character, position, radius, function(model, humanoid, root)
		kit:hit(humanoid, amount, root)
		if stunfor then
			stun(model, stunfor)
		end
	end)
end

local function pullnpc(root, toward, power)
	if not isnpc(root.Parent) or root.Anchored then
		return
	end
	local offset = toward - root.Position
	if offset.Magnitude < 4 then
		return
	end
	local velocity = offset.Unit * power
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y + velocity.Y * 0.3, velocity.Z)
end

local function pullnear(character, center, radius, power)
	enemiesnear(character, center, radius, function(_, _, root)
		pullnpc(root, center, power)
	end)
end

local function drivenpc(victimroot, duration, path, onfinish)
	local npc = isnpc(victimroot.Parent)
	local wasanchored = victimroot.Anchored
	if npc then
		victimroot.Anchored = true
	end
	local started = os.clock()
	local connection
	connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - started
		if not victimroot.Parent or elapsed >= duration then
			connection:Disconnect()
			if victimroot.Parent then
				if npc then
					victimroot.CFrame = path(1)
					victimroot.Anchored = wasanchored
				end
				if onfinish then
					onfinish()
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if npc then
			victimroot.CFrame = path(elapsed / duration)
		end
	end)
end

local function worldhit(character, from, to)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, params)
	return result and result.Position or to
end

local function gettier()
	return armfunctions and armfunctions:GetAttribute("CurrentTier") or 1
end

local function settier(tier)
	if armfunctions then
		armfunctions:SetAttribute("CurrentTier", math.clamp(tier, 1, 3))
	end
end

local function addpower(amount)
	local rage = kit:ragevalue()
	if not rage then
		return
	end
	local value = rage.Value + amount
	local tier = gettier()
	while value >= 100 and tier < 3 do
		value -= 100
		tier += 1
	end
	while value < 0 and tier > 1 do
		value += 100
		tier -= 1
	end
	settier(tier)
	rage.Value = math.clamp(value, 0, 100)
end

local function isswordtool(child)
	if not child:IsA("Tool") then
		return false
	end
	if child.ToolTip == "Sword" then
		return true
	end
	if combatutil then
		local ok, weapondata = pcall(function()
			return combatutil:GetWeaponData(combatutil:GetWeaponName(child))
		end)
		return ok and weapondata ~= nil and weapondata.WeaponType == "Sword"
	end
	return false
end

local function disablesword(model, duration)
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local expiry = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration
	local proxy = model:FindFirstChild("SwordDisableProxy")
	if not proxy then
		proxy = Instance.new("Folder")
		proxy.Name = "SwordDisableProxy"
		proxy.Parent = model
	end
	proxy:SetAttribute("Expiry", expiry)
	debris:AddItem(proxy, duration + 1)
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if isswordtool(child) then
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
			break
		end
	end
	local connection
	connection = model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if not proxy.Parent or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= (proxy:GetAttribute("Expiry") or 0) then
			connection:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		if isswordtool(child) then
			task.defer(function()
				humanoid:UnequipTools()
			end)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(duration + 1, function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	local victim = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	local origin = rootof(model) and rootof(model).Position or model:GetPivot().Position
	if victim then
		kit:play("Magnet.SwordDisableEffect", { Player = victim, Stage = 1, Expiry = expiry, Origin = origin })
	else
		kit:play("Magnet.SwordDisableEffect", { Character = model, Stage = 2, Expiry = expiry, Origin = origin })
	end
end

local function scrapbin(player)
	if scraps.bin and scraps.bin.Parent then
		return scraps.bin
	end
	local origin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
	if not origin then
		return nil
	end
	local interactive = origin:FindFirstChild("InteractiveEffects")
	if not interactive then
		interactive = Instance.new("Folder")
		interactive.Name = "InteractiveEffects"
		interactive.Parent = origin
	end
	local folder = interactive:FindFirstChild("MagnetFruitScraps")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "MagnetFruitScraps"
		folder.Parent = interactive
	end
	local bin = folder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not bin then
		bin = Instance.new("Folder")
		bin.Name = player.Name
		bin.Parent = folder
	end
	scraps.bin = bin
	return bin
end

local function clearscraps()
	for part in pairs(scraps.list) do
		if part.Parent then
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(scraps.list)
	if scraps.bin then
		scraps.bin:Destroy()
		scraps.bin = nil
	end
end

local function spawnscraps(player, character, origin, count)
	local bin = scrapbin(player)
	if not bin then
		return
	end
	local active = 0
	for _ in pairs(scraps.list) do
		active += 1
	end
	count = math.min(count, scrapmax - active)
	if count <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local entries = {}
	local radius = 14
	for _ = 1, count do
		scraps.nextid += 1
		local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
		local distance = 5 + math.random() * radius
		local flat = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, 0, math.sin(angle) * distance)
		local surface = kit:groundbelow(flat, character)
		local hover = 1.5 + math.random()
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "Scraps" .. scraps.nextid .. "_Server"
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		part.Position = surface + Vector3.new(0, hover, 0)
		part.Parent = bin
		scraps.list[part] = os.clock() + scraplife
		table.insert(entries, { serverId = scraps.nextid, surfacePos = surface, hoverHeight = hover, travelTime = 0.6 + math.random() * 0.3 })
	end
	kit:play("Magnet.Scraps", {
		Player = player,
		Root = rootof(character),
		Origin = origin,
		ScrapData = { scrapType = "Explode", origin = origin, r = radius, scraps = entries },
	})
end

local function absorbscrap(part, duration)
	if not scraps.list[part] then
		return
	end
	scraps.list[part] = nil
	part:SetAttribute("Absorbing", duration)
	part:Destroy()
	if not istransformed.Value then
		addpower(scrapgain)
	end
end

local function absorbwithin(position, radius)
	for part in pairs(scraps.list) do
		if part.Parent and (part.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
			absorbscrap(part, 0.35 + (part.Position - position).Magnitude / 120)
		end
	end
end

local function stripruntimeparts(model)
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and not mechparts[child.Name] then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return model
end

local function standalonerig(cframe)
	local model = stripruntimeparts(rigtemplate:WaitForChild("MagnetRig"):Clone())
	local scalefix = model:FindFirstChild("ScaleFix")
	if scalefix then
		scalefix:Destroy()
	end
	model:PivotTo(cframe)
	model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
	return model
end

local function setbodyhidden(character, hidden)
	if hidden then
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local partofmech = transform.accessory and d:IsDescendantOf(transform.accessory)
			if not partofmech and (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 then
				transform.hidden[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	else
		for d, transparency in pairs(transform.hidden) do
			if d.Parent then
				d.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		table.clear(transform.hidden)
	end
end

local function endflight()
	local current = flight
	if not current then
		return
	end
	flight = nil
	if current.proxy and current.proxy.Parent then
		current.proxy:Destroy()
	end
end

local function startflight(player, character, root)
	endflight()
	local proxy = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	proxy.Name = "MagnetEnableFlight"
	proxy.Value = true
	proxy.Parent = root
	local current = { proxy = proxy, started = os.clock(), hits = 0, player = player }
	flight = current
	kit:play("Magnet.F_Tap", {
		Player = player,
		Root = root,
		hrp = root,
		Origin = root.Position,
		Stage = 3,
		Proxy = proxy,
		MagnetProxy = armfunctions,
	})
	task.delay(data.flight.duration, function()
		if flight == current then
			endflight()
			kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
		end
	end)
end

local function launchjetpack(player, character, root)
	local current = flight
	if not current then
		return
	end
	local ignore = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	ignore.Name = "MagnetJetpackIgnoreStage"
	ignore.Parent = root
	debris:AddItem(ignore, 3)
	flight = nil
	current.proxy:Destroy()
	kit.lastused.F = os.clock()

	local aim = kit:aim(root)
	local start = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 1.5)
	local direction = (aim.target - start.Position)
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
	local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
	projectile.Name = "magnetjetpack"
	projectile.Anchored = true
	projectile.CanCollide = false
	projectile.CanQuery = false
	projectile.CanTouch = false
	projectile.Transparency = 1
	projectile.Size = Vector3.one
	projectile.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(start.Position, start.Position + direction)
	projectile.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") or workspace
	debris:AddItem(projectile, 8)

	local flyup = 0.5
	kit:play("Magnet.F_Tap", {
		Player = player,
		Root = root,
		hrp = root,
		Origin = root.Position,
		Stage = 4,
		Proxy = projectile,
		FlyUpDur = flyup,
		Seed = math.random(1, 100000),
	})

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(0.15)
		local travelled = 0
		local speed = data.flight.launchspeed
		local victim = nil
		while travelled < data.flight.launchrange and projectile.Parent do
			local step = runservice.Heartbeat:Wait() * speed
			local from = projectile.Position
			local to = from + direction * step
			local blocked = worldhit(character, from, to)
			kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, _, candidate)
				if not victim and enemyof(character, model) and (candidate.Position - to).Magnitude <= 7 then
					victim = candidate
				end
			end)
			projectile.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(blocked, blocked + direction)
			travelled += step
			if victim or blocked ~= to then
				break
			end
		end
		if not projectile.Parent then
			return
		end
		if victim then
			local endpos = victim.Position + Vector3.new(0, 75, 0)
			local marker = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			marker.Name = "HitTarget"
			marker.Value = victim
			marker:SetAttribute("EndPos", endpos)
			marker.Parent = projectile
			local model = victim.Parent
			local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			stun(model, flyup + 1.5)
			local from = victim.Position
			drivenpc(victim, flyup, function(alpha)
				return CFrame.new(from:Lerp(endpos, alpha))
			end, function()
				if humanoid then
					kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.flaunch, victim)
				end
				blast(character, endpos, 22, data.damage.flaunch * 0.5, 1)
			end)
		else
			local marker = Instance.new("Vector3Value")
			marker.Name = "MissExplode"
			marker.Value = projectile.Position
			marker.Parent = projectile
			blast(character, projectile.Position, 22, data.damage.flaunch, 1)
		end
	end)
end

local function endtransform(player, skipeffect)
	local accessory, rig = transform.accessory, transform.rig
	transform.token = nil
	if not accessory then
		return
	end

	local character = accessory.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mechcframe = (rig and rig.PrimaryPart and rig:GetPivot()) or (root and root.CFrame)

	transformedrig.Value = nil
	istransformed.Value = false
	if transform.unfit then
		transform.unfit()
		transform.unfit = nil
	end
	if character then
		setbodyhidden(character, false)
	end
	accessory:Destroy()
	transform.accessory, transform.rig = nil, nil

	kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1.5
	settier(1)
	local rage = kit:ragevalue(character)
	if rage then
		rage.Value = 0
	end

	if not skipeffect and root and mechcframe then
		local eject = standalonerig(mechcframe)
		eject.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") or workspace
		debris:AddItem(eject, 4)
		kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.Untransform", {
			Player = player,
			Root = root,
			hrp = root,
			Origin = root.Position,
			Rig = eject,
			MechCF = mechcframe,
		})
		local center = mechcframe.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(0.15)
			local stop = os.clock() + 2.1
			while os.clock() < stop and character.Parent do
				pullnear(character, center, 60, 35)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			task.wait(0.35)
			if character.Parent then
				blast(character, center, 45, data.damage.eject, 1.5)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if transform.accessory or not kit:canuse(character, "V") then
		return
	end
	local rage = kit:ragevalue(character)
	if gettier() < 3 or not rage or rage.Value < 100 then
		return
	end
	if not spend(character, data.Cost.V) then
		return
	end
	endflight()
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 4

	local accessory = rigtemplate:Clone()
	local rig = stripruntimeparts(accessory:WaitForChild("MagnetRig"))
	for _, part in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= rig.PrimaryPart then
			part.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
	humanoid:AddAccessory(accessory)
	transform.accessory, transform.rig = accessory, rig
	istransformed.Value = true

	local fakerig = standalonerig(root.CFrame)
	fakerig.Parent = replicatedstorage
	debris:AddItem(fakerig, 12)

	kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.V", {
		Player = player,
		Root = root,
		hrp = root,
		Origin = root.Position,
		Rig = rig,
		FakeRig = fakerig,
		UpDist = 100,
		DownDist = 100,
		IsNpc = false,
	})

	local token = {}
	transform.token = token
	local startposition = root.Position

	task.delay(3.4, function()
		if transform.token ~= token then
			return
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= rig.PrimaryPart then
				part.Transparency = 0
			end
		end
		setbodyhidden(character, true)
		transformedrig.Value = rig
		transform.unfit = rigfit.fit(character, humanoid, root, rig)
	end)
	task.delay(3.7, function()
		if transform.token == token then
			blast(character, startposition, 32, data.damage.v, 1)
		end
	end)
end

local function base(player, root, extra)
	local params = { Player = player, Root = root, hrp = root, Origin = root.Position }
	for k, v in pairs(extra) do
		params[k] = v
	end
	return params
end

		end

	proxy.Parent = root
	debris:AddItem(proxy, 4)
	kit:play("Magnet.Z_Attract_Held", base(player, root, {

	task.spawn(function()

		while proxy.Parent and root.Parent and os.clock() - started < 2 and (kit.effectholding.Value or os.clock() - started < 1) do

local function onholdstart(player, character, root, key)
	local token = { key = key, started = os.clock(), player = player, character = character, root = root, transformed = istransformed.Value }
	hold = token
	if token.transformed then
		local rig = transform.rig
		if key == "Z" then
			kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.Z_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding, Rig = rig }))
		elseif key == "X" then
			kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.X_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding, Windup = data.mech.xwindup }))
		elseif key == "C" then
			kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.C_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding, Rig = rig, MousePos = kit.mousepos }))
		end
		local threshold = key == "F" and 0.3 or (key == "X" and data.mech.xwindup + 0.1 or holdthreshold)
		task.delay(threshold, function()
			if hold == token and kit.active and kit.active.key == key and kit.effectholding.Value then
				token.held = true
				transformedheld(token)
			end
		end)
		return
	end

	if key == "Z" then
		kit:play("Magnet.Z_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding }))
	elseif key == "X" then
		kit:play("Magnet.X_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding }))
	elseif key == "C" then
		kit:play("Magnet.C_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding }))
	elseif key == "F" then
		kit:play("Magnet.F_Tap", base(player, root, { Stage = 1, Holding = kit.effectholding }))
	end
	local threshold = key == "F" and flightthreshold or holdthreshold
	task.delay(threshold, function()
		if hold ~= token or not kit.active or kit.active.key ~= key or not kit.effectholding.Value then
			return
		end
		token.held = true
		if key == "Z" then
			zbeam(token)
		elseif key == "C" then
			cheld(token)
		elseif key == "F" then
			token.flying = true
			hold = nil
			kit.active = nil
			kit.effectholding.Value = false
			startflight(player, character, root)
		end
	end)
end

local function basetap(player, character, root, key, aim, held)
	local origin, target, flat, facing = aim.origin, aim.target, aim.flat, aim.facing
	local holding, mousepos = kit.effectholding, kit.mousepos

	if key == "Z" then
		if held then
			return
		end
		local aimcframe = CFrame.lookAt(origin, target)
		local starts = {
			aimcframe * CFrame.new(-2.4, 1.4, -1),
			aimcframe * CFrame.new(2.4, 1.4, -1),
			aimcframe * CFrame.new(-2.8, 0.4, -1.2),
			aimcframe * CFrame.new(2.8, 0.4, -1.2),
		}
		kit:play("Magnet.Z_Attract", base(player, root, { Stage = 2, Holding = holding, StartCFrame = starts, MousePos = mousepos }))
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.7
		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, 4 do
				task.wait(0.15)
				local from = (CFrame.lookAt(starts[i].Position, mousepos.Value) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)).Position
				local to = worldhit(character, from, from + (mousepos.Value - from).Unit * 200)
				local victim = kit:firstalong(character, from, to, 4)
				local impact = victim and victim.Position or to
				task.delay((impact - from).Magnitude / 333.33, function()
					blast(character, impact, 8 + i, data.damage.z, 0.5)
					pullnear(character, impact, 18, 25)
				end)
			end
		end)
	elseif key == "X" then
		local maxrange = held and 150 or 120
		target = kit:clamprange(origin, target, maxrange)
		target = kit:groundbelow(target, character)
		local startcframe = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0), target)
		if held then
			local travel = math.clamp(math.clamp((origin - target).Magnitude, 6, maxrange) / maxrange, 0, 1) ^ 0.8 * 0.25 + 0.1
			kit:play("Magnet.X_Attract_Held", base(player, root, { Stage = 2, StartCFrame = startcframe, MaxRange = maxrange, TargetPosition = target }))
			kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
			task.delay(travel, function()
				local caged = {}
				enemiesnear(character, target, 26, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
					caged[model] = humanoid
					kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.xheld * 0.3, victimroot)
					stun(model, 3.4)
					local hold2 = victimroot.CFrame
					drivenpc(victimroot, 3.35, function()
						return hold2
					end)
				end)
				task.wait(1.85)
				blast(character, target, 26, data.damage.xheld * 0.2)
				task.wait(1.5)
				blast(character, target + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), 32, data.damage.xheld * 0.5, 1)
			end)
		else
			local traveltime = 0.35 + 0.4 * math.clamp((target - origin).Magnitude / maxrange, 0, 1)
			kit:play("Magnet.X_Attract", base(player, root, {
				Stage = 2,
				Holding = holding,
				StartCFrame = startcframe,
				MaxRange = maxrange,
				TargetPosition = target,
				TravelTime = traveltime,
			}))
			kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
			task.delay(traveltime, function()
				enemiesnear(character, target, 16, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
					kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.x * 0.3, victimroot)
					stun(model, 1.6)
					local hold2 = victimroot.CFrame
					drivenpc(victimroot, 1.425, function()
						return hold2
					end)
				end)
				task.wait(1.425)
				blast(character, target, 20, data.damage.x * 0.7, 0.8)
			end)
		end
	elseif key == "C" then
		if held then
			local startcframe = root.CFrame
			local updist = 25
			kit:play("Magnet.C_Attract_Held", base(player, root, {
				Stage = 2,
				StartCFrame = startcframe,
				UpDist = updist,
				UpCFrame = startcframe + Vector3.new(0, updist, 0),
			}))
			kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1.8
			absorbwithin(root.Position, 60)
			local slam = kit:groundbelow(startcframe.Position, character)
			task.delay(1.3, function()
				blast(character, slam, 35, data.damage.cheld, 1.2)
			end)
			return
		end
		local landingflat = kit:clamprange(origin, flat, 60)
		local landing = kit:groundbelow(landingflat, character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		kit:play("Magnet.C_Attract", base(player, root, {
			Stage = 2,
			Holding = holding,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			UpCFrame = facing + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0),
			EndCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(landing, landing + facing.LookVector),
		}))
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1.3
		local grabbed = kit:firstalong(character, origin, origin + facing.LookVector * 30, 8)
		if grabbed then
			local model = grabbed.Parent
			stun(model, 1.6)
			local from = grabbed.Position
			drivenpc(grabbed, 0.6, function(alpha)
				local lift = from:Lerp(landing, alpha) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * 25, 0)
				return CFrame.new(lift)
			end)
		end
		task.delay(0.6, function()
			blast(character, landing, 22, data.damage.c, 1)
		end)
	elseif key == "F" then
		if held then
			return
		end
		local dashdist, dashtime = 55, 0.3
		local victim = kit:firstalong(character, origin, origin + facing.LookVector * dashdist, 9)
		kit:play("Magnet.F_Tap", base(player, root, {
			Stage = 2,
			Holding = holding,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			DashSpeed = dashtime,
			DashDist = dashdist,
			HitTarget = victim ~= nil,
		}))
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + dashtime + 0.3
		task.delay(dashtime, function()
			kit:damagealong(character, origin, origin + facing.LookVector * dashdist, 9, data.damage.f)
			if victim and victim.Parent then
				stun(victim.Parent, 1)
				disablesword(victim.Parent, data.swordlock)
			end
		end)
	end
end

				disablesword(model, data.swordlock)

local function onrelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	local token = hold
	hold = nil
	if not token or token.key ~= key then
		return
	end
	if token.trigger then
		token.trigger:Destroy()
	end
	if token.flying then
		return
	end
	if token.transformed then
		if token.held then
			return
		end
		mechtap(player, character, root, key, aim)
		return
	end
	basetap(player, character, root, key, aim, token.held)
end

local function onm1(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if os.clock() - lastm1 > 1.2 then
		combo = 0
	end
	lastm1 = os.clock()

	if istransformed.Value then
		combo = combo % 4 + 1
		kit:play("Magnet.Transformed.M1", base(player, root, { Stage = combo, Rig = transform.rig }))
		local center = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 14
		task.delay(0.2, function()
			blast(character, center, 16, data.damage.mechm1, 0.4)
		end)
		return
	end

	local tier = gettier()
	local length = tier + 2
	combo = combo % length + 1
	local slam = tier == 3 and combo == 5
	local prefix
	if combo == 1 then
		prefix = "MagnetM1Tier" .. tier
	elseif slam then
		prefix = "MagnetSlamTier" .. tier
	else
		prefix = "MagnetM" .. combo .. "Default"
	end

	kit:play("Magnet.M1", base(player, root, {
		Stage = combo,
		CurrentTier = tier,
		Slam = slam,
		TieredPrefix = prefix,
	}))
	if slam then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
	end
	local scale = tier == 3 and 1.5 or (tier == 2 and 1.15 or 1)
	local center = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * (slam and 4 or 5) * scale
	task.delay(0.15, function()
		blast(character, center, (slam and 13 or 9) * scale, (slam and data.damage.slam or data.damage.m1) * scale, 0.35)
	end)
end

local function watchhealth(character)
	if healthconnection then
		healthconnection:Disconnect()
		healthconnection = nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	lasthealth = humanoid.Health
	healthconnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		local loss = (lasthealth or health) - health
		lasthealth = health
		if loss <= 0 or health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		if istransformed.Value then
			humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, health + loss * data.mech.damagereduction)
			lasthealth = humanoid.Health
			return
		end
		if gettier() >= 3 then
			humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, health + loss * data.passive.tierthreedefense)
			lasthealth = humanoid.Health
		end
		addpower(-(loss / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)) * 100 * data.passive.drainperhealth)
		if flight then
			if os.clock() - flight.started <= 10 then
				flight.hits += 1
				if flight.hits >= data.flight.hitstocancel then
					endflight()
					kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true, F = true },
	maxhold = 15,
	canhold = function(player, character, root, key)
		if key == "F" and flight and not istransformed.Value then
			launchjetpack(player, character, root)
			return false
		end
		return spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = onholdstart,
	onrelease = onrelease,
	onm1 = onm1,
	onkey = function(player, character, root, humanoid, key)
		if key ~= "V" then
			return
		end
		if istransformed.Value then
			if os.clock() >= kit.busyuntil then
				endtransform(player)
			end
		else
			starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
		end
	end,
	onhit = function(amount, humanoid, root)
		if not root then
			return
		end
		kit:play("Magnet.Passive", { root, 1 })
		root:SetAttribute("LastHitMagnet", tick() + 0.5)
		local owner = kit:getowner()
		local character = kit:getcharacter()
		if owner and character and not istransformed.Value and os.clock() - scraps.lastspawn > data.passive.scrapcooldown then
			scraps.lastspawn = os.clock()
			spawnscraps(owner, character, root.Position, math.random(1, 2))
		end
	end,
	onpassivestart = function(player, character)
		if armfunctions then
			armfunctions:Destroy()
		end
		armfunctions = Instance.new("Folder")
		armfunctions.Name = "MagnetArmFunctions"
		armfunctions:SetAttribute("CurrentTier", 1)
		armfunctions.Parent = character
		kit:ragevalue(character)

		modeproxy = character:FindFirstChild("MagnetModeProxy")
		if not modeproxy then
			modeproxy = Instance.new("StringValue")
			modeproxy.Name = "MagnetModeProxy"
			modeproxy.Parent = character
		end
		modeproxy.Value = "Attract"

		kit:play("Magnet.Passive", {
			Character = character,
			Player = player,
			Proxy = armfunctions,
			TransformedProxy = transformedrig,
		})
		watchhealth(character)
	end,
	onunequip = function()
		endflight()
	end,
	onpassiveend = function()
		endtransform(kit:getowner(), true)
		endflight()
		clearscraps()
		if healthconnection then
			healthconnection:Disconnect()
			healthconnection = nil
		end
		if armfunctions then
			armfunctions:Destroy()
			armfunctions = nil
		end
		if modeproxy then
			modeproxy:Destroy()
			modeproxy = nil
		end
	end,
})

task.spawn(function()
	local step = 0.1
	local elapsed = 0
	while true do
		task.wait(step)
		elapsed += step
		local character = kit:getcharacter() or (kit.passivecharacter and kit.passivecharacter.Parent and kit.passivecharacter)
		local root = rootof(character)
		local rage = character and character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
		if character and root and armfunctions then
			local now = os.clock()
			for part, expires in pairs(scraps.list) do
				if not part.Parent or now > expires then
					scraps.list[part] = nil
					if part.Parent then
						part:Destroy()
					end
				elseif (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= pickupradius then
					absorbscrap(part, 0.3)
				end
			end

			local tier = gettier()
			local pull = pulltiers[tier]
			if pull and not istransformed.Value then
				enemiesnear(character, root.Position, pull.radius, function(_, _, victimroot)
					if (victimroot:GetAttribute("LastHitMagnet") or 0) <= tick() then
						pullnpc(victimroot, root.Position, pull.power)
					end
				end)
			end

			if rage and elapsed >= 0.25 then
				if istransformed.Value and transform.token then
					rage.Value = math.max(0, rage.Value - data.rage.transformdrainpersecond * elapsed)
					if rage.Value <= 0 then
						endtransform(kit:getowner())
					end
				end
				elapsed = 0
			end
		end
	end
end)
