source-071.source:
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local rigfit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("rigfit"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local istransformed = tool:WaitForChild("IsTransformed")
local transformedrig = tool:WaitForChild("TransformedRigObject")
local numtails = tool:WaitForChild("NumTails")
local beamcharge = tool:WaitForChild("RED_BEAM_MAX_CHARGE_TIME")
local beamduration = tool:WaitForChild("MAX_Z_BEAM_DURATION")
local armtime = tool:WaitForChild("ARM_EXTEND_TIME")
local armradius = tool:WaitForChild("UNTRANSFORMED_ARM_MAX_EXTEND_RADIUS")
local armradiusfox = tool:WaitForChild("TRANSFORMED_ARM_MAX_EXTEND_RADIUS")
local rigtemplate = serverstorage:WaitForChild("Rigs"):WaitForChild("Empyrean"):WaitForChild("Kitsune")
local cutscenemodel = serverstorage:WaitForChild("FX"):WaitForChild("RedKitsune"):WaitForChild("Cutscene"):WaitForChild("UltimateModel")

local kit
local combo, lastm1 = 0, 0
local tails = 0
local holdstarted = {}
local transform = { accessory = nil, rig = nil, token = nil, hidden = {}, walkspeed = nil, unfit = nil }

local function tailids(count)
	local ids = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		table.insert(ids, i)
	end
	return ids
end

local function settails(count)
	local character = kit:getcharacter() or kit.passivecharacter
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not character:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") then
		return
	end
	tails = count
	numtails.Value = count
	kit:play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = tailids(count), Tool = tool })
end

local function tailsfor(amount)
	if amount >= 200 / 3 then
		return 3
	elseif amount >= 100 / 3 then
		return 2
	end
	return 1
end

local function setrage(amount)
	local rage = kit:ragevalue()
	if not rage then
		return
	end
	rage.Value = math.clamp(amount, 0, 100)
	if not istransformed.Value then
		local count = tailsfor(rage.Value)
		if count ~= tails then
			settails(count)
		end
	end
end

local function addrage(amount)
	local rage = kit:ragevalue()
	if rage then
		setrage(rage.Value + amount)
	end
end

local function worldend(character, from, direction, distance)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
	}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(from, direction * distance, params)
	return result and result.Position or from + direction * distance
end

local function isnpc(model)
	return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) == nil
end

local function setbodyhidden(character, hidden)
	if hidden then
		for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local partoffox = transform.accessory and d:IsDescendantOf(transform.accessory)
			if not partoffox and (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 then
				transform.hidden[d] = d.Transparency
				d.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	else
		for d, transparency in pairs(transform.hidden) do
			if d.Parent then
				d.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		table.clear(transform.hidden)
	end
end

local function buildrig()
	local accessory = rigtemplate:Clone()
	for _, d in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and (d.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Seat" or d.Name:sub(1, 9) == "ProxyPart") then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or d.Name == "OriginalSize" then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.Massless = true
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	return accessory, accessory:WaitForChild("Kitsune")
end

local function endtransform(player, skipeffect)
	local accessory = transform.accessory
	transform.token = nil
	if not accessory then
		return
	end

	local character = accessory.Parent
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	transformedrig.Value = nil
	istransformed.Value = false
	if transform.unfit then
		transform.unfit()
		transform.unfit = nil
	end
	if character then
		setbodyhidden(character, false)
	end
	if humanoid and transform.walkspeed then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = transform.walkspeed
	end
	transform.walkspeed = nil
	accessory:Destroy()
	transform.accessory, transform.rig = nil, nil

	kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.8

	if not skipeffect and root then
		kit:play("Kitsune.Untransform", { Root = root })
	end
	tails = 0
	setrage(0)
end

local function starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if transform.accessory or not kit:canuse(character, "V") then
		return
	end
	local rage = kit:ragevalue(character)
	if not rage or rage.Value < 100 then
		return
	end
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1

	kit:play("Kitsune.V", { Player = player, Root = root, Toggle = true, Tool = tool })
	kit:play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = {}, Tool = tool })

	local accessory, rig = buildrig()
	local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local attachment = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("RootRigAttachment")
	if attachment then
		local bounds, size = rig:GetBoundingBox()
		local bottomoffset = (bounds.Position - rig:GetPivot().Position).Y - size.Y / 2
		local current = attachment.Position
		attachment.Position = Vector3.new(current.X, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + bottomoffset, current.Z)
	end
	humanoid:AddAccessory(accessory)
	transform.accessory, transform.rig = accessory, rig
	transformedrig.Value = rig
	transform.unfit = rigfit.fit(character, humanoid, root, rig)
	istransformed.Value = true
	setbodyhidden(character, true)
	transform.walkspeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 1.35

	kit:play("Kitsune.RedEmbers", { Root = root, Holding = kit.effectholding, Special = true, Tool = tool })
	task.delay(0.15, function()
		kit:damageradius(character, root.Position, 30, data.damage.v)
	end)

	local token = {}
	transform.token = token
	task.delay(data.transformduration or 40, function()
		if transform.token == token then
			endtransform(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function firebeam(player, character, root, aim)
	local fox = istransformed.Value
	local chargealpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - (holdstarted.Z or os.clock())) / beamcharge.Value, 0, 1)
	local full = chargealpha >= 1
	local duration = full and beamduration.Value or 0.2
	local distance = fox and 260 or 200
	local aimcframe = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, aim.target)
	if (aim.target - root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
		aimcframe = aim.facing
	end

	kit:play("Kitsune.RedBeam", {
		player = player,
		State = "Fire",
		Character = character,
		CF = aimcframe,
		Mouse = kit.mousepos,
		chargeAlpha = chargealpha,
		distance = distance,
		Tool = tool,
		transformed = fox,
		duration = duration,
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.4

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(0.2)
		local ends = os.clock() + duration
		local hits = {}
		local finish = root.Position
		repeat
			local from = root.Position
			local direction = full and (kit.mousepos.Value - from) or aimcframe.LookVector
			if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
			end
			direction = direction.Unit
			if fox then
				from = (CFrame.lookAt(from, from + direction) * CFrame.new(0, 5, -15)).Position
			end
			finish = worldend(character, from, direction, distance)
			local length = (finish - from).Magnitude
			kit:eachtarget(character, function(_, humanoid, victimroot)
				local t = math.clamp((victimroot.Position - from):Dot(direction), 0, length)
				if (from + direction * t - victimroot.Position).Magnitude <= (fox and 12 or 8) and os.clock() - (hits[humanoid] or 0) >= 0.25 then
					hits[humanoid] = os.clock()
					kit:hit(humanoid, full and data.damage.zbeam or data.damage.ztap, victimroot)
				end
			end)
			task.wait(0.1)
		until os.clock() >= ends or not root.Parent
		kit:damageradius(character, finish, 16, data.damage.zexplode)
	end)
end

local function tailsgrab(player, character, root)
	local fox = istransformed.Value
	local radius = fox and armradiusfox.Value or armradius.Value
	local victims, list = {}, {}
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
		if kit:canhit(model) and (victimroot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= radius + 10 then
			table.insert(victims, { model = model, humanoid = humanoid, root = victimroot })
			table.insert(list, { root = victimroot, inRange = true })
		end
	end)

	kit:play("Kitsune.RedM1Arm", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		Tool = tool,
		armMaxExtendRadius = radius,
		armExtendTime = armtime.Value,
		victimHrpsBindableOrTable = list,
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + armtime.Value * 2 + 0.2

	task.delay(armtime.Value, function()
		for _, victim in ipairs(victims) do
			if victim.root.Parent then
				kit:hit(victim.humanoid, data.damage.x, victim.root)
				if isnpc(victim.model) and not victim.root.Anchored then
					local offset = victim.root.Position - root.Position
					local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
					local pull = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
					victim.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + pull * (fox and 16 or 7)) * victim.root.CFrame.Rotation
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function firecannon(player, character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position + aim.forward * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local direction = aim.target - origin
	if direction.Magnitude < 1 then
		direction = aim.forward
	end
	direction = direction.Unit
	local speed, range = 160, 200
	local finish = worldend(character, origin, direction, range)
	local fliesfor = math.max((finish - origin).Magnitude / speed, 0.15)

	local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
	projectile.Name = "empyreanorb"
	projectile.Anchored = true
	projectile.CanCollide = false
	projectile.CanQuery = false
	projectile.CanTouch = false
	projectile.Transparency = 1
	projectile.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 8)
	projectile.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction)
	projectile.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") or workspace
	debris:AddItem(projectile, fliesfor + 3)

	kit:play("Kitsune.RedOrb", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = direction,
		projectilePart = projectile,
		fliesFor = fliesfor,
		projectileSpeed = speed,
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5

	local dragged = {}
	local started = os.clock()
	local connection
	connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - started
		local alpha = math.min(elapsed / fliesfor, 1)
		local position = origin + (finish - origin) * alpha
		projectile.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)

		kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
			if kit:canhit(model) and not dragged[victimroot] and (victimroot.Position - position).Magnitude <= 7 then
				dragged[victimroot] = { npc = isnpc(model), anchored = victimroot.Anchored }
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.cgrab, victimroot)
				kit:play("Kitsune.RedCProjectileDrag", {
					enemyRoot = victimroot,
					projectilePart = projectile,
					victimRootParts = {},
					syncedEndTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + (fliesfor - elapsed),
					initVec = direction,
					rotPerFrame = 0,
				})
			end
		end)

		for victimroot, info in pairs(dragged) do
			if info.npc and victimroot.Parent then
				victimroot.Anchored = true
				victimroot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, direction) * CFrame.Angles(7 * elapsed, 5 * elapsed, 5 * elapsed) + position + direction * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end

		if alpha >= 1 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			for victimroot, info in pairs(dragged) do
				if info.npc and victimroot.Parent then
					victimroot.Anchored = info.anchored
				end
			end
			kit:damageradius(character, finish, 18, data.damage.cexplode)
		end
	end)
end

local function victimcframe(dashend)
	local ok, offset = pcall(function()
		return cutscenemodel:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(cutscenemodel.VictimCF.CFrame)
	end)
	return dashend * CFrame.new(0, -7.297, 0) * (ok and offset or CFrame.new(0, 0, -20))
end

local function pounce(player, character, root, aim)
	local length, endsafter = 60, 0.45
	local startpos = root.Position
	local endpos = startpos + aim.forward * length
	local victimroot = kit:firstalong(character, startpos, endpos, 12)
	local victimmodel = victimroot and victimroot.Parent
	if victimroot then
		endpos = victimroot.Position - aim.forward * 10
		endpos = Vector3.new(endpos.X, startpos.Y, endpos.Z)
	end

	kit:play("Kitsune.Red_Cutscene", {
		Stage = "POUNCE",
		player = player,
		Player = player,
		Root = root,
		hrp = root,
		origin = startpos,
		Origin = startpos,
		fireDir = aim.forward,
		forwardCylinderLength = (endpos - startpos).Magnitude,
		endsAfter = endsafter,
		pounceStartPos = startpos,
		pounceEndPos = endpos,
		Tool = tool,
	})

	local rig = transform.rig
	if not victimroot or not rig then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + endsafter + 0.4
		task.delay(endsafter, function()
			kit:damagealong(character, startpos, endpos, 12, data.damage.cpounce)
		end)
		return
	end

	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + endsafter + 3.2
	local humanoid = victimmodel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local wasanchored = victimroot.Anchored

	task.delay(endsafter, function()
		if not victimroot.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local dashend = CFrame.lookAt(endpos, endpos + aim.forward)
		local projectileend = kit:groundbelow(endpos + aim.forward * 90, character) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		local holdat = victimcframe(dashend)

		kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.cpounce, victimroot)
		kit:play("Kitsune.Red_Cutscene", {
			Stage = 2,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			hrp = root,
			Character = character,
			Rig = rig,
			EnemyChar = victimmodel,
			dashEndCF = dashend,
			ProjectileEndPos = projectileend,
			Origin = endpos,
			Tool = tool,
		})

		victimroot.Anchored = true
		local started = os.clock()
		local connection
		connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local elapsed = os.clock() - started
			if not victimroot.Parent then
				connection:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			if elapsed < 131 / 60 then
				victimroot.CFrame = holdat
			elseif elapsed < 165 / 60 then
				local alpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 131 / 60) / (34 / 60), 0, 1)
				victimroot.CFrame = CFrame.new(holdat.Position:Lerp(projectileend, alpha)) * holdat.Rotation
			else
				connection:Disconnect()
				victimroot.CFrame = CFrame.new(projectileend) * holdat.Rotation
				victimroot.Anchored = wasanchored
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.cultimate, victimroot)
				kit:damageradius(character, projectileend, 20, data.damage.cexplode)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function wildassault(player, character, root, aim)
	local fox = istransformed.Value
	local total = fox and 90 or 70
	local sway = fox and 14 or 10
	local perdash = 0.14
	local points = { root.Position }
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local along = aim.origin + aim.forward * total * (i / 3)
		local side = i == 3 and 0 or ((i % 2 == 1) and sway or -sway)
		points[i + 1] = along + aim.right * side
	end

	kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + perdash * 3 + 0.3
	for i = 1, 3 do
		task.delay((i - 1) * perdash, function()
			local from, to = points[i], points[i + 1]
			kit:play("Kitsune.ZigzagDash", { player = player, hrp = root, originPos = from, goalPos = to, index = i })
			kit:play("Kitsune.ClientDash", { Root = root, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(to, to + aim.forward), Duration = perdash, Linear = true })
			task.delay(perdash, function()
				kit:damagealong(character, from, to, fox and 12 or 8, data.damage.f)
			end)
		end)
	end
end

local function onholdstart(player, character, root, key)
	holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
	local fox = istransformed.Value
	if key == "Z" then
		kit:play("Kitsune.RedZCharge", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			holding = kit.effectholding,
			maxChargeTime = beamcharge.Value,
		})
	elseif key == "C" then
		kit:play("Kitsune.CCharge", {
			player = player,
			hrp = root,
			holding = kit.effectholding,
			transformed = fox,
			mutated = true,
			cutsceneTransition = false,
		})
	end
end

local function onrelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	if key == "Z" then
		firebeam(player, character, root, aim)
	elseif key == "X" then
		tailsgrab(player, character, root)
	elseif key == "C" then
		if istransformed.Value then
			pounce(player, character, root, aim)
		else
			firecannon(player, character, root, aim)
		end
	end
end

local function onm1(player, character, root, humanoid)
	if os.clock() - lastm1 > 1.2 then
		combo = 0
	end
	lastm1 = os.clock()
	combo = combo % 5 + 1
	local final = combo == 5
	local fox = istransformed.Value
	local aim = kit:aim(root)

	kit:play("Kitsune.RedM1Combo", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		transformed = fox,
		index = combo,
		damageDir = aim.forward,
		playerOnGround = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air,
	})

	if final then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	end
	local reach = fox and 14 or 6
	local center = root.Position + aim.forward * reach
	local radius = (fox and 14 or 8) + (final and 4 or 0)
	task.delay(0.12, function()
		kit:damageradius(character, center, radius, final and data.damage.m1final or data.damage.m1)
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true },
	canhold = function()
		if istransformed.Value then
			addrage(-data.rage.skillcosttransformed)
		end
		return true
	end,
	onholdstart = onholdstart,
	onrelease = onrelease,
	onm1 = onm1,
	onkey = function(player, character, root, humanoid, key)
		if key == "V" then
			if istransformed.Value then
				if os.clock() >= kit.busyuntil then
					endtransform(player)
				end
			else
				starttransform(player, character, root, humanoid)
			end
		elseif key == "F" then
			if kit:canuse(character, "F") then
				if istransformed.Value then
					addrage(-data.rage.skillcosttransformed)
				end
				wildassault(player, character, root, kit:aim(root))
			end
		end
	end,
	onhit = function(amount)
		if not istransformed.Value then
			addrage(amount * data.rage.gainperdamage)
		end
	end,
	onpassivestart = function(player, character)
		tails = 0
		local rage = kit:ragevalue(character)
		setrage(rage and rage.Value or 0)
	end,
	onpassiveend = function(character)
		endtransform(kit:getowner(), true)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			kit:play("Kitsune.Tail", { Root = root, Ids = {}, Tool = tool })
		end
		tails = 0
	end,
})

task.spawn(function()
	local step = 0.25
	while true do
		task.wait(step)
		local character = kit:getcharacter() or (kit.passivecharacter and kit.passivecharacter.Parent and kit.passivecharacter)
		local rage = character and character:FindFirstChild("Rage")
		if rage then
			if istransformed.Value and transform.token then
				setrage(rage.Value - data.rage.transformdrainpersecond * step)
				if rage.Value <= 0 then
					endtransform(kit:getowner())
				end
			elseif not istransformed.Value and rage.Value < 100 then
				setrage(rage.Value + 100 * step / 300)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))
local tool = script.Parent
local kit
local flight = {}
local damageestimate = {
	Z = 2547,
	X = 3054,
	C = 3477,
}

local function spend(character, key)
	local energy = character and character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local cost = kit.data.Cost[key] or 0
	if cost > 0 then
		if not energy or energy.Value < cost then
			return false
		end
		energy.Value -= cost
	end
	return true
end

local function canpay(character, key)
	local energy = character and character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local cost = kit.data.Cost[key] or 0
	return cost <= 0 or energy and energy.Value >= cost
end

local function damagearea(character, position, radius, amount)
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, position, radius)) do
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount, target.root or target.part)
	end
end

local function rayend(character, root, target)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		character,
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"),
		workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin"),
	}
	local delta = target - root.Position
	if delta.Magnitude < 1 then
		delta = root.CFrame.LookVector * 500
	end
	local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, delta, params)
	return result and result.Position or root.Position + delta
end

local function onholdstart(player, character, root, key)
	if key == "Z" then
		local aim = kit:aim(root)
		local target = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, 500)
		kit:play("Rocket.Z", {
			Root = root,
			Position = target,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
		})
	elseif key == "F" then
		kit:play("Rocket.F", {
			Root = root,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
		})
		local mover = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		mover.Name = "RocketFlightVelocity"
		mover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(90000, 90000, 90000)
		mover.P = 1500
		mover.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 55, 0)
		mover.Parent = root
		flight[player] = mover
		task.spawn(function()
			local launched = os.clock()
			while kit.active and kit.active.key == "F" and kit.active.player == player and root.Parent and mover.Parent do
				local aim = kit:aim(root)
				local direction = Vector3.new(aim.target.X - root.Position.X, 0, aim.target.Z - root.Position.Z)
				if direction.Magnitude < 1 then
					direction = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
				end
				direction = direction.Magnitude > 0 and direction.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
				mover.Velocity = direction * 38 + Vector3.new(0, os.clock() - launched < 0.35 and 50 or 5, 0)
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
			if mover.Parent then
				mover:Destroy()
			end
			if flight[player] == mover then
				flight[player] = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function onrelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	if key == "F" then
		local mover = flight[player]
		flight[player] = nil
		if mover and mover.Parent then
			mover:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end
	if not spend(character, key) then
		return
	end
	local target = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, 500)
	local endpoint = rayend(character, root, target)
	kit:play("Rocket.Z", {
		Root = root,
		Position = endpoint,
	})
	local hit = hitbox.first(character, root.Position, endpoint, 2.5)
	local impact = hit and hit.root and hit.root.Position or endpoint
	local delaytime = math.min((impact - root.Position).Magnitude / 250, 2)
	task.delay(delaytime, function()
		if character.Parent then
			damagearea(character, impact, 7, damageestimate.Z)
		end
	end)
end

local function onkey(player, character, root, humanoid, key)
	if key ~= "X" and key ~= "C" then
		return
	end
	if not kit:canuse(character, key) or not spend(character, key) then
		return
	end
	kit.lastused[key] = os.clock()
	local aim = kit:aim(root)
	local target = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, key == "C" and 500 or 250)
	if key == "X" then
		local offsets = {
			Vector3.new(-12, 0, -12),
			Vector3.new(12, 0, -12),
			Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(-12, 0, 12),
			Vector3.new(12, 0, 12),
		}
		task.spawn(function()
			for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
				if not character.Parent then
					break
				end
				local ground = kit:groundbelow(target + offset, character)
				local start = ground + Vector3.new(0, 55, 0)
				kit:play("Rocket.X", {
					Position0 = CFrame.lookAt(start, ground),
					Position1 = CFrame.new(ground),
				})
				task.delay(0.25, function()
					if character.Parent then
						damagearea(character, ground, 9, damageestimate.X / 5)
					end
				end)
				task.wait(0.18)
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	local ground = kit:groundbelow(target, character)
	local mid = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
	local forward = Vector3.new(target.X - root.Position.X, 0, target.Z - root.Position.Z)
	if forward.Magnitude < 1 then
		forward = Vector3.new(aim.forward.X, 0, aim.forward.Z)
	end
	forward = forward.Magnitude > 0 and forward.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	kit:play("Rocket.C", {
		Root = root,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		Origin = root.Position,
		FireDir = forward,
		Mid = mid,
		Goal = ground,
	})
	task.spawn(function()
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, mid)
		task.wait(0.35)
		if not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(mid, ground)
		task.wait(0.1)
		if not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local height = math.min(3.5, root.Size.Y * 0.5 + humanoid.HipHeight)
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, height, 0), ground + forward)
		damagearea(character, ground, 18, damageestimate.C)
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, F = true },
	maxhold = 8,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return canpay(character, key)
	end,
	onholdstart = onholdstart,
	onrelease = onrelease,
	onkey = onkey,
	onunequip = function(player)
		local mover = player and flight[player]
		flight[player] = nil
		if mover and mover.Parent then
			mover:Destroy()
		end
	end,
})
tool.Destroying:Connect(function()
	for player, mover in pairs(flight) do
		flight[player] = nil
		if mover and mover.Parent then
			mover:Destroy()
		end
	end
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))
local tool = script.Parent
local held = {}
local charges = {}
local passive = {}
local kit
local damageestimate = {
	M1 = 55,
	Z = 320,
	X = 110,
	C = 300,
	V = 420,
	F = 190,
}

local function rootof(character)
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function orbs(character)
	local value = character and character:FindFirstChild("LightningOrbs")
	if not value and character then
		value = Instance.new("IntValue")
		value.Name = "LightningOrbs"
		value.Value = 4
		value.Parent = character
	end
	return value
end

local function canpay(character, key)
	local energy = character and character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local cost = kit and kit.data.Cost[key] or 0
	if cost > 0 and (not energy or energy.Value < cost) then
		return false
	end
	if key == "Z" or key == "F" or key == "V" then
		local value = orbs(character)
		if not value or value.Value < 1 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function spend(character, key)
	local energy = character and character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local cost = kit.data.Cost[key] or 0
	if cost > 0 then
		if not energy or energy.Value < cost then
			return false
		end
		energy.Value -= cost
	end
	if key == "Z" or key == "F" or key == "V" then
		local value = orbs(character)
		if not value or value.Value < 1 then
			return false
		end
		value.Value -= 1
	end
	return true
end

local function setstun(model, duration)
	local stun = model and model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if stun and stun:IsA("NumberValue") then
		stun.Value = math.max(stun.Value, duration)
	end
end

local function radius(character, position, size, amount, stunfor)
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, position, size)) do
		if kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount, target.root or target.part) and stunfor then
			setstun(target.model, stunfor)
		end
	end
end

local function playhold(player, character, root, key)
	held[key] = os.clock()
	charges[key] = 0
	local aim = kit:aim(root)
	if key == "Z" then
		kit:play("Lightning2.ZHeld", {
			Character = character,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
			player = player,
		})
	else
		local holdtarget = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, 700)
		kit:play("Lightning2." .. key, {
			Stage = 1,
			Character = character,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
			Root = root,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Origin = root.Position,
			StartCFrame = aim.facing,
			EndCFrame = CFrame.new(holdtarget),
			MousePos = aim.target,
		})
	end
	if key == "V" then
		task.spawn(function()
			local token = held[key]
			while held[key] == token and kit.active and kit.active.key == key and charges[key] < 3 do
				task.wait(0.65)
				if held[key] ~= token or not kit.active or kit.active.key ~= key then
					break
				end
				local value = orbs(character)
				if value and value.Value > 1 then
					value.Value -= 1
					charges[key] += 1
				else
					break
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function release(player, character, root, key, aim)
	local start = held[key] or os.clock()
	local duration = math.min(os.clock() - start, kit.maxhold)
	local charge = charges[key] or 0
	held[key] = nil
	charges[key] = nil
	if not spend(character, key) then
		return
	end
	local target = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, 700)
	local forward = (target - root.Position)
	if forward.Magnitude < 1 then
		forward = aim.forward * 100
	end
	forward = forward.Unit
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + forward)

	if key == "Z" then
		local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
		projectile.Name = "LightningHitbox"
		projectile.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
		projectile.Transparency = 1
		projectile.Anchored = true
		projectile.CanCollide = false
		projectile.CanTouch = false
		projectile.CanQuery = false
		projectile.CFrame = facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
		projectile:SetAttribute("Targeting", target)
		projectile.Parent = workspace
		kit:play("Lightning2.Z", {
			Stage = 2,
			Hitbox = projectile,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			Origin = root.Position,
			Speed = 150 + duration * 20,
			player = player,
		})
		kit:track({
			duration = 1.4,
			radius = 5,
			position = function()
				return projectile.Parent and projectile.Position or root.Position
			end,
			damage = damageestimate.Z,
			source = tool.Name,
		})
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 36 do
				if not projectile.Parent then
					break
				end
				projectile.CFrame += forward * 5
				task.wait(0.03)
			end
			if projectile.Parent then
				projectile:SetAttribute("Exploding", true)
				radius(character, projectile.Position, 12, damageestimate.Z, 0.25)
				debris:AddItem(projectile, 0.3)
			end
		end)
	elseif key == "X" then
		local cloudid = "LightningX_" .. tostring(player.UserId) .. "_" .. tostring(math.floor(os.clock() * 1000))
		local proxy = Instance.new("Part")
		proxy.Name = "LightningCloudProxy"
		proxy.Size = Vector3.one
		proxy.Transparency = 1
		proxy.Anchored = true
		proxy.CanCollide = false
		proxy.CanQuery = false
		proxy.CanTouch = false
		proxy.Position = target + Vector3.new(0, 36, 0)
		proxy:SetAttribute("Position", target)
		proxy.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("_WorldOrigin")
		kit:play("Lightning2.X", {
			Stage = 2,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			CloudId = cloudid,
			CloudProxy = proxy,
			Height = 36,
			Amount = damageestimate.X,
		})
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 4 do
				if not character.Parent then break end
				radius(character, target, 22, damageestimate.X, 0.2)
				task.wait(0.65)
			end
		end)
		debris:AddItem(proxy, 8)
	elseif key == "C" then
		kit:play("Lightning2.C", {
			Stage = 2,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			Origin = target,
			Position = target,
			Amount = damageestimate.C,
			Holding = kit.effectholding,
		})
		task.delay(0.75, function()
			if character.Parent then
				radius(character, target, 18, damageestimate.C, 1)
			end
		end)
	elseif key == "V" then
		local ground = kit:groundbelow(target, character)
		local endcframe = CFrame.lookAt(ground, ground + forward)
		kit:play("Lightning2.V", {
			Stage = 2,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			Origin = root.Position,
			StartCFrame = facing,
			EndCFrame = endcframe,
			Duration = 0.8 + charge * 0.45,
			Speed = 0.8 + charge * 0.45,
			Absorbed = 1 + charge,
			Amount = damageestimate.V * (1 + charge * 0.2),
			Size = 14 + charge * 3,
		})
		task.delay(0.8 + charge * 0.2, function()
			if character.Parent then
				radius(character, target, 18 + charge * 4, damageestimate.V * (1 + charge * 0.2), 0.4)
			end
		end)
	elseif key == "F" then
		local endposition = kit:clamprange(root.Position, target, 85)
		local rayparams = RaycastParams.new()
		rayparams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		rayparams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies"), workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") }
		local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, endposition - root.Position, rayparams)
		if result then
			endposition = result.Position - forward * 3
		end
		kit:play("Lightning2.F", {
			Stage = 2,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Root = root,
			StartCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(endposition, endposition + forward),
			StartCFrame2 = facing,
			newCF = CFrame.lookAt(endposition, endposition + forward),
		})
		local from = root.Position
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(endposition, endposition + forward)
		kit:damagealong(character, from, endposition, 7, damageestimate.F)
	end
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true, V = true, F = true },
	maxhold = 3,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return canpay(character, key)
	end,
	onholdstart = playhold,
	onrelease = release,
	onm1 = function(player, character, root)
		if tool.Holding:IsA("BoolValue") then
			tool.Holding.Value = true
		end
		local aim = kit:aim(root)
		kit:play("Lightning2.M1", {
			Character = character,
			Holding = tool.Holding,
			Root = root,
			Player = player,
			player = player,
			Origin = root.Position,
			MousePos = aim.target,
			Range = 10,
		})
		kit:damagealong(character, root.Position, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 9, 5, damageestimate.M1)
		task.delay(0.2, function()
			if tool.Parent then
				tool.Holding.Value = false
			end
		end)
	end,
	onpassivestart = function(player, character)
		local value = orbs(character)
		local token = {}
		passive[player] = token
		task.spawn(function()
			while passive[player] == token and character.Parent and character:GetAttribute("passivefruit") == tool.Name do
				task.wait(5)
				if passive[player] == token and value.Value < 4 then
					value.Value += 1
				end
			end
		end)
	end,
	onpassiveend = function(character)
		local player = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			passive[player] = nil
		end
		local value = character:FindFirstChild("LightningOrbs")
		if value then
			value:Destroy()
		end
	end,
})

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))

local function ensure(classname, name)
	local value = tool:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not value then
		value = Instance.new(classname)
		value.Name = name
		value.Parent = tool
	end
	return value
end

local cremote = ensure("RemoteEvent", "DoughCRemote")
local wheelremote = ensure("RemoteEvent", "DoughWheelRemote")

local kit
local combo, lastm1 = 0, 0
local hold = nil
local wheel = nil
local grab = nil
local tapsides = { "Right", "Left", "Both" }

local function isnpc(model)
	return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) == nil
end

local function rootof(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function enemyof(character, model)
	if model == character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if isnpc(model) then
		return true
	end
	return character:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false and model:GetAttribute("PvpDisabled") == false
end

local function stun(model, duration)
	local value = model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if not value or not value:IsA("ValueBase") then
		return
	end
	value.Value = math.max(value.Value, duration)
	if isnpc(model) then
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if value.Parent and value.Value <= duration then
				value.Value = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function spend(character, cost)
	local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	if not energy or not cost or cost <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if energy.Value < cost then
		return false
	end
	energy.Value -= cost
	return true
end

local function enemiesnear(character, position, radius, callback)
	kit:eachtarget(character, function(model, humanoid, root)
		if enemyof(character, model) and (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= radius then
			callback(model, humanoid, root)
		end
	end)
end

local function blast(character, position, radius, amount, stunfor)
	enemiesnear(character, position, radius, function(model, humanoid, root)
		kit:hit(humanoid, amount, root)
		if stunfor then
			stun(model, stunfor)
		end
	end)
end

local function holdnpc(root, path, duration)
	if not isnpc(root.Parent) then
		return function() end
	end
	local wasanchored = root.Anchored
	root.Anchored = true
	local started = os.clock()
	local released = false
	local connection
	local function release()
		if released then
			return
		end
		released = true
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		if root.Parent then
			root.Anchored = wasanchored
		end
	end
	connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not root.Parent or os.clock() - started >= duration then
			release()
			return
		end
		local cframe = path(os.clock() - started)
		if cframe then
			root.CFrame = cframe
		end
	end)
	return release
end

local function worldorigin()
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") or workspace
end

local function rayparams(character)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignore = { character, worldorigin() }
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Characters", "Enemies" }) do
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if folder then
			table.insert(ignore, folder)
		end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	return params
end

local function worldhit(character, from, to)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, rayparams(character))
	if result then
		return result.Position, result.Normal, true
	end
	return to, Vector3.yAxis, false
end

local function ground(character, position, depth)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -(depth or 200), 0), rayparams(character))
	if result then
		return result.Position, result.Normal
	end
	return nil
end

local function buso(character, player)
	if not character:FindFirstChild("HasBuso") then
		return nil
	end
	local value = player and player:FindFirstChild("BusoColor")
	return value and value.Value or Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
end

local function grounded(character)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end

local function servertime()
	return meleekit.now()
end

local function indicator(root, lifetime)
	local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = "DoughIndicator"
	value:SetAttribute("Holding", true)
	value:SetAttribute("Scale", 1)
	value.Parent = root
	debris:AddItem(value, lifetime)
	return value
end

local function punch(player, character, root, side, target, charged)
	local playerbuso = buso(character, player)
	local marker = indicator(root, 3)
	local offset = side == "Left" and -1.6 or 1.6
	kit:play("Dough.TAP", {
		Stage = 1,
		Anchor = root,
		Side = side,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(offset, 1.2, -1),
		Scale = { 0, charged and 1.6 or 1 },
		Lifetime = marker,
		FadeIn = 0.15,
		FadeOut = 0.4,
		Mouse = kit.mousepos,
	})
	task.wait(0.15)
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	local origin = (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset, 1.2, -1)).Position
	local range = charged and data.tap.chargedrange or data.tap.range
	local endpoint, normal, hit = worldhit(character, origin, origin + (target - origin).Unit * range)
	marker:SetAttribute("Holding", false)
	kit:play("Dough.TAP", {
		Stage = 2,
		Root = root,
		Side = side,
		Indicator = marker,
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, endpoint),
		Scale = Vector2.new(data.tap.width * (charged and 1.4 or 1), (endpoint - origin).Magnitude),
		ExtendDuration = 0.12,
		FreezeDuration = 0.05,
		RetractDuration = 0.3,
		Buso = playerbuso,
		MaximumFloorMultiplier = charged and 2 or 1,
		RayCastResult = hit and { Position = endpoint, Normal = normal } or nil,
	})
	task.wait(0.1)
	local amount = charged and data.damage.tapcharged or data.damage.tap
	enemiesnear(character, origin, range + 4, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
		local along = victimroot.Position - origin
		local direction = (endpoint - origin).Unit
		local distance = along:Dot(direction)
		if distance >= 0 and distance <= range + 2 and (along - direction * distance).Magnitude <= 5 then
			kit:hit(humanoid, amount, victimroot)
			stun(model, 0.6)
			meleekit.push(victimroot, direction, 45, 8)
		end
	end)
end

local function onm1(player, character, root)
	if os.clock() - lastm1 > data.tap.reset then
		combo = 0
	end
	lastm1 = os.clock()
	combo = combo % #tapsides + 1
	local side = tapsides[combo]
	local target = kit.mousepos.Value
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.3
	if side == "Both" then
		task.spawn(punch, player, character, root, "Left", target, true)
		task.spawn(punch, player, character, root, "Right", target, true)
	else
		task.spawn(punch, player, character, root, side, target, false)
	end
end

local function missile(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local power = math.clamp(held / data.z.holdfull, 0, 1)
	local full = held >= data.z.holdfull
	local speed = data.z.speed
	local range = full and data.z.heldrange or data.z.range
	local scale = 1 + power * 0.8
	local origin = (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 1, -2)).Position
	local direction = (aim.target - origin).Unit
	if direction ~= direction then
		direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "DoughMissile"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 6) * scale
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction)
	part.Parent = worldorigin()
	debris:AddItem(part, range / speed + 4)
	task.wait()
	kit:play("Dough.Misc.Projectile", {
		Method = "Create",
		Anchor = part,
		Scale = scale,
		Data = { Speed = speed, Timestamp = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() },
	})
	kit:play("Dough.Misc.Projectile", { Method = "Ignite", Anchor = part, Enabled = true })
	if held > 0.2 then
		meleekit.push(root, -direction, data.z.recoil * power, 10 * power)
	end
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.4
	local travelled = 0
	local dragged = {}
	local position = origin
	local impact, grounded_ = nil, false
	while travelled < range and part.Parent do
		local dt = runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local step = speed * dt
		local nextposition = position + direction * step
		local result = workspace:Raycast(position, nextposition - position, rayparams(character))
		if result then
			impact = result.Position
			grounded_ = result.Normal.Y > 0.5
			break
		end
		position = nextposition
		travelled += step
		part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
		enemiesnear(character, position, data.z.radius * scale, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
			if not dragged[model] then
				dragged[model] = victimroot
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.zdrag, victimroot)
				stun(model, 1)
			end
		end)
		for model, victimroot in pairs(dragged) do
			if victimroot.Parent and isnpc(model) then
				victimroot.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + direction * 2)
				victimroot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end
	end
	impact = impact or position
	kit:play("Dough.Misc.Projectile", {
		Method = "Destroy",
		Anchor = part,
		Data = { FadeOut = 0.5, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(impact, impact + direction) },
	})
	local radius = full and data.z.heldexplosion or data.z.explosion
	kit:play("Dough.Explosions.Generic", {
		CFrame = CFrame.new(impact),
		Scale = radius,
		Duration = 0.6,
		Lifetime = 1.5,
		Grounded = grounded_,
	})
	local amount = full and data.damage.zheld or data.damage.z
	enemiesnear(character, impact, radius, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
		kit:hit(humanoid, amount, victimroot)
		stun(model, 0.8)
		meleekit.push(victimroot, (victimroot.Position - impact), 60, 30)
	end)
	debris:AddItem(part, 2)
end

local function pastryground(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local power = math.clamp(held / data.x.holdfull, 0, 1)
	local scale = 1 + power
	local target = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, data.x.range)
	local spot, normal = ground(character, target, 300)
	spot = spot or target
	normal = normal or Vector3.yAxis
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(spot, spot + root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
	kit:play("Dough.X.Ground", {
		CFrame = cframe,
		Scale = scale,
		EruptDelay = data.x.eruptdelay,
		Lifetime = data.x.holdup + 0.6,
		FadeIn = 0.2,
		FadeOut = 0.5,
		FloorLifetime = 3,
		AnimationSpeed = 1,
		PulsateInfluence = 1,
		Buso = buso(character, player),
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.6
	task.wait(data.x.eruptdelay)
	local radius = data.x.radius * scale
	enemiesnear(character, spot, radius, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
		kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.xground * (0.8 + power * 0.4), victimroot)
		stun(model, data.x.holdup + 1)
		local from = victimroot.Position
		local top = from + Vector3.new(0, data.x.lift * scale, 0)
		holdnpc(victimroot, function(elapsed)
			local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.25, 0, 1)
			if elapsed > data.x.holdup then
				alpha = 1 - math.clamp((elapsed - data.x.holdup) / 0.25, 0, 1)
			end
			return CFrame.new(from:Lerp(top, alpha))
		end, data.x.holdup + 0.3)
		task.delay(data.x.holdup + 0.25, function()
			if humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.xgroundslam, victimroot)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function pastryair(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local power = math.clamp(held / data.x.holdfull, 0, 1)
	local length = data.x.airrange + (data.x.airheldrange - data.x.airrange) * power
	local upperarm = character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
	local shoulder = upperarm and upperarm:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
	local lowerarm = character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm")
	local elbow = lowerarm and lowerarm:FindFirstChild("RightElbow")
	local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	local wrist = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("RightWrist")
	local origin = upperarm and upperarm.Position or root.Position
	local direction = (aim.target - origin).Unit
	if direction ~= direction then
		direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	local point, normal, hitworld = worldhit(character, origin, origin + direction * length)
	if shoulder and elbow and wrist then
		kit:play("Dough.X.Aerial.Arm", {
			Root = root,
			HRP = root,
			Anchor = upperarm,
			AnchorJoint = shoulder,
			AnchorJoint2 = elbow,
			AnchorJoint3 = wrist,
			Point = point,
			Length = (point - origin).Magnitude,
			Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (1 + power * 0.5),
			ExtendDuration = 0.25,
			RetractDuration = 0.35,
			RayCastResult = hitworld and { Position = point, Normal = normal } or nil,
		})
	end
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.7
	local target = meleekit.firstline(character, origin, point, 5 + power * 3)
	if not target then
		return
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
	if not meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		return
	end
	stun(target.model, data.x.barrage + 1.2)
	local effectid = player.UserId .. "_" .. math.floor(os.clock() * 1000)
	local holdat = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, -8)
	local release = holdnpc(target.root, function()
		return holdat
	end, data.x.barrage + 0.6)
	local landing = ground(character, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 14, 300) or (root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 10, 0))
	local reach = CFrame.new(landing)
	kit:play("Dough.X.Aerial.Ball", {
		EffectId = effectid,
		Stage = 1,
		CFrame = holdat,
		ReachCFrame = holdat,
		Scale = 3,
		Duration = data.x.barrage,
		FadeIn = 0.2,
		FadeOut = 0.4,
	})
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + data.x.barrage + 0.8
	local stop = os.clock() + data.x.barrage
	while os.clock() < stop and meleekit.alive(target.model) and root.Parent do
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.damage.xairbarrage, target.root)
		task.wait(data.x.barragetick)
	end
	kit:play("Dough.X.Aerial.Ball", {
		EffectId = effectid,
		Stage = 2,
		CFrame = holdat,
		ReachCFrame = reach,
		Scale = 3,
		Duration = 0.3,
	})
	release()
	if target.root.Parent and isnpc(target.model) then
		target.root.CFrame = reach + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	end
	task.wait(0.3)
	kit:play("Dough.X.Aerial.Explosion", { CFrame = reach, Scale = 18, Duration = 0.5, Lifetime = 1.5 })
	if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.damage.xairslam, target.root)
		stun(target.model, 0.8)
	end
	blast(character, landing, 16, data.damage.xairslam * 0.4, 0.5)
end

local function hidebody(character, hidden)
	local model = wheel and wheel.model
	for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and not (model and d:IsDescendantOf(model)) then
			if hidden then
				if d.Transparency < 1 then
					d:SetAttribute("doughhidden", d.Transparency)
					d.Transparency = 1
				end
			elseif d:GetAttribute("doughhidden") ~= nil then
				d.Transparency = d:GetAttribute("doughhidden")
				d:SetAttribute("doughhidden", nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function stopwheel(skipeffect)
	local current = wheel
	if not current then
		return
	end
	wheel = nil
	current.token = nil
	if current.connection then
		current.connection:Disconnect()
	end
	local character = current.character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if current.collision and current.collision.Parent then
		current.collision:SetAttribute("Destroy", true)
	end
	if current.model then
		debris:AddItem(current.model, skipeffect and 0 or 0.4)
	end
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
	if character then
		hidebody(character, false)
	end
	tool:SetAttribute("doughwheel", false)
end

local function startwheel(player, character, root, maxspeed, duration, oncontact)
	stopwheel(true)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "DoughWheel"
	local wheelpart = Instance.new("Part")
	wheelpart.Name = "WheelPart"
	wheelpart.Size = data.f.size
	wheelpart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	wheelpart.Transparency = 1
	wheelpart.CanCollide = true
	wheelpart.CanQuery = false
	wheelpart.CanTouch = false
	wheelpart.CFrame = root.CFrame
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("MaxSpeed", maxspeed)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("MaxInputTurnPower", 1)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("MaxCameraTurnPower", 0.6)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("TurnSpeedNudgeInterpolate", 4)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("DriftAboveTurnPower", 0.8)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("MaxTurnSpeed", 2.5)
	wheelpart:SetAttribute("MaxTiltAngle", 0.35)
	wheelpart.Parent = model
	local collision = Instance.new("Part")
	collision.Name = "Wheel"
	collision.Size = Vector3.new(data.f.size.X, data.f.size.Y, data.f.size.Z * 0.4)
	collision.Transparency = 1
	collision.CanCollide = false
	collision.CanQuery = false
	collision.CanTouch = false
	collision.Massless = true
	collision.CFrame = wheelpart.CFrame
	collision.Parent = wheelpart
	local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	joint.Name = "Motor6D"
	joint.Part0 = wheelpart
	joint.Part1 = collision
	joint.Parent = collision
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "WheelAttachment"
	attachment.Parent = collision
	local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.zero
	velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	velocity.Parent = wheelpart
	local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 4e5
	gyro.P = 3000
	gyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
	gyro.Parent = wheelpart
	local position = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
	position.MaxForce = Vector3.zero
	position.Parent = wheelpart
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = wheelpart
	weld.Part1 = root
	weld.Parent = wheelpart
	model.PrimaryPart = wheelpart
	model.Parent = character
	for _, part in ipairs({ wheelpart, collision }) do
		pcall(function()
			part:SetNetworkOwner(player)
		end)
	end
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	end
	local token = {}
	wheel = { model = model, part = wheelpart, collision = collision, character = character, player = player, token = token }
	hidebody(character, true)
	tool:SetAttribute("doughwheel", true)
	kit:play("Dough.F", {
		Character = character,
		Wheel = collision,
		Scale = 1,
		FadeIn = 0.5,
		FadeOut = 0.25,
		Buso = buso(character, player),
	})
	local hitcooldown = {}
	local started = os.clock()
	wheel.connection = runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if wheel == nil or wheel.token ~= token then
			return
		end
		if not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or os.clock() - started > duration then
			stopwheel()
			return
		end
		if wheelpart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 12 then
			return
		end
		enemiesnear(character, wheelpart.Position, data.f.radius, function(model_, humanoid_, victimroot)
			if oncontact then
				if oncontact(model_, humanoid_, victimroot) then
					return
				end
			end
			if os.clock() - (hitcooldown[model_] or 0) >= data.f.tick then
				hitcooldown[model_] = os.clock()
				kit:hit(humanoid_, data.damage.f, victimroot)
				stun(model_, 0.35)
			end
		end)
	end)
	return token
end

wheelremote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, info)
	if not wheel or wheel.player ~= player or type(info) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if info.Wheel ~= wheel.collision or type(info.Attributes) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local turn = tonumber(info.Attributes.CurrentTurnSpeed)
	if turn then
		wheel.collision:SetAttribute("CurrentTurnSpeed", math.clamp(turn, -5, 5))
	end
end)

cremote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, info)
	if not grab or grab.player ~= player or type(info) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if info.Weld ~= grab.weld or typeof(info.C0) ~= "CFrame" then
		return
	end
	if info.C0.Position.Magnitude <= data.c.raise * 3 then
		grab.weld.C0 = info.C0
	end
end)

local function setcstage(character, stage)
	character:SetAttribute("DoughAwakenedCStage", stage)
end

local function clothesline(player, character, root, target)
	local c = data.c
	local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
	hitbox.Name = "DoughCHitbox"
	hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
	hitbox.Transparency = 1
	hitbox.CanCollide = false
	hitbox.CanQuery = false
	hitbox.CanTouch = false
	hitbox.Massless = true
	hitbox.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -6)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "Weld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = hitbox
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, -6)
	weld.Parent = hitbox
	hitbox.Parent = character
	pcall(function()
		hitbox:SetNetworkOwner(player)
	end)
	grab = { player = player, weld = weld, hitbox = hitbox }

	local center = CFrame.new(root.Position) * root.CFrame.Rotation
	local slamspot = ground(character, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * c.slamdistance, 300) or (root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * c.slamdistance)
	local slamcframe = CFrame.new(slamspot)
	local total = c.windup + c.spin + c.slam + c.slamhold + c.retract
	local victims = {}
	if target then
		victims[target.model] = target
	end
	local function holdvictims(duration)
		for model, victim in pairs(victims) do
			stun(model, duration + 0.3)
			holdnpc(victim.root, function()
				return hitbox.Parent and hitbox.CFrame or nil
			end, duration)
		end
	end

	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + total + 0.3
	local playerbuso = buso(character, player)
	setcstage(character, 1)
	kit:play("Dough.C", {
		Stage = 1,
		Character = character,
		Hitbox = hitbox,
		Remote = cremote,
		Buso = playerbuso,
		CFrame = center,
		SlamCFrame = slamcframe,
		RaiseHeight = c.raise,
		TotalSpins = c.spins,
		WindUpDuration = c.windup,
		SpinDuration = c.spin,
		SlamDuration = c.slam,
		SlamHoldDuration = c.slamhold,
		RetractDuration = c.retract,
		Timestamp = servertime(),
	})
	holdvictims(total)
	task.wait(c.windup)
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	setcstage(character, 2)
	kit:play("Dough.C", { Stage = 2, Character = character, Timestamp = servertime() })
	local spinend = os.clock() + c.spin
	while os.clock() < spinend and root.Parent do
		enemiesnear(character, hitbox.Position, 10, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
			if not victims[model] then
				victims[model] = { model = model, humanoid = humanoid, root = victimroot }
				stun(model, spinend - os.clock() + c.slam + c.slamhold + 0.5)
				holdnpc(victimroot, function()
					return hitbox.Parent and hitbox.CFrame or nil
				end, spinend - os.clock() + c.slam)
			end
			kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.cspin, victimroot)
		end)
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	setcstage(character, 3)
	kit:play("Dough.C", { Stage = 3, Character = character, Timestamp = servertime() })
	task.wait(c.slam)
	for model, victim in pairs(victims) do
		if victim.root.Parent and isnpc(model) then
			victim.root.CFrame = slamcframe + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		end
	end
	blast(character, slamspot, c.slamradius, data.damage.cslam, 0.9)
	for model, victim in pairs(victims) do
		if victim.root.Parent then
			meleekit.push(victim.root, Vector3.zero, 0, 55)
		end
	end
	meleekit.push(root, Vector3.zero, 0, 40)
	task.wait(c.slamhold)
	setcstage(character, 4)
	kit:play("Dough.C", { Stage = 4, Character = character, Timestamp = servertime() })
	task.wait(c.retract)
	kit:play("Dough.C", { Stage = -1, Character = character, Timestamp = servertime() })
	setcstage(character, nil)
	grab = nil
	hitbox:Destroy()
end

local function clothesroll(player, character, root)
	local hit = nil
	local token
	token = startwheel(player, character, root, data.c.rollspeed, data.c.maxroll, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
		if hit then
			return true
		end
		hit = { model = model, humanoid = humanoid, root = victimroot }
		kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.croll, victimroot)
		task.defer(function()
			if wheel and wheel.token == token then
				stopwheel()
				clothesline(player, character, root, hit)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end)
	hold.ctoken = token
end

local function fusillade(player, character, root)
	local v = data.v
	local center = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 2)
	local holding = kit.effectholding
	kit:play("Dough.V", {
		CFrame = center,
		Mouse = kit.mousepos,
		Holding = holding,
		ZoneRadius = v.zone,
		Lengths = v.lengths,
		Scales = v.scales,
		Width = v.width,
		WidthMultiplier = 1,
		MinDuration = v.mintime,
		MaxDuration = v.maxtime,
		StartLag = v.startlag,
		Timestamp = servertime(),
		Delay = 0,
		DragSpeed = v.drag,
		Buso = buso(character, player),
	})
	task.spawn(function()
		local function zonepoint(mouse)
			local offset = mouse - center.Position
			local distance = math.min(offset.Magnitude, v.zone)
			return center.Position + (offset.Magnitude > 0 and offset.Unit or Vector3.zero) * distance
		end
		local point = zonepoint(kit.mousepos.Value)
		local started = os.clock()
		local released = false
		task.wait(v.startlag)
		while root.Parent do
			local elapsed = os.clock() - started
			if not holding.Value then
				released = true
			end
			if (released and elapsed > v.mintime) or elapsed > v.maxtime then
				break
			end
			local mouse = kit.mousepos.Value
			local toward = mouse - point
			point += (toward.Magnitude > 0 and toward.Unit or Vector3.zero) * v.drag * v.tick * 1.5
			if (point - center.Position).Magnitude > v.zone then
				point = center.Position + (point - center.Position).Unit * v.zone
			end
			local spot = point
			enemiesnear(character, spot, v.radius, function(model, humanoid, victimroot)
				kit:hit(humanoid, data.damage.v, victimroot)
				stun(model, 0.5)
				if isnpc(model) and not victimroot.Anchored then
					victimroot.CFrame = victimroot.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(spot) * victimroot.CFrame.Rotation, 0.5)
					victimroot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end)
			task.wait(v.tick)
		end
	end)
end

local function onholdstart(player, character, root, key)
	hold = { key = key, started = os.clock(), player = player }
	if key == "C" then
		clothesroll(player, character, root)
	elseif key == "V" then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + data.v.mintime
		fusillade(player, character, root)
	end
end

local function onrelease(player, character, root, key, aim)
	local token = hold
	hold = nil
	if not token or token.key ~= key then
		return
	end
	local held = os.clock() - token.started
	if key == "Z" then
		missile(player, character, root, aim, held)
	elseif key == "X" then
		if grounded(character) then
			pastryground(player, character, root, aim, held)
		else
			pastryair(player, character, root, aim, held)
		end
	elseif key == "C" then
		if wheel and token.ctoken and wheel.token == token.ctoken then
			stopwheel()
			clothesline(player, character, root, nil)
		end
	end
end

local function onkey(player, character, root, humanoid, key)
	if key ~= "F" then
		return
	end
	if wheel and not grab then
		stopwheel()
		kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
		return
	end
	if not kit:canuse(character, "F") or not spend(character, data.Cost.F) then
		return
	end
	kit.lastused.F = os.clock()
	startwheel(player, character, root, data.f.maxspeed, data.f.duration)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true, V = true },
	maxhold = data.v.maxtime,
	canhold = function(player, character, root, key)
		if wheel then
			return false
		end
		return spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = onholdstart,
	onrelease = onrelease,
	onm1 = function(player, character, root)
		if wheel then
			return
		end
		onm1(player, character, root)
	end,
	onkey = onkey,
	onunequip = function()
		hold = nil
		stopwheel()
	end,
	onpassiveend = function(character)
		stopwheel(true)
		if character then
			setcstage(character, nil)
		end
	end,
})
