local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local kit
local holdstarted = {}
local overheatuntil = 0
local drillactive = nil

local function overheated()
	return os.clock() < overheatuntil
end

local function effect(name)
	return overheated() and ("DeathStep2.Mode." .. name) or ("DeathStep2." .. name)
end

local function amount(base)
	return base * (overheated() and data.OverheatBoost or 1)
end

local function marker(name, parent, life)
	local value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	value.Name = name
	value.Value = true
	value.Parent = parent
	debris:AddItem(value, life)
	return value
end

local function burn(character, position)
	if not overheated() then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local started = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - started < data.Overheat.FireTime and character.Parent do
			meleekit.area(kit, character, position, data.Overheat.FireRadius, data.Damage.Fire)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

local function rocketkickstart(root)
	local using = marker("deathstepusing", root, 3)
	holdstarted.using = using
	kit:play(effect("RocketKick"), { HRP = root, Holding = kit.effectholding, Using = using })
end

local function rocketkick(character, root, aim, held)
	local using = holdstarted.using
	holdstarted.using = nil
	local power = math.clamp(held / data.Kick.MaxHold, 0, 1)
	local direction = aim.target - root.Position
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
	local range = data.Kick.Range * (0.7 + power * 0.6)
	local speed = data.Kick.Speed * (1 + power * 0.35)
	local duration = range / speed
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z))
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.3
	local hit = {}
	local impact = nil
	local normal = Vector3.yAxis
	meleekit.dash(character, root, direction, speed, duration, nil, function()
		if impact then
			return
		end
		local wall = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction * 4, meleekit.rayparams(character))
		if wall then
			impact, normal = wall.Position, wall.Normal
		end
		for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, root.Position + direction * 2, data.Kick.Radius)) do
			if not hit[target.model] and meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				hit[target.model] = true
				if kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount(data.Damage.Z), target.root) then
					meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.5)
					meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 75, 20)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	if using then
		using:Destroy()
	end
	if impact then
		kit:play(effect("RocketKick"), { HRP = root, Position = impact, Normal = normal, Scale = 1 + power * 0.5 })
		meleekit.area(kit, character, impact, data.Kick.DentRadius, amount(data.Damage.Z) * 0.5, { stun = 0.4 })
		burn(character, impact)
	end
end

local function windbullet(character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local direction = aim.target - origin
	direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
	local impact = meleekit.impact(character, origin, direction, data.Bullet.Range)
	local target = meleekit.firstline(character, origin, impact, data.Bullet.Radius)
	if target and (target.root.Position - origin).Magnitude < (impact - origin).Magnitude then
		impact = target.root.Position
	end
	local length = (impact - origin).Magnitude
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.4
	kit:play(effect("AirShot"), { CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction), Character = character, Length = length, SCALE = 1 })
	task.delay(length / data.Bullet.Speed, function()
		if not character.Parent then
			return
		end
		if target and meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount(data.Damage.X), target.root)
		end
		meleekit.area(kit, character, impact, data.Bullet.ExplosionRadius, amount(data.Damage.X) * 1.25, { stun = 0.4, push = 45, lift = 25 })
		burn(character, meleekit.ground(character, impact))
	end)
end

local function drillstart(character, root)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if meleekit.grounded(character, root) then
		local hop = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		hop.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 1e6, 0)
		hop.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)
		hop.Parent = root
		debris:AddItem(hop, 0.2)
	end
	local active = marker("deathstepdrill", root, data.Drill.MaxHold + 1)
	drillactive = active
	kit:play(effect("Drill"), { Character = character, Active = active })
	local hover = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	hover.Name = "deathstephover"
	hover.MaxForce = Vector3.one * 1e6
	hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	hover.Parent = root
	local caught = {}
	task.spawn(function()
		local started = os.clock()
		while active.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 and os.clock() - started < data.Drill.MaxHold and (kit.effectholding.Value or os.clock() - started < data.Drill.MinHold) do
			task.wait(0.15)
			if os.clock() - started >= 0.2 then
				hover.Parent = nil
			end
			local aim = kit:aim(root)
			local direction = aim.target - root.Position
			direction = direction.Magnitude > 1 and direction.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
			local center = root.Position + direction * data.Drill.Reach * 0.5
			for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.box(character, CFrame.lookAt(center, center + direction), Vector3.new(7, 7, data.Drill.Reach))) do
				if meleekit.alive(target.model) and kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount(data.Damage.C), target.root) then
					caught[target.model] = target
					meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.5)
				end
			end
		end
		hover:Destroy()
		if active.Parent then
			active:Destroy()
		end
		drillactive = nil
		for model, target in pairs(caught) do
			if meleekit.alive(model) then
				kit:hit(target.humanoid, amount(data.Damage.CFinish), target.root)
				meleekit.push(target.root, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), 0, -60)
				burn(character, meleekit.ground(character, target.root.Position))
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function maximumoverheat(character, root)
	overheatuntil = os.clock() + data.Overheat.Duration
	tool:SetAttribute("overheat", true)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.8
	kit:play("DeathStep.V", { HRP = root })
	task.delay(0.6, function()
		if root.Parent then
			meleekit.area(kit, character, root.Position, data.Overheat.Radius, data.Damage.V, { stun = 0.4, push = 30, lift = 15 })
		end
	end)
	task.delay(data.Overheat.Duration, function()
		if os.clock() >= overheatuntil then
			tool:SetAttribute("overheat", nil)
		end
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true },
	maxhold = 3,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(_, character, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		if key == "Z" then
			rocketkickstart(root)
		elseif key == "C" then
			drillstart(character, root)
		end
	end,
	onrelease = function(_, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = meleekit.heldfor(holdstarted[key])
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "Z" then
			rocketkick(character, root, aim, math.min(held, data.Kick.MaxHold))
		elseif key == "X" then
			windbullet(character, root, aim)
		end
	end,
	onkey = function(_, character, root, _, key)
		if key ~= "V" or not kit:canuse(character, key) or not meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost.V) then
			return
		end
		kit.lastused.V = os.clock()
		maximumoverheat(character, root)
	end,
	onunequip = function()
		if drillactive and drillactive.Parent then
			drillactive:Destroy()
		end
	end,
})

local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local kit
local holdstarted = {}
local guard = 0
local guardconnection
local lasthealth

local function marker(class, name, parent, lifetime)
	local value = Instance.new(class)
	value.Name = name
	value.Parent = parent
	debris:AddItem(value, lifetime or 6)
	return value
end

local function watchguard(character)
	if guardconnection then
		guardconnection:Disconnect()
		guardconnection = nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	lasthealth = humanoid.Health
	guardconnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		local loss = (lasthealth or health) - health
		lasthealth = health
		if loss <= 0 or health <= 0 or guard <= 0 then
			return
		end
		humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, health + loss * guard)
		lasthealth = humanoid.Health
	end)
end

local function setguard(character, amount, duration)
	guard = amount
	watchguard(character)
	if duration then
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if guard == amount then
				guard = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function palms(character, root, aim)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local direction = aim.forward
	local state = marker("Configuration", "sharkmanzstate", root, 4)
	local duration = data.Palms.Range / data.Palms.Speed
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 1.4
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction)
	kit:play("Sharkman2.Z", {
		Character = character,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		CFrame = root.CFrame,
		Duration = duration,
		Distance = data.Palms.Range,
		State = state,
	})
	local target = meleekit.dash(character, root, direction, data.Palms.Speed, duration, data.Palms.Radius)
	if not target or not root.Parent then
		state:SetAttribute("State", 0)
		return
	end
	local release = meleekit.hold(target, nil, 1.2)
	meleekit.stun(target.model, 1.3)
	state:SetAttribute("State", 1)
	local started = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - started < data.Palms.Barrage and root.Parent and meleekit.alive(target.model) do
		local look = (target.root.Position - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if look.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			look = direction
		end
		local nextpos = target.root.Position - look.Unit * 4 + Vector3.new(math.random(-15, 15) / 10, 0, math.random(-15, 15) / 10)
		state:SetAttribute("NextPos", nextpos)
		state:SetAttribute("MousePos", aim.target)
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.ZPalm, target.root)
		task.wait(data.Palms.Tick)
	end
	state:SetAttribute("State", 2)
	release()
	if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.Z, target.root)
		meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 60, 20)
	end
end

local function vortex(character, root, aim, held)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local direction = (aim.target - root.Position).Unit
	if direction ~= direction then
		direction = aim.forward
	end
	local proxy = marker("BoolValue", "sharkmanxproxy", root, 5)
	proxy.Value = true
	local position = root.Position + direction * 5
	proxy:SetAttribute("ServerPosition", position)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	kit:play("Sharkman2.X", {
		Character = character,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		Stage = 1,
		Holding = kit.effectholding,
		HeldProxy = proxy,
		Duration = data.Vortex.Duration,
	})
	local started = os.clock()
	local target
	while os.clock() - started < data.Vortex.Duration and root.Parent do
		local dt = runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local nextposition = position + direction * data.Vortex.Speed * dt
		local blocked = workspace:Raycast(position, nextposition - position, meleekit.rayparams(character))
		target = meleekit.firstline(character, position, nextposition, data.Vortex.Radius)
		position = blocked and blocked.Position or nextposition
		proxy:SetAttribute("ServerPosition", position)
		if target or blocked then
			break
		end
	end
	proxy.Value = false
	proxy:Destroy()
	if not target then
		kit:play("Sharkman2.X", { Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Stage = 2, CFrame = CFrame.new(position) })
		meleekit.area(kit, character, position, data.Vortex.ExplosionRadius, data.Damage.X * 0.5, { stun = 0.4 })
		return
	end
	meleekit.stun(target.model, 1.2)
	if held >= data.Vortex.HoldThreshold and target.root then
		local grab = marker("CFrameValue", "sharkmanxgrab", root, data.Vortex.MaxHold + 1)
		grab.Value = target.root.CFrame
		grab:SetAttribute("ServerCFrame", target.root.CFrame)
		kit:play("Sharkman2.X", {
			Character = character,
			Humanoid = humanoid,
			Stage = 3,
			CFrame = target.root.CFrame,
			VictimRoot = target.root,
			GrabProxy = grab,
			MaxHold = data.Vortex.MaxHold,
			MousePos = kit.mousepos.Value,
		})
		local release = meleekit.hold(target, nil, data.Vortex.MaxHold)
		meleekit.stun(target.model, data.Vortex.MaxHold + 0.5)
		local grabbed = os.clock()
		local current = target.root.Position
		while os.clock() - grabbed < data.Vortex.MaxHold and root.Parent and meleekit.alive(target.model) do
			local dt = runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
			local goal = kit:clamprange(root.Position, kit.mousepos.Value, data.Vortex.ControlRange) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			current = current:Lerp(goal, math.clamp(dt * 6, 0, 1))
			local cframe = CFrame.new(current)
			grab:SetAttribute("ServerCFrame", cframe)
			if meleekit.isnpc(target.model) and target.root.Parent then
				target.root.CFrame = cframe
			end
		end
		grab:Destroy()
		release()
	else
		kit:play("Sharkman2.X", {
			Character = character,
			Humanoid = humanoid,
			Stage = 2,
			CFrame = target.root.CFrame,
			VictimRoot = target.root,
		})
		local release = meleekit.hold(target, nil, 1)
		task.wait(1)
		release()
	end
	if target.root and target.root.Parent then
		position = target.root.Position
	end
	meleekit.area(kit, character, position, data.Vortex.ExplosionRadius, data.Damage.X, { stun = 0.5, lift = 30 })
end

local function spear(player, character, root, aim, held)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local direction = aim.forward
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction)
	root.CFrame = cframe
	guard = 0
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 2
	kit:play("Sharkman2.C", { Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Player = player, Stage = 1, CFrame = cframe })
	if held >= data.Spear.HoldThreshold then
		kit:play("Sharkman2.C", { Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Player = player, Stage = 3, CFrame = cframe })
		setguard(character, data.Spear.AfterGuard, data.Spear.AfterGuardTime)
	end
	task.wait(0.3)
	local victims = {}
	local roots = {}
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.line(character, root.Position, root.Position + direction * data.Spear.Range, data.Spear.Radius)) do
		if target.root and meleekit.alive(target.model) and not victims[target.model] then
			victims[target.model] = target
			table.insert(roots, target.root)
			meleekit.stun(target.model, 1.8)
		end
	end
	if #roots == 0 then
		kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
		return
	end
	local releases = {}
	local index = 0
	for _, target in pairs(victims) do
		index += 1
		local spot = root.CFrame * CFrame.new((index - 1) * 2 - (#roots - 1), 0, -4)
		table.insert(releases, meleekit.hold(target, CFrame.lookAt(spot.Position, root.Position), 1.6))
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
	kit:play("Sharkman2.C", {
		Character = character,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		Player = player,
		Stage = 2,
		CFrame = root.CFrame,
		VictimRoots = roots,
		Timestamp = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
	})
	local started = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - started < data.Spear.Barrage and root.Parent do
		for _, target in pairs(victims) do
			if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.CBarrage, target.root)
			end
		end
		task.wait(data.Spear.Tick)
	end
	for _, release in ipairs(releases) do
		release()
	end
	for _, target in pairs(victims) do
		if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.C, target.root)
			meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 90, 25)
		end
	end
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { X = true, C = true },
	maxhold = 3,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(player, character, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if key == "C" then
			setguard(character, data.Spear.HoldGuard)
			kit:play("Sharkman2.C", { Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Player = player, Holding = kit.effectholding })
		end
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = meleekit.heldfor(holdstarted[key])
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "X" then
			vortex(character, root, aim, held)
		elseif key == "C" then
			spear(player, character, root, aim, held)
		end
	end,
	onkey = function(_, character, root, _, key)
		if key ~= "Z" or not kit:canuse(character, key) or not meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost.Z) then
			return
		end
		kit.lastused.Z = os.clock()
		local aim = kit:aim(root)
		task.wait(data.Palms.Windup)
		if root.Parent then
			palms(character, root, aim)
		end
	end,
	onunequip = function()
		guard = 0
	end,
})

			kit:play("Electrov2.Z", { Arg = "ClawSlash", SlashOrigin = root, SizeMult = 1 })
			local center = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * data.Rampage.Reach * 0.5
			for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.box(character, CFrame.lookAt(center, center + root.CFrame.LookVector), Vector3.new(9, 8, data.Rampage.Reach))) do

			end

		end
	end)
end

local function rampagedash(character, root, aim, held)
	local direction = aim.forward
	local distance = data.Rampage.Dash * (1 + math.clamp(held / data.Rampage.MaxHold, 0, 1))
	local endpoint, _, blocked = meleekit.impact(character, root.Position, direction, distance)
	if blocked then
		endpoint -= direction * 3
	end
	local oldpos = root.CFrame
	local newcf = CFrame.lookAt(endpoint, endpoint + direction)

	root.CFrame = newcf

		PierceOrigin = root,
		PierceChar = character,
		oldPos = oldpos,
		newCF = newcf,
		StrikeDist = (endpoint - oldpos.Position).Magnitude,
		VanishMult = 1,
	})
	meleekit.along(kit, character, oldpos.Position, endpoint, data.Rampage.Radius, data.Damage.ZDash, { stun = 0.5, ignore = {} })

end

	local direction = aim.forward
	local range = data.Thrust.Range * (1 + power * 0.6)
	local duration = range / data.Thrust.Speed
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.4
	kit:play("Electrov2.X", { Arg = "Dash", dashRef = root, FullLifetime = duration, Rate = 6, Lifetime = 0.3 })

	meleekit.dash(character, root, direction, data.Thrust.Speed, duration, nil, function()

				meleekit.stun(target.model, duration + 0.5)
			end

				target.root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
			end
		end
	end)
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	kit:play("Electrov2.X", { Arg = "Explosion", Ref = root, SizeMult = 1 + power * 0.5, mousePos = aim.target })
	meleekit.area(kit, character, root.Position + direction * 4, data.Thrust.ExplosionRadius, data.Damage.X, { stun = 0.5, push = 70, lift = 25 })
end

local function thunderclap(character, root, aim)
	local direction = aim.forward
	local target = meleekit.firstline(character, root.Position, root.Position + direction * data.Clap.Range, data.Clap.SearchRadius)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 1.6
	if not target then
		local endpoint, _, blocked = meleekit.impact(character, root.Position, direction, data.Clap.Range * 0.5)
		if blocked then
			endpoint -= direction * 3
		end
		local previous = root.CFrame
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(endpoint, endpoint + direction)
		kit:play("Electrov2.C", { Arg = "ZigZag", TrailRef = root, prevPos = previous, tTick = nexttick() })
		return
	end
	local grab = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	grab.Name = "electroclawgrab"
	grab.Parent = root
	debris:AddItem(grab, 2)
	local release = meleekit.hold(target, nil, 1.6)
	meleekit.stun(target.model, 1.6)
	task.spawn(function()
		for index = 1, data.Clap.Blinks do
			if not root.Parent or not meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				break
			end
			local previous = root.CFrame
			local angle = (index / data.Clap.Blinks) * math.pi * 2 + (index % 2) * math.pi
			local spot = target.root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 8, 0, math.sin(angle) * 8)
			root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(spot, target.root.Position)
			kit:play("Electrov2.C", { Arg = "ZigZag", TrailRef = root, prevPos = previous, tTick = nexttick() })
			kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.CBlink, target.root)
			task.wait(data.Clap.BlinkTime)
		end
		if not root.Parent then
			release()
			return
		end
		kit:play("Electrov2.C", { Arg = "ElectroJump", jumpRef = root })
		task.wait(0.2)
		local hitcf = target.root and target.root.CFrame or root.CFrame
		kit:play("Electrov2.C", { Arg = "Strike", explosionRef = root, hitCf = hitcf, tTick = nexttick() })
		task.wait(0.15)
		kit:play("Electrov2.C", { Arg = "Explode", explosionRef = root, hitCf = hitcf })
		release()
		grab:Destroy()
		if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.C, target.root)
			meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.75)
			meleekit.push(target.root, Vector3.zero, 0, 60)
		end
		meleekit.area(kit, character, hitcf.Position, data.Clap.ExplosionRadius, data.Damage.C * 0.4, { exclude = target.model, stun = 0.5 })
	end)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true },
	maxhold = 2,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(_, character, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		if key == "Z" then
			rampagestart(character, root)
		elseif key == "X" then
			thrustcharge(root)
		end
	end,
	onrelease = function(_, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = meleekit.heldfor(holdstarted[key])
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "Z" then
			rampagedash(character, root, aim, held)
		elseif key == "X" then
			thrust(character, root, aim, held)
		end
	end,
	onkey = function(_, character, root, _, key)
		if key ~= "C" or not kit:canuse(character, key) or not meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost.C) then
			return
		end
		kit.lastused.C = os.clock()
		thunderclap(character, root, kit:aim(root))
	end,
})

local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local anims = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Storage"):WaitForChild("Anims")
local kit
local holdstarted = {}
local markers = {}

local function playanim(character, name)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	local animation = anims:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if not animator or not animation then
		return
	end
	local ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
	if ok then
		track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
		track:Play()
	end
end

local function marker(class, name, parent, lifetime)
	local value = Instance.new(class)
	value.Name = name
	value.Parent = parent
	debris:AddItem(value, lifetime or 8)
	return value
end

local function clearmarker(key)
	if markers[key] then
		markers[key]:Destroy()
		markers[key] = nil
	end
end

local function talonlighter(character, root, aim, held)
	local power = math.clamp(held / data.Lighter.MaxHold, 0, 1)
	local range = data.Lighter.Range * (1 + power * data.Lighter.HoldRange)
	local duration = range / data.Lighter.Speed
	local direction = aim.forward
	local start = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction)
	root.CFrame = start
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.3
	kit:play("DragonTalon.Z", {
		stage = 1,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		origin = root.Position,
		StartCFrame = start,
		DashSpeed = duration,
		DashRange = range,
	})
	local target = meleekit.dash(character, root, direction, data.Lighter.Speed, duration, data.Lighter.Radius)
	if not target or not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	local total = data.Damage.ZBurn * data.Lighter.Ticks + data.Damage.Z
	local finisher = target.humanoid.Health <= total
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + (finisher and 3 or 2.2)
	local grabcf = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.5)
	local release = meleekit.hold(target, CFrame.lookAt(grabcf.Position, root.Position), finisher and 3 or 2.2)
	meleekit.stun(target.model, finisher and 3 or 2.2)
	local anchored = root.Anchored
	root.Anchored = true
	kit:play("DragonTalon.Z", {
		stage = finisher and 3 or 2,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		origin = root.Position,
		StartCFrame = root.CFrame,
		GrabTarget = target.root,
		CFrameGoal = target.root.CFrame,
	})
	playanim(character, finisher and "DTalon_ZExecute" or "DTalon_ZRegularHit")
	task.wait(0.5)
	for _ = 1, data.Lighter.Ticks do
		if not meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			break
		end
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.ZBurn, target.root)
		task.wait(data.Lighter.TickTime)
	end
	task.wait(finisher and 0.6 or 0.15)
	if root.Parent then
		root.Anchored = anchored
	end
	release()
	if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.Z, target.root)
		meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 90, 30)
	end
end

local function ember(character, root, aim)
	clearmarker("X")
	local direction = (aim.target - root.Position).Unit
	if direction ~= direction then
		direction = aim.forward
	end
	local start = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position + direction * 4, root.Position + direction * 5)
	local proxy = marker("CFrameValue", "dragontalonproxy", root, data.Ember.Duration + 2)
	proxy.Value = start
	local holding = marker("BoolValue", "dragontalonholding", root, data.Ember.Duration + 2)
	holding.Value = false
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	kit:play("DragonTalon.X", {
		Stage = 1,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		origin = root.Position,
		Proxy = proxy,
		Holding = holding,
		StartCFrame = start,
		Range = data.Ember.Range,
		Speed = data.Ember.Speed,
		Duration = data.Ember.Duration,
	})
	local carried = {}
	local position = start.Position
	local heading = direction
	local started = os.clock()
	local lasttick = 0
	local blocked
	while os.clock() - started < data.Ember.Duration and root.Parent do
		local dt = runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local desired = (kit.mousepos.Value - position)
		if desired.Magnitude > 2 then
			heading = heading:Lerp(desired.Unit, math.clamp(dt * data.Ember.Turn, 0, 1)).Unit
		end
		local nextposition = position + heading * data.Ember.Speed * dt
		blocked = workspace:Raycast(position, nextposition - position, meleekit.rayparams(character))
		position = blocked and blocked.Position or nextposition
		proxy.Value = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + heading)
		for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, position, data.Ember.Radius)) do
			if target.root and meleekit.alive(target.model) and not carried[target.model] then
				carried[target.model] = target
				meleekit.stun(target.model, data.Ember.Duration)
			end
		end
		local ticking = os.clock() - lasttick >= data.Ember.TickTime
		if ticking then
			lasttick = os.clock()
		end
		for _, target in pairs(carried) do
			if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				if meleekit.isnpc(target.model) and target.root.Parent then
					target.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + heading * 3)
					target.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
				if ticking then
					kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.XDrag, target.root)
				end
			end
		end
		if blocked or (position - root.Position).Magnitude > data.Ember.Range then
			break
		end
	end
	proxy:Destroy()
	holding:Destroy()
	local floor = blocked and { blocked.Position, blocked.Normal }
	if not floor then
		local ground = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), meleekit.rayparams(character))
		floor = ground and { ground.Position, ground.Normal }
	end
	kit:play("DragonTalon.X", {
		Stage = 2,
		Character = character,
		origin = position,
		ExplosionCFrame = CFrame.new(position),
		FloorBurn = floor,
		BurnDuration = data.Ember.BurnTime,
	})
	meleekit.area(kit, character, position, data.Ember.ExplosionRadius, data.Damage.X, { stun = 0.5, push = 60, lift = 30 })
	if floor then
		local burnat = floor[1]
		task.spawn(function()
			local burnstarted = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - burnstarted < data.Ember.BurnTime do
				task.wait(data.Ember.BurnTick)
				if not character.Parent then
					break
				end
				meleekit.area(kit, character, burnat, data.Ember.BurnRadius, data.Damage.XBurn, {})
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function vortexrise(character, root)
	clearmarker("C")
	local top = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, data.Vortex.Height, 0)
	local ceiling = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, data.Vortex.Height, 0), meleekit.rayparams(character))
	if ceiling then
		top = root.CFrame.Rotation + (ceiling.Position - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	end
	local hover = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
	hover.Name = "dragontalonhover"
	hover.MaxForce = Vector3.one * 1e6
	hover.P = 20000
	hover.D = 800
	hover.Position = top.Position
	hover.Parent = root
	debris:AddItem(hover, data.Vortex.TimeOut + 1)
	markers.C = hover
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, root.Position, data.Vortex.StunRadius)) do
		if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.8)
		end
	end
	kit:play("DragonTalon.C", {
		Stage = 1,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		origin = root.Position,
		StartCFrame = root.CFrame,
		UpDistance = top.Position.Y - root.Position.Y,
		goalCF = top,
		Holding = kit.effectholding,
		TimeOut = data.Vortex.TimeOut,
	})
end

local function vortexdive(player, character, root, aim)
	local hover = markers.C
	markers.C = nil
	local top = root.CFrame
	local aimpoint = kit:clamprange(root.Position, aim.target, data.Vortex.Range)
	local ground = workspace:Raycast(aimpoint + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), meleekit.rayparams(character))
	if not ground then
		ground = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), meleekit.rayparams(character))
	end
	local landing = ground and ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) or root.Position - Vector3.new(0, data.Vortex.Height, 0)
	local flat = (landing - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	local land = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and CFrame.lookAt(landing, landing + flat) or CFrame.new(landing) * root.CFrame.Rotation
	local timetoland = data.Vortex.TimeToLand
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + timetoland + 0.6
	if hover then
		hover.Position = landing
		hover.P = 8000
	end
	kit:play("DragonTalon.C", {
		Stage = 2,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		Player = player,
		origin = root.Position,
		StartCFrame = land,
		TopCFrame = top,
		TimeToLand = timetoland,
	})
	playanim(character, "DTalon_CDiveDown")
	task.wait(timetoland)
	if hover then
		hover:Destroy()
	end
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	playanim(character, "DTalon_CLand")
	meleekit.area(kit, character, landing, data.Vortex.Radius, data.Damage.C, { stun = 0.6, push = 110, lift = 45 })
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true, C = true },
	maxhold = 2,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(_, character, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		if key == "Z" then
			kit:play("DragonTalon.ZHold", { Root = root, origin = root.Position, Holding = kit.effectholding, Dur = data.Lighter.MaxHold })
		elseif key == "X" then
			clearmarker("X")
			local maid = marker("BoolValue", "dragontalonmaid", root, 4)
			markers.X = maid
			kit:play("DragonTalon.X", { Stage = 0, Character = character, Root = root, origin = root.Position, Maid = maid })
		elseif key == "C" then
			vortexrise(character, root)
		end
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = meleekit.heldfor(holdstarted[key])
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "Z" then
			talonlighter(character, root, aim, held)
		elseif key == "X" then
			ember(character, root, aim)
		elseif key == "C" then
			vortexdive(player, character, root, aim)
		end
	end,
	onunequip = function()
		clearmarker("X")
		clearmarker("C")
	end,
})

local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local replicatedstorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))
local weapondata = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("WeaponData")).godhuman
local util = require(replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("Util"))
local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local masterclock = util.MasterClock
local kit
local holdstarted = {}

local function now()
	return masterclock:GetTime()
end

local function alive(model)
	local humanoid = model and model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function firstline(character, from, to, radius)
	local best
	local bestdistance = math.huge
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.line(character, from, to, radius)) do
		local root = target.root
		if root and alive(target.model) then
			local distance = (root.Position - from).Magnitude
			if distance < bestdistance then
				best = target
				bestdistance = distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function firstnear(character, position, radius)
	local best
	local bestdistance = math.huge
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, position, radius)) do
		local root = target.root
		if root and alive(target.model) then
			local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestdistance then
				best = target
				bestdistance = distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function stun(model, duration)
	local value = model and model:FindFirstChild("Stun")
	if not value or not (value:IsA("NumberValue") or value:IsA("IntValue")) then
		return
	end
	value.Value = math.max(value.Value, duration)
end

local function push(root, direction, force, lift)
	if not root or not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flat.Unit * force + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
end

local function damagearea(character, position, radius, amount, excluded)
	for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.sphere(character, position, radius)) do
		if target.model ~= excluded and target.humanoid and alive(target.model) then
			dealdamage(character, target.humanoid, amount, target.root)
		end
	end
end

local function spend(character, amount)
	local energy = character:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	if not energy or not amount or amount <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if energy.Value < amount then
		return false
	end
	energy.Value -= amount
	return true
end

local function scaledamage(character, amount)
 if character and character:FindFirstChild("HasBuso") then
  amount *= 1.25
 end
 return amount
end

local function dealdamage(character, humanoid, amount, root)
 return kit:hit(humanoid, scaledamage(character, amount), root)
end

local function protect(character)
 local forcefield = Instance.new("ForceField")
 forcefield.Name = "godhuman_invulnerability"
 forcefield.Visible = false
 forcefield.Parent = character
 game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(forcefield, 8)
 return forcefield
end

local function unprotect(forcefield)
 if forcefield and forcefield.Parent then
  forcefield:Destroy()
 end
end

local function rayimpact(character, origin, direction, distance)
	local ignored = { character }
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Characters", "Enemies" }) do
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if folder then
			table.insert(ignored, folder)
		end
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * distance, params)
	return result and result.Position or origin + direction * distance
end

local function dash(character, root, direction, speed, duration)
 local mover = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
 mover.Name = "godhuman_dash"
 mover.MaxForce = Vector3.one * 1000000
 mover.P = 30000
 mover.Velocity = direction * speed
 mover.Parent = root
 local started = os.clock()
 local previous = root.Position
 local target
 while os.clock() - started < duration and root.Parent do
  runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
  target = firstline(character, previous, root.Position, 5) or firstnear(character, root.Position, 5)
  previous = root.Position
  if target then
   break
  end
 end
 if mover.Parent then
  mover:Destroy()
 end
 if root.Parent then
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
 end
 return target
end

local function soaringbeast(character, root, humanoid, aim)
	local origin = root.Position
	local destination = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, 70)
	local offset = destination - origin
	local direction = offset.Magnitude > 1 and offset.Unit or aim.forward
	local distance = math.clamp(offset.Magnitude, 8, 70)
	local duration = math.clamp(distance / 175, 0.08, 0.42)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction)
	root.CFrame = facing
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + duration + 0.9
	local forcefield = protect(character)
	task.delay(1.6, function()
		unprotect(forcefield)
	end)
	kit:play("SuperhumanV2.Z", {
		Stage = 2,
		Character = character,
		Root = root,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		Duration = duration,
		Timestamp = now(),
		Velocity = direction * 175,
	})
	local started = os.clock()
	local previous = root.Position
	local target
	local mover = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	mover.Name = "godhuman_dash"
	mover.MaxForce = Vector3.one * 1000000
	mover.P = 30000
	mover.Velocity = direction * 175
	mover.Parent = root
	while os.clock() - started < duration and root.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
		runservice.Heartbeat:Wait()
		target = firstline(character, previous, root.Position, 5) or firstnear(character, root.Position, 5)
		previous = root.Position
		if target then
			break
		end
	end
	if mover.Parent then
		mover:Destroy()
	end
	if not root.Parent then
		unprotect(forcefield)
		return
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	if not target then
		unprotect(forcefield)
		return
	end
	local targetroot = target.root
	local targethumanoid = target.humanoid
	if not targetroot or not alive(target.model) then
		unprotect(forcefield)
		return
	end
	local close = (targetroot.Position - origin).Magnitude <= 12
	local wasanchored = targetroot.Anchored
	targetroot.Anchored = true
	local punchamount = 6
	local totaldamage = data.Damage.Z * (close and 1.15 or 1)
	local durationofbarrage = 0.72
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + durationofbarrage + 0.25
	kit:play("SuperhumanV2.Z", {
		Stage = 3,
		TargetRoot = targetroot,
		TargetHumanoid = targethumanoid,
		UserRoot = root,
		UserHumanoid = humanoid,
		Duration = durationofbarrage,
		PunchAmount = punchamount,
		Timestamp = now(),
	})
	stun(target.model, durationofbarrage)
	for _ = 1, punchamount do
		if targetroot.Parent and root.Parent then
			targetroot.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
		end
		if alive(target.model) then
			dealdamage(character, targethumanoid, totaldamage / punchamount, targetroot)
		end
		task.wait(durationofbarrage / punchamount)
	end
	if targetroot.Parent then
		targetroot.Anchored = wasanchored
	end
	if targetroot.Parent and root.Parent then
		local finalcf = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, targetroot.Position)
		kit:play("SuperhumanV2.Z", {
			Stage = 4,
			TargetRoot = targetroot,
			UserRoot = root,
			Timestamp = now(),
			UserCFrame = finalcf,
		})
		push(targetroot, targetroot.Position - root.Position, 55, 22)
	end
	unprotect(forcefield)
end

local function heavenandearthtap(character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	local direction = aim.forward
	local distance = 180
	local impact = rayimpact(character, origin, direction, distance)
	local target = firstline(character, origin, impact, 4)
	if target and target.root then
		local targetdistance = (target.root.Position - origin).Magnitude
		local wallDistance = (impact - origin).Magnitude
		if targetdistance < wallDistance then
			impact = target.root.Position
		else
			target = nil
		end
	end
	local travel = math.clamp((impact - origin).Magnitude / 220, 0.12, 0.75)
	local positionobject = Instance.new("Vector3Value")
	positionobject.Name = "godhumanprojectileposition"
	positionobject.Value = origin
	positionobject.Parent = tool
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(origin, impact)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + travel + 0.35
	kit:play("SuperhumanV2.X", {
		Stage = 2,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Lifetime = travel,
		Distance = (impact - origin).Magnitude,
		PositionObject = positionobject,
		Timestamp = now(),
		Character = character,
	})
	task.delay(travel, function()
		if positionobject.Parent then
			positionobject.Value = impact
		end
		if not character.Parent then
			if positionobject.Parent then
				positionobject:Destroy()
			end
			return
		end
		kit:play("SuperhumanV2.X", {
			Stage = 4,
			Character = character,
		})
		damagearea(character, impact, 11, data.Damage.XTap)
		if target and target.root and target.root.Parent then
			push(target.root, target.root.Position - origin, 38, 50)
			stun(target.model, 0.35)
		end
		task.delay(2, function()
			if positionobject.Parent then
				positionobject:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function heavenandearthheld(character, root, held)
	local scale = math.clamp(held / 4, 0.15, 1)
	local radius = 42 * scale
	local damage = data.Damage.XHeld * scale
	local center = root.Position
	local cframe = CFrame.lookAt(center, Vector3.new(kit.mousepos.Value.X, center.Y, kit.mousepos.Value.Z))
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.8
	kit:play("SuperhumanV2.X", {
		Stage = 3,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Floor = kit:groundbelow(center, character),
		Timestamp = now(),
		ClapDelay = 0.65,
		HeldScale = scale,
	})
	task.delay(0.65, function()
		if not character.Parent then
			return
		end
		local ground = kit:groundbelow(root.Position, character)
		local targets = hitbox.sphere(character, ground, radius)
		for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
			if target.humanoid and alive(target.model) then
				if dealdamage(character, target.humanoid, damage, target.root) then
					stun(target.model, 0.5)
					if target.root then
						push(target.root, target.root.Position - root.Position, 34 * scale, 58 * scale)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function sixthrealmguntap(character, root, humanoid, aim, held)
 local charged = held >= 0.2
 local range = charged and 150 or 85
 local speed = charged and 260 or 220
 local origin = root.Position
 local destination = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, range)
 local direction = destination - origin
 if direction.Magnitude < 1 then
  direction = aim.forward
 else
  direction = direction.Unit
 end
 local anticipated = firstline(character, origin, origin + direction * range, 5)
 local targetposition = anticipated and anticipated.root and anticipated.root.Position or origin + direction * range
 local travel = math.clamp((targetposition - origin).Magnitude / speed, 0.08, 0.65)
 local forcefield = charged and protect(character) or nil
 if forcefield then
  task.delay(travel + 1.2, function()
   unprotect(forcefield)
  end)
 end
 kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + travel
 kit:play("SuperhumanV2.C", {
  Stage = 2,
  Char = character,
  TargetChar = anticipated and anticipated.model or nil,
  Timestamp = now(),
  TravelTime = travel,
  TargetPosition = targetposition,
 })
 local target = dash(character, root, direction, speed, travel)
 if not target or not target.root or not alive(target.model) then
  unprotect(forcefield)
  return
 end
 local targetroot = target.root
 local targethumanoid = target.humanoid
 local grabtime = charged and 0.75 or 0.22
 kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + grabtime + 0.25
 kit:play("SuperhumanV2.C", {
  Stage = 3,
  Char = character,
  TargetChar = target.model,
  TargetPosition = targetroot.Position,
  Timestamp = now(),
  TravelTime = travel,
  EndLag = 0.25,
  GrabTime = grabtime,
  Charged = charged,
 })
 stun(target.model, grabtime)
 task.wait(grabtime)
 if not alive(target.model) then
  unprotect(forcefield)
  return
 end
 dealdamage(character, targethumanoid, charged and data.Damage.CHeld or data.Damage.CTap, targetroot)
 damagearea(character, targetroot.Position, charged and 18 or 12, (charged and data.Damage.CHeld or data.Damage.CTap) * 0.55, target.model)
 push(targetroot, targetroot.Position - root.Position, charged and 105 or 70, charged and 40 or 26)
 unprotect(forcefield)
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { X = true, C = true },
	maxhold = 6,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(_, character, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if key == "X" then
			kit:play("SuperhumanV2.X", {
				Stage = 1,
				Character = character,
				Humanoid = humanoid,
				HoldValue = kit.effectholding,
				MinHold = 0.12,
			})
		elseif key == "C" then
			kit:play("SuperhumanV2.C", {
				Stage = 1,
				Character = character,
				Humanoid = humanoid,
				HoldValue = kit.effectholding,
			})
		end
	end,	onrelease = function(_, character, root, key, aim)
		local held = math.clamp(os.clock() - (holdstarted[key] or os.clock()), 0, 6)
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "X" then
			if held >= 0.12 then
				heavenandearthheld(character, root, held)
			else
				heavenandearthtap(character, root, aim)
			end
		elseif key == "C" then
			sixthrealmguntap(character, root, character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), aim, held)
		end
	end,
	onkey = function(_, character, root, humanoid, key)
		if key ~= "Z" or not kit:canuse(character, key) or not spend(character, data.Cost.Z) then
			return
		end
		kit.lastused.Z = os.clock()
		soaringbeast(character, root, humanoid, kit:aim(root))
	end,
})

local serverstorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local httpservice = game:GetService("HttpService")

local fruitkit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("fruitkit"))
local meleekit = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("meleekit"))
local hitbox = require(serverstorage:WaitForChild("hitbox"))

local tool = script.Parent
local data = require(tool:WaitForChild("Data"))
local kit
local holdstarted = {}
local chargeid

local function drain(player, character, root, aim)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local direction = aim.forward
	local origin = root.Position
	local target = meleekit.firstline(character, origin, origin + direction * data.Drain.Range * data.Drain.FarMult, data.Drain.Radius)
	local endpoint
	if target then
		endpoint = target.root.Position - direction * 3.5
	else
		local hitpos, _, blocked = meleekit.impact(character, origin, direction, data.Drain.Range)
		endpoint = blocked and hitpos - direction * 3 or hitpos
	end
	local firedir = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction)
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + (target and 1.4 or 0.4)
	kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_Z", {
		Stage = 1,
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = firedir,
		targetPos = endpoint,
	})
	task.wait(0.125)
	if not root.Parent then
		return
	end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(endpoint, endpoint + direction)
	if not target or not meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		return
	end
	local release = meleekit.hold(target, root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), 1)
	meleekit.stun(target.model, 1.1)
	kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_Z", { Stage = 2, player = player, hrp = root, origin = root.Position, fireDir = root.CFrame })
	kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_Z_Victim", { player = player, hrp = root, origin = root.Position, fireDir = root.CFrame, victimRoot = target.root })
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, humanoid.Health + humanoid.MaxHealth * data.Drain.Heal)
	end
	for _ = 1, data.Drain.Ticks do
		if not meleekit.alive(target.model) then
			break
		end
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.ZTick, target.root)
		task.wait(data.Drain.TickTime)
	end
	release()
	if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
		kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.Z, target.root)
		meleekit.push(target.root, direction, 80, 25)
	end
end

local function scarlet(player, character, root, aim)
	local origin = root.Position
	local targetpos = kit:clamprange(origin, aim.target, data.Tear.Range)
	local direction = (targetpos - origin).Unit
	if direction ~= direction then
		direction = aim.forward
		targetpos = origin + direction * data.Tear.Range
	end
	local blocked = workspace:Raycast(origin, targetpos - origin, meleekit.rayparams(character))
	if blocked then
		targetpos = blocked.Position
	end
	local flies = (targetpos - origin).Magnitude / data.Tear.Speed
	kit.busyuntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_X", {
		player = player,
		hrp = root,
		origin = origin,
		fireDir = CFrame.lookAt(origin, targetpos),
		targetPos = targetpos,
		projectileFliesFor = flies,
		projectileSpeed = data.Tear.Speed,
	})
	local dragged = {}
	local started = os.clock()
	local previous = origin
	while os.clock() - started < flies and root.Parent do
		task.wait(0.05)
		local position = origin + (targetpos - origin) * math.clamp((os.clock() - started) / flies, 0, 1)
		for _, target in ipairs(hitbox.line(character, previous, position, data.Tear.Radius)) do
			if target.root and meleekit.alive(target.model) and not dragged[target.model] then
				dragged[target.model] = target
				meleekit.stun(target.model, 0.8)
				kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.XDrag, target.root)
				kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_X_Victim", { player = player, hrp = target.root })
			end
		end
		for _, target in pairs(dragged) do
			if meleekit.isnpc(target.model) and target.root.Parent and meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				target.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + direction * 2)
			end
		end
		previous = position
	end
	if blocked then
		meleekit.area(kit, character, targetpos, data.Tear.BurstRadius, data.Damage.X, { stun = 0.5, push = 70, lift = 20 })
	else
		for _, target in pairs(dragged) do
			if meleekit.alive(target.model) then
				kit:hit(target.humanoid, data.Damage.X * 0.6, target.root)
			end
		end
	end
end

kit = fruitkit.new(tool, {
	holdkeys = { Z = true, X = true },
	maxhold = 2,
	canhold = function(_, character, _, key)
		return meleekit.spend(character, data.Cost[key])
	end,
	onholdstart = function(player, _, root, key)
		holdstarted[key] = os.clock()
		if key == "Z" then
			chargeid = httpservice:GenerateGUID(false)
			kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_Z_Held", { EffectID = chargeid, player = player, hrp = root, origin = root.Position, fireDir = root.CFrame, skillHeld = true })
		end
	end,
	onrelease = function(player, character, root, key, aim)
		holdstarted[key] = nil
		if key == "Z" then
			if chargeid then
				kit:play("Saddi2.Saddi_Z_Held", { EffectID = chargeid, player = player, hrp = root, origin = root.Position, fireDir = root.CFrame, skillHeld = false })
				chargeid = nil
			end
			drain(player, character, root, aim)
		elseif key == "X" then
			scarlet(player, character, root, aim)
		end
	end,
})
